bshang ba la sogs pa dang / dwangs ma la sogs pa'i lus zungs rnams kyi nang du zhugs pa'i rgyus rims des dri ma rnams zad par byed pa'am/ lus zungs rnams kyang zad par byas nas de'i 'og tu rnam pa kun du ste/ thams cad kyi thams cad du lus zungs bshang ba dang gci ba dang bcas pa dag ste/ rims kyi tsha bas dri ma med par byas pa'am/ yang na yan lag tsho'aga' lus zungs la sogs pa ma dag cing ljan ljin dang bcas pa'i rims kyis grangs ji lta ba bzhin du rlung la sogs pa'i nad gzhi las zhag 2bdun nam bcu'am bcu gnyis kyi bar du phal cher gnas pa'i mtshams sam/ dus kyi nges pa las ni —mi 'da' bar rjes su gnas te/ ci'i phyir zhe na/ dus de tsam gyi nang du 'chi ba'am/rims kyis 4gtong bar 'gyur ba'am/ 'chi zhing gsod par 'gyur te/nyin zhag 'di tsam gyis gtong ba'am gsod par 'gyur ro/ /de yang gang rlung shas che ba las byung ba de ni phal cher zhag bdun gyis gtong ba'am 'chi bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du mkhris pa shas che ba las byung ba ni zhag bcus so/ /bad kan shas che ba las byung ba ni bcu gnyis kyis bye brag phyed par 'gyur ba ni rims kyis 5sbyar ba'i don no/ /de skad me bzhin 'jug gis bshad/ /ces bya ba la/ de lta bu de ni sman dpyad kyi gzhung rtsom par byed pa drang srong me bzhin 'jug ces bya bas 6bshad pa'i gzhung yin no/ /ljang sngon gyis ni bshad pa'i gzhung / /bdun pa nyis bldab gyur pa 7yin/ /de bzhin dgu /dang bcu gcig bldab1/ /'di ni nad gzhi gsum gyi tshigs/ /'tsho dang 'chi bar byed pa yin/ /zhes bya ba la/ drang srong ljang sngon zhes bya bas bshad pa'i gzhung ni 'og nas bshad pa'i tshul 'dir ston pa yin te/113—1035

bdun pa ni nyis bldab tu 1brtsi ste/ rlung gi rims kyis zhag bcu bzhi na dwangs ma la sogs pa dang ma dag pa gang yin pa greyang rung ste/ rnam pa thams cad du zhag bcu bzhis 'tsho ba'am 'chi bar 'gyur ba bye brag phyed par 'gyur ba yin no / /gnyis pa ni zhag dgu pa ste/ de yang nyis bldab tu brtsis la zhag bcwa 5brgyad du bya ste/ mkhris pa shas che ba'i rims ni zhag bcwa —brgyad kyis 'tsho ba'am/ 'chi ba'i bye brag phyed par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du gsum pa ni zhag bcu sacig pa yin te/ 'di nyis bldab tu byas pas 3zhag nyi shu rtsa gnyis kyis bad kan gyi shas che ba'i rims kyi 8bye brag phyed par 'gyur te/'di dag ni nad gzhi gsum las byung ba'i rims kyi dus tshigs kyi bye brag rnam par gzhag 9pa yin no / /rims dus dag dang ma dag las/ /yun ring rta dus su gnas pa yin/ /zhes bya ba la/ de la dag pa'i 1 nad dang bshang ba dang gci ba legs par smin pa rtse zhil zhing ma smin pa'i skyon med pa yin la/de las go bzlog pa ni ma smin pa yin te/ dag pa dang ma dag pa de gnyis cha 'dres pa las 1 ni dus yun ring mo zhig tu gnas shing sngar bshad pa'i dus las yun ring du gnas te/ gang gi tshe lus zungs kyi dwangs ma la la —ni dag cing smin / la la ni ma dag cing ma ྾smin par 'gyur 7na/ de'i tshe rgyun gyi rims 'byang zhing 'dor bar mi 'gyur gye/ yun ring du gnas pa kho nar 'gyur ro/ /nad rtse trezhil ba nyam chung dang / /kha zas mi 'phrod sogs bsten pas/ /nad dkyel chung yang gnod bya sogs/ /brten 8te stobs che 1 nyid gyur las/ /gnyen por bcas shing 'phel 'bri gnas / /mi bzad pa ni nyid du 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba la/ nad kyi rtse zhil zhing nad las thar ba'i skyes bu nyam chung zhing 773—1036

lus rid par gyur pa dang / kha zas mi 'phrod pa la sogs pa bsten pa ste/zas dang skom dang sman dang spyod lam mi mthun zhing mi 'phrod pa bsten pa'i 1rgyus rlung la sogs pa'i nad gang yang rung ba dkyel chung zhing stobs shin tu zhan pa yin yang mi bzad pa'i rims rgyun 2kyi rims la sogs par 'gyur ro/ /de yang tsha ba mi bzod pa la sogs pa'i tshul gyis 'debs pa na mi bzad pa'i rims zhes bya'o/ /de yang ji ltar 'gyur zhe na/ gnod bya la sogs pa gang yang rung ba la brten zhing gnas pa ste/ lan 'ga' ni gnod bya la sogs pas 4khrag la sogs pa gang yang rung ba brten la/ lan 'ga' ni nyin mtshan la sogs pa'i dus la brten la/ lan 'ga' ni rlung la sogs pa'i rang bzhin la brten te/ de ni tshabs chen por 'gyur ba'i stobs dang / nus pa thob par 'gyur ro/ /de yang gnyen po dang bcas pa yin zhing bcos pa'i thabs yod pa ma yin la/ yang de ni 'phel ba dang 'bri ba gnyis po la brten zhing 5gnas pa yin no/ /de rnams kyis 6ni nad kyi stobs/ /rang gi 7dus su rims stobs skyed / /ces bya ba la/ nyam chung ba la sogs pa de rnams kyi rang gi dus nyin mtshan dang / dus kyi cha ni mtshan nyid can du rims kyi stobs skyed cing 'phel bar 'gyur ba yin no/ /slar yang de dag bcos thabs kyi/ /stobs che chung las ldog par byed/ /ces bya ba la/ mi bzad pa'i rims kyi rtsom pa de slar ldog cing rang gi bya ba 'gag rtapar 'gyur ba ni bcos thabs kyi stobs che chung las ldog par 'gyur te/ bcos thabs ni gnyen po ste lus zungs dang dus la sogs pa cha mi mnyam pa ni gnyen po'am/ bcos thabs kyi stobs yin la / de stobs chung bar byas pa ni nus pa zad par byas pa ste/ rgyu des ldog 113—/037

par 'gyur ro/ /nad zad rims ni phrar ༄1snagyur pa/ /bcud la sogs pa nyid la thim/ /zhes bya ba la/ nad zad pa ni nad kyi nus pa ni bri bar gyur la/rims ni phra zhing shes par dka' bar gnas pa ni dwangs ma la sogs pa'i lus zungs nyid la thim zhing mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /thim pas lus rid sha mdog nyams / / rmongs bag la sogs de yis sgred/ /ces bya ba la/ rims de lus zungs la thim pas ni lus rid pa — la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid skyed cing 'byung bar byed do/ /nye zhing kha ni bye ba'i phyir/ /dwangs ma rgyu ba'i rtsa sgo nas/ /lus kun myur du khyab pa ni/ /nad kyis skye bar byed pa yin/ /des na rgyun du rtag rims 4'gyur/ /zhes bya ba la/ rtsa sgo bar gang nye bar gnas shing kha bye bar gyur pa nyid kyi phyir/ dwangs ma rgyu ba'i rtsa'i 5sgo rnams las rlung la sogs pa'i nad gang yang rung bas lus kun khyab cing phyin par byas nas/ nad des lus thams cad khyab pa'i phyir/ rgyu des rims de rtag cing rgyun mi 'chad par 'byung bar 'gyur ba yin la/ de yang tsha ba la sogs pa'i rgyun ma chad par rgyun du 'byung bas na/ rgyun gyi rims 6'gyur ba yin no/ /de las bzlog pa 7tshul mi 'dra/ /mi snyoms rtsol ba mi mnyam pa/ /bya ba'i dus min mnyam 8yun ring / /zhes bya ba la/ de las bzlog pa ni snga ma rgyun gyi rims de las bzlog pa ste/ tsha ba'i rgyun bar bar 9 du chad pa la sogs pa'i tshul mi 'dra ba bzhi las rtag pa'i rims su gzhag 7ste/ tshul mi mthun pa ni ring zhing shin tu ring ba dang / kha bye zhing shin tu bye ba dang / dwangs mas /1bcud rtsa'i sbubs su nad kyis lus ma lus pa la myur du khyab par mi byed pa ste/ tshul de dag gi rgyun de dag gis rtag pa la sogs pa'i rims kyi mtshan nyid rnam par gzhag nyu snapa yin 113—1038

no / /de yang rtag pa la sogs pa'i rims de dag ni cha mi snyoms pa yin te/rgyu gang gis mi snyems pa yin zhe na/ rtsom pa mi snyoms 1pa'i phyir te/ dus kyi 'gyur ba mi mnyam pa'i phyir ron/ /rtsom pa mi mnyam pa de yang mkhris pa dang rlung gnyis spyi nas 'dzin pa zhes bya ba la sogs pa smos pa lta bu dang / bya ba mi mnyam pa ni/ sha dang tshil gyi nus pa dro/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa lta bu'o/ /dus mi mnyam pa ni rims kyis 'debs pa'i nyin zhag ste/ de ni nyin mtshan lan gnyis ldang / /gzhan dag nyin re lan re yin/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa de yang lan 'ga' ni nyin mo ldang / lan 'ga' ni mtshan mo/ lan 'ga' ni nyi ma phyed/ lan 'ga' ni dgongs ka ldang bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du ni yun ring du 'byel pa can yang yin pas na yun ring ste/ dus yun 4ring zhig tu gnas pa zhes bya ba'i don no/ /phal cher nad ni khrag la brten/rtag pa'i rims ni byed par 'gyur/ /de yang 5nyin mtshan lan gnyis ldang / /zhes bya ba la/ phal cher zhes bya ba mang du rlung la sogs pa'i nad gang yang rung ba khra/ ga la brten cing gnas nas rtag pa'i rims skyed cing 'byung bar byed par 'gyur la/ de yang nyin mtshan gcig 6gi nang du lan gnyis ldang bar 'gyur te/ 'dir nyin par lan gnyis ldang la/ mtshan mo lan cig ldang ngo zhes bya ba'i nges pa yod pa ma yin la/ gzhan du lan 'ga' ni nyin gcig 7la lan gnyis ldang bar 'gyur la/ lan 'ga' ni nyin mtshan gnyis la re re ldang bar 'gyur ro/ /nyin gcig nyin re lan re ldang / /de ni sha yi rtsa la brten/ /zhes bya ba la/ rims nyin gcig pa ni nyin zhag gcig gi nang du lan re re zhig ldang bar 'gyur la/ nyin gcig pa'i 8rims de ni sha'i bcud kyi dwangs 113—1039

ma rgyu ba'i rtsa la brten cing gnas pa yin no/ /gsum pa tshil gyi rtsa la gnas/ /zhes bya ba la/ rims nyin gsum pa'i nad ni tshil gyi rtsa'i nad la gnas pas rims nyin gsum pa skyed par byed do/ /mkhris pa rlung gnyis spyi nas 'dzin/ /bad kan mkhris gyur 1sum mdo na/ /rlung dang bad kan rgyab nas 'dzin/ /de ni zhag gcig gis chod yin/ /zhes bya ba la/ rims nyin gsum pa las gyur pa yin du zin kyang / mkhris pa dang rlung gnyis shas che ba rgo spyi bo ste mgo nas 'dzin pa yin la/ bad kan dang mkhris pa shas che na ni sum mdo zhes bya ba dpung pa gnyis dang / gnya' ba 'dus pa'i mtshams su na zhing de nas zug par 'gyur ro/ /rlung dang bad kan shas che na ni rgyab nas na zhing de nas 'dzin pa yin no/ /yang rims nyin gsum pa de ni zhag gcig gis 2chod pa yin no/ /nyin bzhi pa'i rims nad tshil dang / /rkang dang rus pa'i nang na gnas / /gzhan dag tshil nyid la gnas zer/ /de yi nus pa bstan pa ni/ /bad kan gyis ni byin gnyis na/ /rlung gis klad pa 4na bar byed/ /rus rkang gnyis kar 5zhugs pa yin6/ /nyin bzhi pa ni go bzlog pa'o/ /nyin gsum pas ni nyin gnyis na/ /nyin gcig 7na bar mi byed do8/ /zhes bya ba la / rims nyin bzhi pa'i mtshan nyid ni rlung la sogs pa'i nad rkang dang rus pa gang yang rung ba'i gnas su 'dug cing brten nas nad 'byung bar 'gyur te/lan 'ga' ni rkang la gnas nas nad 9 skyed do/ /lan 'ga' ni rus pa la gnas nas nad skyed 7pa yin no/ /yang sman pa gzhan dag ni nyin bzhi pa'i rims kyi gnas kyang nyin gsum pa dang 'dra bar tshil nyid la gnas nas ldang ngo zhes zer ro/ /rims nyin bzhi pa de'i nus rkamathu ni rnam pa gnyis yod par 713—1040

—bstan te/ gang gi tshe bad kan gyi shas che ba de'i tshe na ①dang po byin pa gnyis nas zug cing na bar 'gyur la/ de rlung gi shas che ba yin na ni dang por klad pa na bar byed pa yin no/ /de yang res 'ga' ni rus pa la gnas la/ res 'ga' ni rkang la zhen cing gnas pa yin no/ /res 'ga' ni rus pa dang rkang gnyis ka la zhugs te gnas pa yin la/ gnyi gar zhugs pa de'i mtshan nyid ni nyin bzhi pa gcig la ②go bzlog pa yin no/ /de yang nyi ma gnyis kyi bar du rgyun mi ①'chad pa nas de'i 'og tu nyin gcig na bar ④byed la/ ⑤de ltar nyin gcig ⑦na ba med nas yang nyi ma gnyis kyi bar du na bar byed pa yin no/ /'dis ni mtshan nyid gcig bstan pa yin la/ de las go bzlog pa'i rnam pa gzhan pa ni nyin gcig rims nad de thu nas nyi ma gnyis kyi bar du cung zad bya ste| nyi ma gsum pa la yang thu bar byed pa'i rims kyis na ba yin te/ de ni gnyis pa'o/ /nad rnams kyi ni stobs che chung / /zas dang spyod pa las 'byung zhing / /de bzhin rims rnams 'byung ba ni/ /yid dang las las skye bar 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba la/ yang dus ⑦de'i tshe rlung la sogs pa'i nad rnams kyi stobs sam mthu che chung las 'byung ba dang / zas dang spyod lam la sogs pa las rims nad du 'gyur la/ de bzhin du yid kyi /8stobs che chung dang / las sngon chad spyod pa'i stobs che chung las rims rnams skye bar 'gyur la—/ de yang lan 'ga' ni rtag pa'i rims su 'gyur ro/ /lan 'ga' ni nyin gcig pa dang / nyin gsum pa dang / nyin bzhi pa dang / de las go bzlog pa dag tu yang 'gyur la/ ched 'ga' ni nyin bzhi par gyur nas/nyin gsum pa dang blun gcig pa la sogs par 'gyur ro/ /nad kyis/ lus

zungs dkrugs gyur pa/ /nad sos nyi tshe zhu bar ①'gyur/ /de tshe nad pa dbugs drag rngul/ /mkhun ⑦zhing slon byed 'gre ba dang / /lus 'dar tshig mang tsha ba dang / /lus grang bzhin mdog nyams pa dang / /dran stor rims kyi ①shugs kyis gzer/ /khros pa'i tshul gyis lta ④ba dang / /bshang ba nad dang sgrar bcas pa/ /sla ba shugs drag 'byung ⑤ba yin/ /zhes bya ba la/sogs pa'i nad gang yang rung bas dwangs ma la sogs pa'i lus zungs dkrugs shing glogs par gyur pa'i rims de nad sos pa dang / nye ba'i tshe na lus zungs de nyid la thim zhing zhu bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas nad de zhu ba'i dbang gis de'i tshe nad pa de la dbugs kyi rngam pa cung zad drag tu 'byung zhing rngul te ba spu'i bu ga rnams nas rjochu 'dzag pa dang / de bzhin du mkhun ⑦zhing sgra mi gsal bar 'don zhing ⑧slon pa ste/ bad kan dang mkhris pa la sogs pa skyugs ⑨par byed pa dang / de bzhin du mal lam sa'i steng du 'gre zhing lus 'gyur ba dang /lus 'dar zhing g.yo ba dang / tshig mang por smra ba ste/ dgos pa yod pa de dgos ⑩pa'i tshig mang du smra ba dang / lus tsha ba dang grang ba'i rnam pa ⑩dus gcig tu smra bar 'gyur ba dang / mdog nyams shing gzi mdangs ⑫med pa dang / ⑫dran pa stor zhing 'du shes mi gsal ba dang / de bzhin du rims kyi shugs kyis gzir zhing spyorims nad kyi shugs lhag par skye ba ltar byed pa dang /khros shing 'khrugs pa lta bu'i tshul du sdang mig gis lta bar byed pa dang / de bzhin du bshang ba yang rlung la sogs pa'i nad dang rlung gi sgra dang bcas pa sla ⑫bag tu shugs su 'byung bar 'gyur ba yin no/ /lus ni yang zhing rmya dang rmongs ⑩bag tsha ba med/ /kha na thor ⑩bu 'byung dang dbang po brtas shing 113 — 1042

bde—/ /yid ni sor gnas rngul dzred bder 'byung yi ga 'byed/ /mgo bo g.ya' ba rims nad byang ba'i mtshan ma yin/ /zhes bya ba la/ mtshan ma de dag gi rjes la rims nad byang ba nyid du 'gyur ba'i mtshan ma ni lus yang bar 'gyur zhing / khong lci ba'i bag med pa dang lus rmya ba dang / rmongs 1bag dang tsha ba med pa ste/ rmya zhing nyam chung ba dang / rmongs 2bag gis 'du shes stor ba dang / tsha zhing rno bar gyur pa'i rnam pa dang bral bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du kha'i nang du thor bu smin pa phra mo 'byung ba dang /mig la sogs pa'i dbang po rnams brtas shing rang gi las kyi bya ba bde blag tu byed par nus pa dang / lus bde zhing nad kyi tshor ba med pa dang /yid so la gnas pa dang / sems kyi rang bzhin sngon chad snying stobs can 5 la sogs pa gang gi shas che ba de de bzhin du ldan par 'gyur ba dang / de bzhin du rngul dang sbrid pa bde blag tu thon zhing 6'byung ba dang / de bzhin du bkres shing zas la 'dod pa skye ba'i yi ga 'byed pa 7'byung bar 'gyur ba dang /mgo bo g.ya' zhing phrugs 8'dod pa skye bar 'gyur te/ 'di dag ni rims 9byang ba'i rtags sam mtshan ma yin no/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsnyus pa'i rnam par 'grel pa tshig gi don gyi zla zer zhes bya ba/ slob dpon zla ba la dga' bas rnam par sbyar ba las/ nad gzhi'i gnas kyi le'u gnyis pa'i rnam par 'grel pa'o// //de nas khrag dang mkhris pa dang lud pa'i nad gzhi bshad par bya'o/ /zhes bya ba la/ rims kyi tsha ba las khrag mkhris skye bar 'gyur bar bshad pas/113—1043

de'i phyir de myur du gsod pa yin pas/ rims kyi nad gzhi'i le'u'i 'og tu khrag dang mkhris pa'i nad gzhi brtsams pa yin no/ /lud pa yang khrag dang mkhris pa dang 'dra bar gnod pa myur du skyed lkupa yin pas de yang le'u 'dir bshad pa yin no/ /rab dro rab rno tsha dang skyur/ /lan tshwa la sogs tsha ba dang //khre rgod utpa la yi zas/ /de bcas shin tu bsten drags dang / /mkhris pa can gyi mkhris nad ni/ /gsher dang khrag rgyas nad du 'gyur/ /de ni phan tshun 'dres gyur pas/ /lus kun khyab par byed par 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba la/zas dang spyod lam shin tu dro zhing tsha ba'i shas che ba dang rab tu rno zhing drags pa dang / skyur ba'i ro shas cher bsten pa dang / lan tshwa'i 2ro la sogs pa ro rno ba shas cher bsten pa dang / tsha bag la gnas pa dang / de bzhin du khre rgod la sogs pa'i zas bsten 4par drags shing shas che ba dang / yang de bzhin du tsha zhing rno ba la sogs pa mkhris pa skyed 5pa'i kha zas skom 6tshad las lhag par bsten zhing zos pas 7mkhris pa'i nad gsher ba dang / khrag gi nad rgyas shing ldang bar 'gyur la/ khrag dang mkhyes pa de gnyis phan tshun gcig la gcig 'dres shing gcig pur gyur pa dang / khrag gi mdog can nyid du gyur nas lus mgo nas rkang gi bar du ma lus par kun khyab cing byer bar 'gyur ba yin no/ /mkhris pa khrag las gyur pa dang / /'dres dang gnod bya las dang gcig /mdog dang dri ni rjes mthun pas/ /khrag gi ming du bstan pa yin/ /zhes bya ba la/ mkhris pa gang yin pa ste 9khrag gi ming du bstan te/ khrag dang mkhris pa gso ba la7/ khrag ni thur song zhes bya ba la sogs pa smos pa'i tshul gyis de'i ming du 'gyur ba yin te/ gang gi phyir mkhris pa ni khrag las gyur pa 773—1044

yin zhing khrag las skyes pa yin no/ /de yang gzhung 'di nyid las/ bad mkhris dri ma bu ga ru/ /rngul dang sen mo ba spu dang / /snum dang mig dang pags pa tshil/ /rim 1bzhin lus zungs dri ma yin/ /zhes smos pa yin pas na—/ de'i phyir khrag gi snyigs 2ma ni mkhris pa yin la/ de bzhin du 'dres pa ste—/ gcig la gcig cha 'dres pa'i gnad dang / de bzhin du gnod bya las kyang 'byung ste/ gang gi phyir khrag ni 4mkhris pa nyid kyis myur du gnod par 'gyur tswal/ de bzhin du khrag gis mkhris pa la gnod par 'gyur ba 6yin te/ de la gnas pa'i phyir ro/ /de yang gzhung 'di nyid las/ 'phel dang zad par bya ba'i sman/ /gcig gi gang yin de gzhan yin/ /zhes bshad pa yin no/ /mdog dang dri yang de gnyis rjes su mthun pa 7yin te/ mkhris pa de ni kha dog dang dri yang khrag dang rjes su mthun pas de'i phyir/ mkhris pa yang 9dri dang kha dog khrag dang mtshungs pas khrag gi ming du bstan zhing bshad pa yin no/ /de ni khrag gnas mchin pa dang / /mcher pa las ni 'byung bar 'gyur / /zhes bya ba la/ khrag dang mkhyes pa de gnyis ni khrag gi gnas te/khrag dang mkhris pa rgyu ba'i rtsa sbubs nas 'byung bar 'gyur ba dang / de bzhin du mchin pa dang mcher pa yang khrag gi gnas yin pas de gnyis las 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /mgo bo lci zhing yi ga 'chus 1/ /bsil 'dod sgregs pa dud can sgyur / /sgyug cing sgyugs mdog btsog par snang / /lud pa dbugs mi bde mgo 'khor/ /khong snyom/ khra/ ga dmar nya dri bro/ /kha dri mi zhim skad 'gags la/ /mig la sogs pa'i kha dog ni/ /dmar dang ljang dang ser por snang / /rmi lam du yang kha dog de/ /'dir ni mthong bar 'gyur ba yin/ /713—1045

zhes bya ba la/ khrag dang mkhris pa'i nad 'di phyis 'byung bar gyur rten/nad kyi sngar byung ba'i tshul mgo bo lci ba la sogs pa 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /mgo bo lci ba ni dang po mgo bo mi thegs 5pa snyam sems pa'o/ /sgregs pa du ba can ni sgregs pa du ba ltar dku ba 'byung ba'o/ /sgyur ba ni gregs pa'i ro sgyur bag tu 'byung ba'o/ /sgyug pa ni slon pa'o/ /skyugs pa'i mdog btsog pa ni kha dog mi sdug pa dang / dri nga ba dang / ro mi zhim par snang ba'o/ /gzhan ni go bar zad do/ /khrag de 4nya dmar po ro 5hi ta zhes bya ba'i dri ltar shin tu dri mnam pa'am/ khrag nyid kyi mdog dmar la dri nga bar snang ba dang / kha'i dri mi zhim zhing mnam 6pa sngar byung ba'i tshul las de shes par bya'o/ /de bzhin du skad 'gags shing subs pa dang / de bzhin du mig dang pags pa dang /gdong dang / lce dang / bshang ba dang / gcin la sogs pa kha dog dmar ba dang / dud 7pa ltar ljang ba dang / ser por snang ba las shes par bya la/yang de bzhin du rmi lam gyi nang du yang kha dog dmar po dang / ljang gu dang /ser por mthong bar 'gyur ba yin no/ /stod du sna mig 9rna ba kha/ /smad du bshang sgo 1 pho mo'i mtshan/ /ba spu'i bu ga kun las kyang / /khrag rab rgyas pa 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba la/ khrag dang mkhris pa'i nad de stod du sna dang mig dang rna ba dang kha'i sgo bdun nas 'byung bar 'gyur ba dang / smad du bshang sgo dang pho mtshan dang mo mtshan te bu ga gsum las 'byung bar 'gyur la/de bzhin du ba spu'i bu ga ma lus pa kun las kyang 'byung ste/ rngul 'byung ba'i rtsa sgo thams cad las kyang 'byung ba ste/ khrag rgyas pa shā/'byung bar 'gyur ba'i sgo ni de dag yin no/ /stod kyi bad kan yin gso sla/ /de rgo 1 bkru sman 713—1046

btang bas gso/ /sman mang yod cing mkhris pa yi/ /sman gyi mchog ni bkru sman yin/ /zla la yod pa'i bad kan yang 1/ /der ni de yis sbyangs 27byas 'gyur / /de rngu la sman ni mngar dang bska/ /bad kan dag la phan pa la/ /gang gtogs dang thugis bad kan sel/ /kha dang bska ba smos ci dgos/ /zhes bya ba la/ stod kyi char 5byung ba'i bad kan dang mkhris pa gang yin pa de ni bad kan rgyas pa las gyur pa yin pa'i phyir/ gso sla zhing bcos par sla ba yin la/ de yang bkru sman btang bas lam bsgyur te gso dgos pa yin no/ /de bzhin du sman yang mang du yod pa ste/ sman ro mngar ba dang kha ba dang bska ba rnams phan pa'i phyir ro/ /yang stod du byung 6ba'i khrag mkhris la mkhris pa'i nad la phan pa'i sman bya ba ni sman gyi mchog yin te/ stod du byung 7ba'i khrag dang mkhris pa'i zla la 8bad kan yod pa de bkru sman byas pas 9gang yin pa de 1 sbyang zhing dag par 'gyur ro/ /bad kan sbyangs shing dag pa'i skyes bu de 11la sman mngar ba rnams kyi khu ba la sogs pa rnams kyang bad kan la phan pa yin te/don du bad kan 1rtaganod pa'i mngar ram/ bad kan la phan par gyur na bad kan 'ba' zhig yod pa de la rang bzhin gyis bad kan sel bar byed pa'i sman kha ba dang bska ba dag byin na phan par 'gyur zhing bsngags pa yin pa lta smos kyang ci dgos/ thur du 'byung ba'i — /rlung yin phyir7/ /de ni sasgyug sman btang bas gso/ /mkhris pa'i sman ni nyung ba yin/ /sgyug sman mkhris pa'i sman mchog yin/ /zla la yod pa'i rlung nad kyang / /de ni de yis zhi mi 'gyur/ /de la laro ni mngar bskol ba/ /'ba' zhig phan par 'gyur ba yin/ /zhes bya ba la/ thur du 'byung zhing ro smad kyi lam nas 'bab pa'i khrag dang mkhris pa ni 113—1047

rlung nad shas che ba las byung ba'i phyir/ de lkugaso ba tsam du byas pa las gtan bsal bar dka' ba yin la/ de yang sgyug sman btang bas gso zhing slon du 'byung ba 2—ni de'i gso ba yin no/ /khrag dang mkhris pa de ni sman shin tu nyung ba yin zhing mngar ba 'ba' zhig gis gso dgos pa yin la/ lam bsgyur ba'i skyug sman gtang ba de ni mkhris pa'i sman gyi mchog kyang ma yin la/ zla la yod pa'i rlung nad gzhan 5dbang du byed pa de yang skyug sman gyis zhi bar mi 'gyur la/ 'og tu 'bab pa'i khrag dang mkhris pa de la ni 6sman ro mngar ba kho na bskol ba 7la sogs pa 8phan pa yin gye/ kha ba'i sman khu ba la sogs pa ni ma yin te/ de rnams kyis 9rlung skyed pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /bad kan rlung ni 'dres pa'i nad / /gnyi gar 'byung ba gso dka' 1ste/ /bzlog pa'i thabs ni med phyir dang / /sman yang yod pa ma yin no/ /zhes bya ba la/khrag dang mkhris pa dang 1 bad kan dang 'dres pa'i nad las byung bar gyur nas lus kyi stod dang lus kyi smad gnyis ka las 'byung ba de ni shin tu bcos par dka' ba yin te/ ci'i phyir zhe na/ bzlog par mi nus pa yin te/ de'i phyir nad kyi lam bzlog cing sabasgyur nas bcos pa'i thabs med pa'i phyir dang /de bzhin du de lta bu'i nad dang glu'atsham zhing gnyi ga las mi 'byung ba'i sman yod pa ma yin pas/ gsor mi rung ba yin no/ /'di las bzlog par bya ba'i thabs / / sbyang ba'ang 1 yod pa ma yin te/ /sbyangs pas nyu/bzlog par bya ba dag /sman pas 9khrag mkhris gso ba yin/ /zhes bya ba la/ gang gi phyir khrag dang mkhris pa'i nad rgyas te byung ba 'di la smyung ba bya ba sman dpyad kyi thabs yin na/ sbyang ba de ni gang zhig btang na gnyi ga nas 'byung ba'i khrag mkhris 713—1048

bad kan dang 77rlung 'dres par gyur pa de dus gcig tu'am gzhan du khrid cing sel bar byed pa de lta bu'i bzlog par bya ba'i thabs su gyur pa'i sbyang ba gang yang yod pa ma yin la/ khrag dang mkhris pa'i nad la ni sbyangs pas 2mi mthun par bzlog cing lam bsgyur ba nyid kyis sman pas bcos dgos na/ lam gnyis nas 'byung ba 'di ni bzlog par nus pa ma yin te/ gang gi phyir thur du 'bab pa las ltos 4te/ sgyug sman btang na ni stod du 'byung ba bzlog par mi 'gyur la / stod du 'byung ba las ltos te bkru sman btang na ni thur du 'byung ba mi bzlog 5pas bcos pa'i thabs med pa yin no/ /mkhris pa nye bar zhi ba yang /'di las 6yong ye yod ma yin/ /'dres par gyur pa'i nad la ni/ /thams cad sel ba'i zhi bya phan/ /zhes bya ba la/ 'di la sbyang ba nye bar zhi bar bya ba'i thabs rnam pa thams cad du med pa de bzhin du zhi bar bya ba'i thabs kyang yod pa ma yin te/ gal te stod du byung ba'i 7bad kan dang 'byel pa la phan par 'gyur ba kha ba dang bska ba la sogs pa'i sman btang na ni/ de rlung la gnod pas thur du 'byung ba 'phel bar 'gyur la/ gang smad du byung ba'i rlung las gyur pa la phan pa sman mngar ba byin na ni/ de bad kan la gnod pas stod du 'byung ba 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /de bas na lam gnyis ka nas 'byung ba'i khrag mkhris 'di la ni sbyang ba dang 'dra bar zhi bar bya ba'i thabs kyang yong ye rnam pa thams cad du yod pa ma yin no/ /de yang gang gi phyir nad 'dres par gyur byung phyogs gcig tu gnas la bya ba cig 1 rtsom par 'gyur ba'i nad la ni thams cad sel ba ste/ nad gzhi gsum char sel ba'i zhi bar bya bas 11phan pa yin na/ stod smad kyi lam gnyis ka nas 'byung ba'i khrag dang mkhris pa 113byed1049

la ni nad gzhi gsum char sel bar 'gyur ba'i sman yod pa ma yin te/ nad gzhi gsum tha dad par gnas pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de la nad dang rjes lkumathun pa'i/ /gtar ga btab ste brtag par bya/ /zhes bya ba la/ khrag dang mkhris pa'i nad de la ni gtar ga btab ste khyag phyung la/ khrag 'di ni rlung 'khrugs pa yin no/ /'di ni mkhris pa 'khrugs pa yin no/ /'di ni bad kan 'khrugs pa'o/ /'di ni 'dres pa'am ldan pa 'khrugs — pa'o/ /'di ni 'dus pa las gyur pa yin no/ /zhes gtar gas bton pa'i khrag nyid la shubartag par bya ste/ rlung khrag gnag dang dmar dang rtsub/ /ces bya ba la sogs pas ni rlung las gyur pa dang / mkhris khrag ser la rtsa gnag mnam/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pas ni mkhris pa las gyur pa dang / bad kan khrag ni 'jam la skya/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pas ni bad kan las gyur pa nas/ nyes gsum dri ma rnyog pa can/ /zhes bya ba'i bar gyis 'dres pa dang 'dus pa las gyur par shes par bya'o/ /bla brnan 4byung bar gyur pa dag5 /'gyur bar 6shes las rtogs par bya/ /zhes bya ba la/ khrag dang mkhris pa de bla brnan 7 byung bar gyur pa dag ni lus kyi 'gyur ba'i bye brag shes par bya ba'i le'u las/ /khrag dang mkhris pa shin tu dmar/ /yang na gnag pa 'am 'tsho ba'am3 / /zhes bya ba la sogs pa las rtogs par bya'o/ /de la lud 9pa myur gnod byedatso //de phyir de nyid bshad par bya/ /zhes bya ba la/ nad de rnams kyi 71nang nas lud pa ni gnod pa myur du skyed cing khyad par du mi bde bar byed pa yin pas/de'i phyir lud pa de'i mtshan nyid gang dag yin pa bshad par bya'o/ /lud pa rlung mkhris bad kan dang / /glo rdol glo gcong la tsolngar bshad/ /ces bya ba la/113—1050

lud pa ni rlung las gyur pa la sogs pa'i dbye bas rnam pa lnga yod do zhes lha'i mig dang ldan pa'i drang srong chen po rnams kyis bshad do/ /thams cad ma gsos zad byed 'gyur/ /phyi ma bzhin du stobs chen yin/ /zhes bya ba la/lud pa de dag thams cad ma 1gsos shing btang snyoms su bzhag 2na mthar zad byed kyi glo gcong chen por 'gyur ba'am/ mthar 'chi ba nyid du 'gyur la/lud pa de rnams kyang phyi ma bzhin du stobs che ste/ rlung gi lud pa bas ni mkhris pa'i lud pa stobs che la/ de bas ni bad kan lud pa stobs che/ de bas ni glo rdol 4ba'i lud pa stobs che/ de bas ni glo gcong zad byed kyi lud pa stobs che zhing shugs drag pa yin no/ /de rnams 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i rtags/ /gre ba g.ya' zhing yi ga 'chus/ /gre nang gra mas gang snyam sems/ /zhes bya ba la/lud pa de rnams phyis 'byung bar 'gyur zhing skye ba la sogs pa'i rtags sam mtshan ma ni gre ba g.ya' zhing yi ga 'chus par 'gyur ba dang / gre ba'i nang thams cad nas kyi gra mas gang ba snyam du sems shing rtsub par 'gyur ro/ /de la thur rgyu'i rlung gnod 'gyur/ / stod du song 5ste brang du phyin/ /de tshe mgul pa'i nang du zhen/ /mgo bo'i rtsa rnams bkang nas ni/ /de nas yan lag 'degs pa ltar/ /g.yengs byed mig rdol tsam du na/ /rgyab brang rtsib 6logs na zhing zug /kha ru 'byung zhing rgyu ba 7na/ /lud pa sgod chag 'dra'i sgra 'byung / /zhes bya ba la/ de la lud pa thams cad la thur du rgyu ba'i rlung gnod pa dang bcas shing thur du 'byung du ma ster bas de stod du song ste brang du phyin par gyur pa la/ de'i tshe des 8shugs brgal ba las 9mgul pa yan chad kyi bar zhen cing gnas nas/ mgo bo'i rtsa sgo rnams nas zhugs te/ gnas

de dag bkang zhing khyab par byed la/ de nas de'i 'og tu lus kyi yan lag rnams gyen du bskyod cing 'degs pa ltar byed pas rnam par g.yengs par byed la/de bzhin du mig gnyis phyung zhing rdol ba tsam 1 du na ba dang rgyab dang brang dang rtsib logs kyi phyogs rnams kyang na zhing zug pa dang bcas pas rlung de kha'i sgor rgyu zhing 'byung bar byed de/ de'i tshe lud pa snod chag pa'i sgra 'byung zhing khar sogs bcag 4pa'i sgra dang bcas pa 'dra bar 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /nad gzhi'i 5dbye bas nad kyang ni/ /tha dad shugs dang bcas pa yin/ /nad gang sgra ni mi snyoms pa/ /de las 6lud pa 'byung ba yin/ /zhes bya ba la/nad gzhi'i rgyu'i bye brag 7dbye bas rgyu tha dad pa'i phyir lud pa'i nad kyang rnam pa tha dad cing rlung de shugs sam stobs dang bcas pa yin la/ des na brod pa'i nad gang yin nga/'i sgra yang mi snyoms shing sgra che ba la sogs pas lud pa de 'byung ba yin no/ /de ni 'di skad ston pa yin te/ de la rlung ni rang bzhin gyi shugs dang bcas pa yin la/ shugs de yang rgyu sna tshogs pa'i dbang gis che ba'am chung bar 'gyur la/ gang de dang phrad pa'i sgra de yang rgyu'i khyad par gyi 1 dbang gis gnod pa 1 sna tshogs pa skyed par 'gyur ro/ /rlung nad skyed pa rlung 'khrugs pa/ /brang dang gre ba kha skam zhing / /snying brang rtsib logs klad pa gzer / /rmongs bag khong 'khrugs skad 'gags shing / /lud pa skam po 'byung byed cing / /na ba'i shugs drag sgra cher 'byung / /lus kun brtse bcas bad kan skam/ /'thon par dka' zhing nyung ngu 'byung / /zhes bya ba la/rlung nad skyed par byed pa'i kha zas dang spyod lam rtsub cing grang ba la sogs pa bsten pa dang / lam dang bud med la sogs pas dub pa dag gis rlung nad de 713—1052

'khrugs shing ldang bar gyur na/ brang dang gre ba dang kha shin tu skam 1par byed pa dang / snying ga la sogs par gzer bar byed pa dang / lud pa skam po bad kan dang mchil snabs med par 'byung bar byed pa dang / de bzhin du tsha 2ba'i tshabs che ba dang / shugs 'byung ba drag po dang / sgra chen po 'byung ba dang bcas pa yin no/ /yang lud nga/ de ni lus dang yan lag brtse ba dang bcas pa dang / bad kan nam mchil snabs nang nas 'thon pa shin tu dka' ba 'byung zhing nyung zhig 'byung ba yin no/ /mkhris pas mig dang 4bad kan ser / /kha nang kha zhing rims mgo 'khor/ /khrag mkhris 5slon zhing skom dad che / /skad 'gags dud 'dra sgyur ba dang / /lud pa'i shugs kyi rgyun 'byung ba / /skar mda' 'phro ba lta bur snang / /zhes bya ba la/ lud pa mkhris pa las gyur pa las ni mig ser ba 6dang / bad kan 'byung ba ser bar 'byung ba dang / de bzhin du kha'i nang kha ba bro ba dang / rims la sogs pa 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /yang lud pa dud pa 'dra ba 'byung zhing dri skyur ba 'byung ba dang / lud pa 'byung ba'i shugs kyi rgyun rtag tu 'byung zhing skar mda'i tshogs 'phro ba ltar mthong bar 'gyur ba'am/ rma bya'i sgo ltar kha dog sna tshogs snang bar 'gyur ro/ /bad kan las brang nad tshabs chung / /mgo lci snying ga gang snyam sems/ /gre bar bskus 'dra snyom par byed/ /cham 'debs zas sgyug yi ga 'chus/ /sru brtse lud pa skam pa dang / /snum zhing dkar ba 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba la/ bad kan las gyur pa'i lud pa'i mtshan nyid ni brang du zug cing na ba dang / na ba'i tshabs chung ba dang / mgo bo phyi zhing bem bem por 'dug pa dang / snying ga rnger mer por gang ba snyam du sems pa 713—/053

dang / gre bar chags shing 'dam pa bsgus pa snyam du sems pa dang / lus dang yan lag snyom zhing lci ba dang / cham pas 'debs pa dang / kha zas skyug cing slon pa dang / sru bshor zhing brtse 1ba dang / lud pa skam pa dang /snum pa dang / dkar bar 'byung ba ni bad kan gyi mtshan nyid yin no/ /stobs 'gyed la sogs drag shul rnams/ /mi nus bzhin byas de dang des/ /rlung gis brang nang glo dral la/ /mkhris pa rjes 'brangs dkyel gyur pa/ /'khrugs te lung/ pa lu bar byed/ /de ni bad kan khrag bcas dang / /ser zhing gnag la skam pa dang / /ril ril por mnam mang du 'byung / /'byung tshe gre ba na ba dang / /brang ni dral ba snyam du sems/ /khab ni rnon pos phug snyam 5sems/ /gzer gyis 'debs par byed pa dang / /tshigs 'bye rims dang dbugs mi bde/ /skad 'gags lus 'dar skom dad che/ /phug ron lta bur mkhun 'byin to6/ /rtsib logs gzer 'gyur 8de nas ni/ / rim gyis / stobs dang me drod dang / /nus pa nyams ni 'bri bar 'gyur/ /zad byed kyis gcin khrag dang bcas/ /rgyab dang rkang pa na bar 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba la/ stobs 'gyed pa ni lag stobs 'gyed cing rtsal bskyod 1pa la sogs pa'o//la sogs pa zhes smos nga/ rta ni/ bud med bsten drags pa dang / khur dang las kyis dub pa dang / glang po che dang rta 'dul ba la sogs pa'i drag shul rnams mi nus bzhin du byas pa dag basbu'o/ /de ltar stobs 'gyed pa la sogs pa'i drag shul mi nus bzhin du nan kyis rtsom par byed/ bsten par byas pa'i rgyu rnam pa mang po de dang des rlung 'khrugs pas brang gi nang gi glo dbral 1 zhing gtses par byed pa yang rlung de mkhris pa dang 'byel zhing / mkhris pa rjes su 713—/054

'brangs pa zla la yod na de stobs skye zhing dkyel du gyur pas lud pa lu bar byed pa yin no/ /de nas lud pa des 1bad kan khrag dang bcas pa dang / kha dog ser ba dang / rtsa gnag pa dang / skam zhing ljan ljin med pa dang /ril ril por gnas la mnam pa dag mang du 'byung zhing slon la 'byung ba'i tshe gre ba'i nang na zhing gzer ba dang bcas pa'o/ /brang gi 2phyogs dbral zhing gshags pa snyam du sems pa dang / yang brang de nyid khab rnon pos phug cing gtsags 4pa snyam du sems pa dang / gzer gyis 5'debs pa dang / ji lta bu'i tshul du 'byung zhe na/ tshigs bye ba snyam du sems pa la sogs pa'i gnod pa dang bcas par 'gyur ba dang / yang de bzhin du phug ron ltar sgra mi gsal ba'i tshig tu mkhun zhing 6'byin pa dang / rtsib logs kyi phyogs gzer ba dang bcas par 'gyur ro/ /de nas de'i 'og tu lud pa can gyi skyes bu des dus kyi rim 7gyes lus kyi stobs la sogs pa 8'bri bar 'gyur ro/ /de la stobs ni khu chu'o / /me drod ni zas 'ju zhing smin par byed pa'i pho ba'i me drod do/ /nus pa ni nyams stobs so/ /de zad byung nyams pas cir 'gyur zhe na/gcin khrag dang bcas par 'gyur ba dang / rgyab dang rkang pa mi bzad par na bar 'gyur ro/ /gtso bo rlung ni 'khrugs pa yis / /lus zungs zad byed nad rgyal po/ /glo gcong gi ni gnas byed cing / /lud pa lu zhing bad kan 'byung / /rnag 'dra mnam zhing ser ba dang / /rul zhing rtsa sngo dmar ba dang / /rtsib logs bton sapa ltar sems shing / /snying ni lhung ba snyam du byed/ /rgyu med dro dang grang 1 ba 'dod/ /zas mang za zhing nyams stobs zad/ /bzhin ni snum zhing dang bar snang / /mig ni mdangs ldan blta ཿsdug 'gyur/ /de 113—/055

nas de las zad byed tsho'agyur/ /thams cad 'byung bar 'gyur ba yin/ /zhes bya ba la/ glo gcong dang ldan pa'i skyes bu la ni rlung gtso bor gyur pas/'og nas bshad pa'i glo gcong gi nad kyi rgyu rnams kyis 'khrugs shing ldang bar 'gyur la/ des lus zungs rnams zad par byas nas/ nad kyi rgyal po zad byed dam/ /glo gcong zhes bya ba'i gnas 2gzhir byung la/ rgyu des na lud pa lu bar 'gyur ro/ / des na skyes bu de bad kan 'byung zhing slon par phal cher rnag la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid dang ldan par 'byung bar 4'gyur ro/ /rtsib logs bton pa ltar sems pa ni gnas de dag bsgul zhing phyung ba snyam du sems par 'gyur ro/ /yang de bzhin du 5glo gcong gi lud pa de snying la 6gnas nas lhung 7zhing 'byung ba snyam byed pa dang / rgyu med par glo bur du tsha ba dang grang ba 'dod cing bsten pas dga' bar byed de/ grang bas nyen pa med par dro ba 'dod pa dang / tsha bas nyen pa med par grang zhing bsel ba 'dod par 'gyur ba dang / kha zas mang du zos su zin kyang nyams stobs 'bri zhing chung bar 'gyur ba dang / bzhin ras snum zhing cung zad dang ba dang ldan par 'gyur ba dang / mig mdangs dang ldan zhing blta na sdug pa mthong na dga' bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas de'i 'og tu lud pa can gyi skyes bu de la zad byed kyi tshul thams cad de gcong chen po'i mtshan nyid ma lus par 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de ltar glo rdol las byung lud/ /nyam chung lus ni 'jig byed de/ /stobs ldan gso ba tsam du rung / /glo gcong las byung de dang —'dra/ /zhes bya ba la/ sngar bshad pa'i mtshan nyid de ltar na glo rdol ba las byung ba'i lud pa 'dis rta5ni skyes bu nyam chung zhing stobs zad pa'i lus 'jig cing 'joms par 713byed/056

byed pa yin la/ skyes bu stobs dang ldan pa la ni re zhig gso ba tsam du rung ba yin no/ /glo gcong las byung ba'i lud pa yang glo rdol gyi lud pa dang tshul 'dra ba yin no/ /de gnyis gsar byung mgon ldan 'grub/ / ces bya ba la/① glo rdol ba dang glo gcong las byung ba'i lud pa de gnyis gsar du byung zhing nad kyis btab nas ring po ma lon par ②yang yin no①/ /mgon dang ldan pa de gso ba'i yan lag bzhi car dang ④ldan pas legs par gsos na 'grub cing 'tshor rung ba yin no/ /nad gzhi tha dad gsum gsor rung / /zhes bya ba la/lud pa de dag gi nang nas nad gzhi tha dad pa'i lud pa rlung dang mkhris pa bad kan las byung ba ni gsor rung ba yin no/ /gnyis 'dres kun kyang rgan po ni/ /na tshod zad btab 'tsho ba tsam/ /zhes bya ba la/ nad gzhi gnyis 'dres pa las byung ba'i lud pa gang yin pa de ⑤ni gso ba tsam du byar rung ba yin la/yang lud pa gsor rung bar bshad ladhi/ nad gzhi tha dad pa las byung ba dag kyang mi rgan pa las ⑦byung zhing / na tshod dengs shing zad pa la btab na re zhig gso ba tsam du byar rung ba yin no/ /lud pa yal bar bor ba las/ /dbugs mi bde dzeedang zad byed slon/ /skad 'gags la sogs nad 'byung 'gyur/ /de phyir de ni myur du gso/ /zhes bya ba la/ gang gi phyir lud pa yal bar bor zhing ma bcos pa las dbugs mi bde ba la sogs pa'i nad 'byung bar 'gyur bas/de'i phyir lud pa gsar pa de myur du gso zhing sman dpyad kyis bcos par bya'o/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa'i rnam par 'grel pa tshig gi don gyi zla zer zhes bya ba/ slob dpon zla ba la dga' bas nges par sbyar ba las/ nad gzhi'i gnas kyi le'u gsum pa'i rnam par 'grel pa'o// //113—1057

de nas dbugs mi bde ba dang skyigs bus btab pa'i nad gzhi ①bshad par bya'o/ /zhes bya ba la/ 'di brtsams pa'i 'byel pa ni 'di yin te/dbugs mi bde ba ni lud pa las 'byung ste/ 'di nyid las lud pa 'phel ba las dbugs mi bde ba 'byung bar gzhung rtsom pas bshad pa yin no/ /de bas na 'di'i 'og tu dbugs mi bde ba'i nad gzhi bshad pa yin la/ skyigs bu yang de'i rkyen gyis 'byung bas dbugs mi bde ba'i zhar la skyigs bu yang bshad pa yin te3/ lud pa 'phel ba'am sngar nad gzhi/ /'khrugs las dbugs mi bde 'byung 'gyur/ /ma zhu tshad 'khru 1slon dug 'thungs/ /skya ④rbab rims btab las kyang 'byung / /zhes bya ba la/ lud pa ⑤'phel ba ni lud pa shas ducher rgyas pa ste/ de las dbugs mi bde ba 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /yang na nad thams cad kyi nad gzhi bshad pa'i skabs su sngar bshad pa'i nad gzhi kha ba dang / tsha ba dang dro ba'i bag zos pa las nad gzhi 'khrugs pas dbugs mi bde ba 'byung bar 'gyur rome/ /de bzhin du ma zhu ba la sogs pa'i nad kyis btab pa las dbugs mi bde ba 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /phran tshegs mun can chad pa dang / /chen po gyen 'byung rnam pa lnga/ /zhes bya ba la/ dbugs mi bde ba ni phran tshegs la sogs pa'i dbye bas rnam pa lnga yod do/ /bad kan gyis ni rgyu 5lam bkag /rlung ni sna tshogs khyab par gnas/ /srog dang zas skom rgyu ba'i lam/ /sbu gu nad kyis bkag pas na⑨/ /ma zhu'i gnas nas 'byung ba'i dbugs/ /brang gnas ⑫dbugs mi bde bar byed/ /ces 47bya ba la—/ rlung gang bad kan gyi nyusnye rgyu ba'i lam gyi sgo bkag nas/ rlung de sna 113—1058

tshogs par thams cad du khyab ste gnas nas ldang bar 'gyur la/ yang rlung de srog la sogs pa rgyu ba'i lam gyi bu ga nad kyis 'khrugs par byas pas ma zhu ba'i gnas nas byung ba'i dbugs gang yin pa de brang na gnas shing brten hu nas dbugs mi bde bar byed pa yin no/ /de yi sngon tshul snying rtsib logs/ /gzer zhing srog rlung mi mthun rgyu/ /sbos dang mur 'gram na ba yin/ /zhes bya ba la/ de'i sngon tshul ni dbugs de khye)sngar byung ba'i nad kyi tshul 3lam rtags ni snying dhil sogs pa gzer ba dang / srog ces bya ba'i rlung mi mthun pa rgyu zhing phyin ci log tu 'gro ba dang / lto sbos pa dang mur 'gram gnyis su na zhing zug par 'gyur ro/ /des ⑤ni drag shul 'grangs drags pas⑥/ /bskyod pa'i rngam pa phran tshegs 'gyur/ /de ni rang nyid zhi bar 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba la/ de la dbugs mi bde ba rnams kyi nang nas phran tshegs ni drag shul la sogs pas bskyod pa'i rlung las 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de la drag shul ni lus dub par byed pa'i las khur 'degs pa la sogs pa'o/ /'grangs ④drags pa ni tshad las lhag par mang du zos pa'o/ /de dag gis bskyod pa ni ldang bar byed pa ste/ de lta bu'i rngam pa ni phran tshegs yin la/ chung ngu phran tshegs de ni gso ba'i sman dpyad bya ⑧mi dgos par dus cung zad cig ngal bso ba tsam gyis rang nyid nye bar zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /rlung ⑨gis rtsa sbubs log rgyu byed/ /bad kan slongs par gyur nas ni/ /klad pa mgul pa'i nad song ste/ / brang dang rtsib ⑩logs na bar byed/ /lud pa'i ngar sgra 'dzer mi dran/ /cham pa mi bzad ⑪yi ga 'chus/ /mi bzad ⑫shugs ni skyed byed cing / /dbugs mi bde ba de'i shugs kyis/ /srog la gnod 'gyur lud pa'i mthar/ /skad cig 113—1059

bde bar byed pa yin/ /nyal tshe shin tu mi bde la/ /'dug na cung zad bde bar 'gyur/ /mig gdangs dpral ba'i phyogs nas ni/ /rngul 'dzag shin tu na bas nyen/ /kha skam ①dbugs ni bstud ②mar 'byung / /dro ba 'dod cing 'dar dang bcas/ /char 'bab grang dang ser bus ①phog /bad kan skyed pas rnam par 'phel/ /mun can de ni 'tsho bya tsam/ /nyams ldan gsar du btab gso blarjo/ /zhes bya ba la/ rlung gis bumi mthun pa rgyu zhing rtsa'i sbubs su log par rgyu bar byedarjo/ des bad kan slongs shing stod du bskyod par 'gyur ba dang / klad pa dang mgul ba'i nang du song zhing kun tu khyab ste/brang dang rtsib ⑦logs na zhing gzer bar byed nas lud pa la sogs pa'i shugs mi bzad pa ③skyed par byed do/ /dbugs mi bde ba yang shugs mi bzad pas srog la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed de/ gang gi ⑨srog ces bya ba'i rlung la gnod cing gzer bar byed pa de ⑩ni srog la gnod pa'i dbugs mi bde ba zhes bya'o/ /yang na srog ni 'tsho ba'i dbang po'am stobs la bya la/ de dbugs mi bde ba'i shugs kyis gnod par byas pas ⑪sdug bsngal bar 'gyur ro/ /lud pa'i mtha' ni bad kan dang / snabs la sogs pa 'dor ba'i mthar skad cig gam thang cig tsam gyi bar du bde bar gnas par byed pa yin no/ /yang de rgo mal na gnas shing nyal ba'i tshe shin tu mi bde zhing sdug bsngal bas dbugs 'byin par byed pa yin la/ de nas langs te tsog tsog po ⑫la sogs pa'i tshul du 'dug na cung zad bde zhing shugs ngal ba yin no/ /mig gdangs pa ni gyen du blta ba'o//dpral ba'i phyogs nas ⑫rngul 'dzag pa ni rngul 'byung zhing dri ma rlan can du spyo'adzag pa'o/ /shin tu na bas ⑩nyen pas ni brnag ⑫par dka' ba'i nad kyis 113—1060

nyam thag par 'gyur ro/ /kha skam ①pa ni khyad par du kha skam zhing rlan ⑤med pa'o—/ /yang de bzhin du dbugs bstud kyemar 'byung zhing yang yang ④du rtseg mar 'gyur ba dang / dro ba'i bag yid la 'dod cing bsten spyopar dga' ba dang lus 'dar ba dang bcas pa yin no/ /yang dbugs mi bde ba de ni char mi 'bab dhipa la sogs pa bad kan skyed dzeepa'i kha zas dang spyod lam gyis rnam par 'phel zhing dkyel skye bar 'gyur ro/ /mun pa can gyi dbugs mi bde ba de ni gso bar bya ba tsam yin la/ de nyams stobs dang ldan pa'i skyes bu de la gsar du btab pa yin na ni gso bla skeb yin no/ /rims dang brgyal las byung grang ba'i/ /sman kyis zhi ste rab mun can/ /zhes bya ba la/ dbugs mi bde ba mun pa can zhes bya ba de nyid gang gi tshe rims dang brgyal ba las byung bar gyur pa de'i tshe grang zhing bsil ba'i sman dang kha zas kyis de zhi zhing bsal bar gyur pa ⑨de'i tshe/ de la rab tu mun pa can zhes bya'o/ /dbugs chad dbugs 'byin rgyun chad pa'i/ /gnad ⑫gcod nad kyis gzir ⑪bar byed/ /rngul bcas brgyal dang sbos dang bcas/ /lgang ba tsha zhing gcin 'gags byed/ /mig mi sdug cing thur du blta/ /mig gcig dmar zhing dran pa stor/ /kha skam smre ⑫zhing skad gdangs ⑫dma'/ /gzi mdangs nyams shing ⑫sems bral ba'o—/ /zhes bya ba la/ dbugs rgyun chad pa zhes bya ba ni/ dbugs rgyun chad pa'i tshul gyis 'byin par byed kyi/ bar mi chad 4nyepar mi byed par mi 'byin zhing ⑫rngub pa ma yin pa ba/nga / gnad gcod pa'i tshul gyis gzir zhing ⑩nyam thag par byed pa dang / rngul dang bcas par brgyal zhing de gnyis ⑫dang ldan pa dang / stod smad du rlung rgyu ba 'gags pas sbos pa dang bcas pa dang /113—1061

beeng ba tsha zhing chu so'i phyogs lhag par tsha ba dang / gcin 'gags par byed pa dang / mig mi sdug cing gcig tu song na mi gnas par gyur par byed pa dang /thur du blta zhing sa la rtogs ①pa dang / mig gcig dmar bar snang ba dang /dran pa stor zhing sems shas cher mi gsal ba dang / kha skam ⑤pa dang / smre sngags kyi tshig tu smra ba dang / skad gdangs ①dma' zhing zhum pa dang / mdog dang gzi mdangs nyams shing yal ba dang / sems dang bral zhing dran pa med pa yin no/ /chen po nga ro cher 'byung zhing / /sgra cha sngur dupa drag pa dang / /bskyod pa bzhin du 'byung 'gyur zhing / /khyu mchog rgyags pa'i nga ro 'dra/ /shes dang rnam shes rab nyams shing / /mig ⑤'khrul bzhin ni gyur pa dang / /ro stod zhum par 'gyur ba ⑥dang / /bshang gci 'gags shing skad gdangs ⑦nyams—/ /mgul skam skeyang dang yang mi smra/ /rna ba mur 'gram klad pa khyan—/ /zhes bya ba la/ dbugs mi bde ba chen po zhes bya ba ⑩dbugs rgyu ba chen po 'byung zhing nga ro chen po dang ldan pas dbugs 'byung bar 'gyur zhing sgregs pa ⑪rab tu che ba dang / sngur pa drag po ⑫sna nas 'byin par spyobyed pa dang / bskyod cing 'gul ba bzhin du rngam pa drag par 'gyur zhing dbugs mi rtsom pa'i shugs g.yo ba dang bcas pa las byung ste/ khyu mchog rgyags pa lta bu'i dbugs rgyun tu 'byung ba dang / shes pa dang rnam par ④shes pa'i khyad par gang dag yod pa rab tu nyams par 'gyuraspyo/ shes pa bee khong du chud pa'o/ /rnam par shes pa ni khyad par gyi shes pa ste/ de dag kyang nyams pa'o/ /gzhan yang mig 'khrul ba dang / rang bzhin yongs su gyur cing mi sdug pa dang ldan pa dang / ro stod zhum zhing rnam par 'gyur ba dang ldan 113—1062

pas dbugs 'byin pa dang / de bzhin du bshang ba dang gci ba 'gags shing sri ba la sogs pa 'byung bar 'gyur ro①/ /gyen 'byung dbugs ni ring du 'byin—/ /slar ni thur du rngub mi nus/ /bad kan gyis kha rtsa sgo 'gags/ /rlung ni 'khrugs pas gzir 'gyur ba 3 / /gyen du blta rnguzhing 'khrul byed pas/ /mig ni kun tu lta byed pa/ /gnad khyernams chad par byed bzhin du/ /skad 'gags smre sngags 'don par byed/ /ces bya ba la/ gyen du 'byung ba ⑤zhes bya ba'i dbugs mi bde ba las/ dbugs ring ba gyen du ring du 'byin zhing dugatong la/ dbugs de phyung nas slar thur du rngub cing sdud par mi nus te/yang nang du sdud par mi nus zhes bya ba'i don no/ /yang de'i rnam pa ni bad kan gyis kha dang rtsa'i sgo rnams 'gags shing bar ma chod par byas pas rlung gi nad 'khrugs shing ldang bar 'gyur bas gzir zhing ⑦shas cher gnod par byas pa dang / mig gyen du blta zhing 'degs par byed la/ 'khrul zhing nor bar byas pas skephan tshun kun tu lta zhing rtogs ⑨par byed pa dang / de bzhin du gnad rnams chad par 'gyur ba bzhin du sdug bsngal zhing nyam thag pa'i smre sngags skad gsang ⑩'gags shing nang du 'dus par gyur pa'i tshul gyis smre sngags 'don par byed do/ /'di dag ma tshang gsor ⑪rung la/ /tshang na nges par srog 'phrog byed/ /ces bya ba la/ dbugs mi bde ba 'di dag thams cad kyang mtshan nyid 'di dag ma rdzogs na gsor rung zhing bcos su ⑫'dod pa yin la/gal te 'di dag ⑫rang rang gi mtshan nyid rdzogs shing tshang ba yin na ni nges par gdon mi za bar srog 'phrog cing 'tsho ba gcod par 'gyur ba yin no/ /dbugs mi bde rgyu sngon tshul dang / /grangs dang rang bzhin rten gcig ⑫yin/ /113—1063

zhes bya ba la/ de la skyigs bu'i nad ni dbugs mi bde ba dang / rgyu la sogs pa'i nad gcig yin te/ 'dir gcig ces bya ba ni mtshungs pa'i ming gi rnam grangs te/ des na skyigs bu dang dbugs mi bde ba ni rgyu la sogs pa tshul 'dra bar gyur pa yin no/ /de yang lud pa'i rgyu ni lud pa 'phel ba'am zhes bya ba la sogs pa yin no/ /sngar 'byung ba'i tshul ni snying rtsib logs zhes bya ba la sogs pa yin no/ /de ltar na de dag thams cad tshul gcig cing 'dra ba yin pas zhes bya ba'okhye/ /skyigs bu zas rngu byung phran tshegs dang / /zung dang chen por 'byung ba dang / /za ba dag dang rnam pa lnga/ /zhes bya ba la/ skyigs bu zas las byung ba la sogs pa'i dbye bas ming rnam pa lnga yin no/ /de la rlung gis ring ①zos dang / /rtsub tsha sra dang ma goms ④pa'i/ /zas dang skom gyis btsir ⑤gyur pa'i/ /rlung gis skyigs bu nad med dang / /sgra mi drag cing sprud 'byung ste/ /zhes bya ba la/ de la skyigs bu ni rlung gis bskyed par 'gyur la/de yang kha zas ring dubag tu zos pa dang / de bzhin du ⑦rtsub pa dang / tsha ba dang sra ba'i bag zas zos pa dang / sngon chad ma goms shing ma bsten pa'i zas skom zos shing 'thungs pas btsir zhing skebasdams par gyur pa'i rlung gis ⑨skyigs bu'i rnam pa nad med cing sdug bsngal ba'i tshor ba med pa sgra mi drag pa'i rjes la dzred pa 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i ⑩skyigs bus 'debs par 'gyur te/ de ni zas las byung ba zhes bya'o/ /gang zhig goms pa'i zas skom gyis/ /zhi 'gyur skyigs bu zas byung yin/ /zhes bya ba la/ yang skyigs bu gang sngar goms shing bsten pa'i zas dang skom gang yang rung ba btang bas zhi zhing chad par 'gyur ba'i skyigs bu de ni zas las byung zhes bya'o/ /drag shul kyis ⑪rlung 113—1064

cung zad bskyod/ /skyigs bu phra mo 'byung bar 'gyur/ /nam tshong rtsa nas 'byung byed cing / /de ni shugs dal 'jam pa yin/ /rtsol ba drag po 'phel 'gyur la/ /zas zos tsam gyis dal bar 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba la/ drag stishul gyi rtsol bas rlung cung zad cig khyebaskyod de skyigs bu phra mo 'byung bar 'gyur la—/ de yang nam tshong gi rtsa ba nas 'byung zhing ldang bar ④'gyur la/ de ltar chung du bskyod pa las phran tshegs 'byung ba'i phyir skyigs bu de'i shugs ⑤dal zhing tshabs chung la dal duzhing shas cher na bar mi byed pa yin no/ /de yang rtsol ba drag po'i shugs bsten pas ni 'phel bar 'gyur la/ kha zas gang yang rung ba zos pa tsam gyis ni de'i mod kho na la rgyu ba dal zhing shugs bul bar 'gyur ro/ /zung 'byung ⑦tshigs ni ring ba la/ /gang zhig zas las ( 'byung 'gyur ba/ /'ju bar nye ba'i tshe na 'debs/ /zas zhu zin nas 'phel 'gyur ba'o—/ /mgo dang mgul pa 'dar byed cing / /sbo dang ⑨shin tu skom dad skyed⑩—/ /bla dang slon dang tshad par 'khru/ /mig gdangs glal ni 'byung bar 'gyur—/ /skyigs bu zung 'byung shugs drag pa/ /gzhung ⑪dang bcas par de shes bya/ /zhes bya ba la/ skyigs bu zung du 'byung ba zhes bya ba ni/ tshigs ring pos chod pa gang shugs gnyis gnyis bstud ⑫mar 'byung ba yin la/ de yang kha zas 'ju ba ⑫dang nye zhing smin pa la phyogs pa'i tshe 'byung bar 'gyur la/zas zhu zin nas ni 'phel bar 'gyur ba yin no/ /gzhan yang skyigs ⑫bus btab pa'i skyes bu'i mgo dang mgul pa 'dar zhing skyod (9par byed pa dang /lto sbo ba dang / skom dad shin tu skye zhing skom gyis gdungs pa dang / glal ba ⑩la sogs pa dang ldan par 'gyur la/ skyigs bu zung du byung ba zhes bya ba de ni 113—1065

shugs ①drag pa dang zhu ba'i tshe na 'byung bas na zhu ba dang bcas pa zhes bya bar nges so/ /skyigs bu chen po 'byung ba'i tshul/ /smin ma mur 'gram gnyis rengs shing / /mig nas mchi 'dzag har bar blta/ /lus rengs tshig ni thogs byed cing / /dran dang 'du shes 'khrul bar byed/ /med pa'am sbubs ni 'gags ④byed cing / /gnad kyi tshogs ni skyod ④par byed/ /rgyab sgu ④lus ni khong skem byed/ /rtsa ba che zhing sgra che la/ /nad tshabs che zhing stobs cher 'byung / /zhes bya ba la/ skyigs bu chen po zhes bya ba 'byung ba'i tshul ni smin ma dang mur 'gram gnyis rengs pa la sogs pa dang ldan pa ⑤'byung bar 'gyur te/ smin ma gnyis dang mur 'gram gnyis na zhing bskyod mi shes pa la sogs pa dang ldan pa dang / lus rengs shing bskyod mi shes par byed pa dang /de bzhin du tshig thogs shing lkugs par byed pa dang / dran pa dang 'du shes te dngos po ma brjed pa dang / sems 'khrugs shing ⑦nyams par byed pa dang /de bzhin du zas rgyu ba'i lam med par 'gags pa ⑦dang / snying la sogs pa'i gnad ⑦ kyi tshogs bskyod cing g.yo bar byed pa dang / rgyab sgu zhing 'khyog ⑨pa dang / lus kyi khong skem ⑩par byed pa yin la/ de ni rtsa ba che zhing rgyun ring ba dang / sgra cher 'byung ba dang / nad tshabs che zhing shugs drag pa dang /stobs dang nus pa chen por 'byung ba yin pas na de ni chen po zhes bya'o/ /zhu ba'i gnas sam lte 'og ⑪nas/ /snga ma 'dra bar gang zhig ⑫'byung / /de 'dra'i tshul ni bstud mar 'byung / /glal dang rkang lag bya rmyang ⑫byed/ /brag ca zab 'byung zab mo 'ospyo/ /zhes bya ba la/ skyigs bu zab mo zhes bya ba ni zhu ba'i gnas mkhris pa'i gnas sam/ lte ba'i 'og nas 'byung bar byed la/ de 113—1066

yang 'byung zhing rgyu ba'i tshul ni skyigs bu chen po'i stimatshan nyid ji skad bshad pa dang tshul 'dra bar 'byung zhing / smin ma mur 'gram gnyis rengs shing / /rgyab sgu las ni khong skem byed/ /ces labya ba'i bar gyi mtshan nyid dang ldan par 'gyur la/ de las ①kyang khyad par du de bstud mar 'byung zhing glal ④ba dang /bya rmyang ⑤byed cing rkang lag skyod par byed pa dang / brag ca'i dusgra zab tu 'byung bar byed pas na 'di'i ming ni zab mo ④zhes bya'o/ /de rnams las ni dang po yi/ /gnyis po gso bar bya ba yin/ /zhes bya ba la/ skyigs bu lnga po de rnams las zas las byung ba dang / phran tshegs zhes bya ba'i skyigs bu gnyis ni gso sla ba yin pas gso bar bya la/ tha ma ⑧gnyis dang zung 'byung ba⑨/ /mtshan nyid kun rdzogs shugs drag spyospang / / zhes bya ba la/⑪ tha ma'i skyigs bu gnyis po dang / skyigs bu chen po dang / skyigs bu zab mo bya ba gnyis ni spang bar bya ⑫la/ de bzhin du ⑫zung du 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i skyigs bu rang gi mtshan nyid dam rtags kun rdzogs shing ma lus pa dang ldan la/ shugs drag ④pa ni spang bar bya ste gsor mi rung ngo / /'di dag thams cad yun ⑫ring bsags—/ /rgan po bud med kyis dub dang / /nad kyis nyam chung zas bcad pa/ /glo rdol nad can spang bar bya/ /zhes bya ba la/ skyigs bu 'di dag thams cad yun ring du bsags shing rgyun ring po ⑩gnas pa dang / mi rgan po dang / bud med la nyal po drags pas dub pa dang / nad kyis lus kyi nyams ⑫dmad cing stobs zad ⑫pa dang / de bzhin du zas bcad cing sgyung ba byas pa dang / glo rdol ba'i nad dang ldan pa la skyigs bus btab pa ⑪spang bar bya ste gsor 3mi rung ngo / /nad kun kyis 'chi byed mod kyi/ /skyigs bu 113—1067

dbugs mi bde ba ltar/ /nad gzhan myur du gsod ①mi byed/ /'di dag 'chi tshe nges 'byung 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba la/ nad pa de lta bu dag ni skyigs bu dang dbugs mi bde ba 'ba' zhig tu ma zad kyi/ rims la sogs pa nad thams cad kyis kyang 'chi bar ④byed mod kyi/ nad de dag las 'di gnyis kyi khyad par ni 'di yin te/ skyigs bu dang dbugs mi bde ba gnyis kyis myur du gsod par byed pa de ltar nad kyi dngos po gzhan gyis myur du gsod cing 'chi bar mi byed de/ gang gi phyir 'di gnyis ni 'chi zhing srog dang bral ba'i tshe nges par gdon mi za bar 'byung bar 'gyur ba yin no/ /tshig 'di dag gis ni de gnyis myur du gso dgos par ④bstan pa yin no/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa'i rnam par 'grel pa tshig gi dhidon gyi zla zer zhes bya ba/ slob dpon zla ba la dga' bas rnam par sbyar ba las/ nad gzhi'i gnas kyi le'u bzhi pa'i rnam par 'grel pa'o// //de nas glo gcong chen po zad byed kyi nad gzhi ⑤bshad par bya'o/ /zhes bya ba la/ lud pa btang snyoms su bzhag cing ma bcos na dbugs mi bde ba dang zad byed 'byung bar 'gyur ro zhes bshad pas na/ de'i phyir de'i 'og tu 'di brtsams pa yin no⑥/ /glo gcong chen po zad byed ⑦ces bya ba ni ming gi rnam grangs so/ /nad ni du ma rjes 'brang zhing / /nad mang sngon ⑤du 'gro bar 'gyur/ /rgyal po zad byed skem byed dang / /nad kyi rgyal po zhes kyang bshad—/ /ces bya ba la/ zad byed kyi 0rjes su nad du ma mang po zhig 'brang zhing rgyu bar byed la/ de bzhin du nad mang po sngon du 'gro zhing thog mar rgyu 113—1068

bas ①nad de ni nad kyi rgyal po zhes bya zhing ming gi rnam grangs bzhi po gnod pa'i rgyal po dang / zad byed dang / skem byed dang / nad kyi rgyal po zhes bya bar bshad pa yin no/ /rgyu skar rnams dang bram ze yi/ /rgyal po'i gcong du ⑤sngon gyur cing / /gang yang nad kyi rgyal por 'gyur1/ /de phyir gnod pa'i rgyal por bshad/ /ces bya ba la/ snar ma la sogs pa'i rgyu skar rnams dang / bram ze rnams kyi rjorgyal po ni zla ba yin la/ de yang sngon bskal pa dang po'i tshe/ zla ba snar ma la mchog tu chags ⑤pas gcong chen po'i nad byung bar gyur la/ de bas na nad 'di la nad kyi rgyal po zhes bya'o/ /des ni rgyal po'i nad yin pas nad kyi rgyal po zhes drug pa'i mtshams sbyar bas bsgrub pa'am/yang na zad byed kyi nad kyang yin la/ rgyal po yang yin pas nad kyi rgyal po ste/nad rnams kyi nang na gnas shing rims la sogs pa'i nad rjodu mas yongs su bskor ladzee/ bshad ma thag pa'i tshul du nad du ma rjes su 'brang zhing / nad mang po sngon du 'gro bas gcong chen po la gnod pa'i rgyal po zhes bya'o zhes mngon par shes pa dang ldan pa'i drang srong rnams kyis bshad pa yin no/ /lus dang sman ni zad byed cing / / zad las ⑤'byung bas zad byed yin/ /zhes bya ba la—/ lus dang sman gyi dngos po gnyis zad pa ni med par byed pa ste/ de bas na lus dang sman zad par byed pa'i nad 'di la zad byed ces bya ste/ gang gi phyir nad 'di skyes par gyur na/ lus zad ⑨cing 'ju bar 'gyur ba dang /sman mang po yang zad cing gtugs par byed pas na/ nad 'di la zad byed ces bya'o/ /yang na zad pa las byung bas na zad byed de/ lus zungs rnams zad pa'i rgyu las byung bas na ming zad byed ces bya ba'o/ /dwangs sogs 113—1069

skems pas skem stibyed yin/ /de rnams de las gsal bas rgyal/ /zhes bya ba la/dwangs ma la sogs pa'i lus zungs bdun po skem zhing rengs ④par byed pas na/de la skem ①byed ces bya'o/ /yang nad de rnams kyi nang na rags shing gsal la nus pa che bas na nad kyi rgyal po zhes bya'o/ /drag shul bsten dang shugs bkag dang / /khu chu dwangs ma snum zad dang / /zas ⑦skom cho ga dang bral bsten/ /bzhi po 'di dag de yi spyorgyu/ /zhes bya ba la/ gcong chen po'i rgyu ni ma spyogs bzhin du drag shul kyi las byed pa la sogs pa bsten drags pa las 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de la drag shul gyi stobs 'gyed pa la sogs pa'i las nyams kyis spyogs par dka' ba bsten zhing du/ lus dang ngag dang yid la gnod par 'gyur ba'i rtsol ba drag po byed pa'o/ /shugs bkag pa ni ngo tsha la sogs pa'i rgyus bshang ba dang gci ba dang 'phyen ⑦ la sogs pa bkag cing bsdams pa'o/ /khu chu la sogs pa zad pa ni rang gi rgyu las byung ba zad cing dengs par byed pa'o//zas dang skom gnyis kyi cho ga dang bral bar bsten pa ni sman dpyad kyi ⑧bstan bcos dang mi mthun par bsten zhing ⑨/ de'i cho ga dang mi mthun par byas nas mi 'phrod ⑩pa za ba'o/ /de yis rlung dang mkhris pa dang / /bad kan babeengs ⑪nas thams cad du/ /lus kyi tshigs kun la zhugs te/ /de yis rtsa sgo la gnod cing / /bu ga'i sgo ni bkag pa 'am/ /yang na shin tu kha bye 'gyur⑫/ /stod smad thad kar gnas nas ni/ /rang gi nad ni ji bzhin skyed/ /ces bya ba la/ drag shul la sogs pa de ⑫dag gis rlung babeeng zhing 'khrugs par byas pas nalhoste/ rgyas shing 'phel bar byas ⑫pa dang / mkhris pa babeengs ⑪nas rang gi gnas las gyen du 'pho zhing rgyas par byed pa dang / de bzhin du bad 113—1070

kan bslangs stinas stod smad dang rtsib logs ⑤la sogs pa thams cad du khyab cing lus kyi tshigs kun gyi nang du zhugs te/ tshigs ①dag la gnod cing rab tu na bar byed pa dang / yang de bzhin du des lus thams cad ④khyab pa'i rtsa sgo la yang gnod cing bcom pa dang / de bzhin du bu ga rnams kyi rjo'abyung zhing rgyu ⑥ ba'i sgo bkag nas gnas par 'gyur ba'am/ yang lan 'ga' rtsa'i sgo'am⑦/kha bye zhing rgyas par byas nas lan 'ga' ni stod du 'gro/ /lan 'ga' ni ro smad dam rtsib logs su thad kar song nas rang rang gi nad ji lta ba bzhin du bskyod de stod du rgyu na ni ro stod kyi nad skyed par byed la/ smad du rgyu na ni ro smad kyi nad skyed par byed/ thad kar 'gro na ni rtsib logs kyi nad skyed par byed do/ /de 'byung 'gyur ba'i sngon tshul ni/ /cham 'debs dzred pa shin tu mang / /mchil ma kha nas ⑧ro mngar bro/ /lus dang me drod nyam chung byed/ /gzhong snod zas ⑨skom la sogs ni/ /gtsang yang mi gtsang nyid du mthong / /phal cher zas dang skom stsogs la⑩/ /sbrang ma rtsa dang skra sogs 'bab/ /snying 'phar slon bro ⑪yi ga 'chus/ /kha zas zos kyang nyams stobs zad/ /lag par lta zhing rkang ⑫gdong skrang / /mig ni shin tu dkar por snang / /lag ngar dag ni 'jal bar 'dod/ /lus la 'jigs su rung bar mthong / /bud med chang dang sha la dga'/ /smod ⑫dang klad pa 'gebs ④par byed/ /skra dang sen mo shin tu 'phel/ /rmi lam du ni phye ma leb/ / rtsangs pa spyosdig sbrul gcan gzan ⑩spre'u/ /bya rnams kyis ni gtses par mthong / /skra rus phub ma thal sogs kyi⑫/ /phung po la ni snye'adzeg pa dang / /yul dang grong ni stong pa dang / /chu klung skam par spyormi lam mthong / /skar mda' buri bo thong 113—1071

ba dang / /ljon shing rnams ni 'bar ①ba rmi/ /zhes bya ba la/ gcong chen po zhes bya ba'i nad de ⑤'byung bar 'gyur zhing / skye bzhin pa'i ①tshul sngar byung ba'i rtags ni cham pa la sogs pa yin te/ cham pa ni sna nas 'dzag pa'i nad des 'debs so/ /dzred pa shin tu mang ba ④ni sprid pa drag tu 'byung zhing mang ba'o/ /mchil ma mang ba ni bad kan gyi ljan ljin kha nas mang du 'ong ba'o//kha'i nang ro mngar bar bro ba ni ⑤mngar ba nyid yin no/ /lus dang me drod nyam chung ba ni lus khong rmya zhing zhum pa dang / zas 'ju bar byed mi nus pa'o/gzhong pa dang snod phra mo la sogs pa gtsang ba yang mi gtsang ba nyid du mthong ba ni de'i tshe log dupa'i shes pa skye zhing 'khrul ba 'byung bar 'gyur ba'o/ /yang phal cher zas ⑦skom la sogs par dusbrang ma la sogs pa ltung ⑨zhing 'bab par 'gyur ba dang / snying 'phar zhing rgal ⑩pa la sogs pa dang / lag pa gnyis la yang dang yang du lta zhing rtogs ⑪par 'gyur ba dang / rgyu med par rkang pa dang gdong skrang bar 'gyur ba dang / de bzhin du mig gnyis shin tu dkar zhing skya bar 'gyur ba dang / de bzhin du lag ngar gnyis 'jal bar 'dod cing nga'i lag ngar tshad ji tsam du song zhes shes par 'dod cing 'jal ba dang /rang gi lus mdzes shing skyon med la 'jigs pa'i bag med par gyur pa la yang mi sdug cing 'jigs su rung bar mthong ba'i log pa'i shes pa skye bar 'gyur ba dang /bud med dang chang dang sha la dga' zhing mngon par 'dod pa bskyed pa dang /yang de dag nyid la smod par yang ⑩byed pa dang / klad pa ste spyi bo gos kyis 'gebs par byed pa dang / skra dang sen mo rnams shin tu 'phel zhing ring bar 'gyur ba dang / rmi lam gyi nang du phye ma leb la sogs pas gtses shing mnan 113—1072

par mthong ba dang / de bzhin du skra la sogs pa'i phung po la 'dzeg par rmi ba dang / yul dang grong stong zhing skye bo ①mi gnas pa rmi lam du mthong ba dang /chu ⑤rnams skams shing krog po stong pa rmi lam du mthong ba dang / skar mda' ltung ba dang ①/ ri bo beeng zhing bsnyil ba rmi ba ④dang / ljon shing bzang ba rnams las skyes pa de dag 'bar zhing me'i phung por 'gyur ba rmi ba ste/ mtshan ma de dag 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /stod kyedu gnas na cham ⑥pas 'debs/ /lud pa lu zhing dbugs mi bde/ /phrag pa spyi bo na ba dang / /skad 'gags yi ga 'chus dzeepar 'gyur/ /smad gnas bshang sla rtug skam byed/ /nang grol nang gnas slon par byed/ /thad kar gnas pas rtsib logs zug /tshigs la gnas na ⑧rims su 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba la/ gcong chen po'i nad ro stod du gnas na cham ⑨pas 'debs pa la sogs pa nad bdun skyed par 'gyur ro/ /nad de ro smad du song bas ni bshang ba sla ba'am rtug skam du 'gyur te/ rtug pa bee ba ni zhig cing ⑨ 'khru bar 'gyur ba'o/ /skam pa ni sra zhing 'gags te 'khren ⑪par 'gyur ba ste/ de las lan 'ga' ni sla bar 'gyur la/ lan 'ga' ni ska bar 'gyur gyi/ de gnyis cha mnyam par mi 'gyur ro/ /nad de nang grol skegyi nang na gnas pa ni slon zhing 'dor spyobar byed do/ /thad kar gnas pa'i nad kyis ni rtsib logs su zug cing na bar 'gyur ro/ /nad de ni tshigs la gnas pas ni rims skyed par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar nad tshul bcu gcig ni/ /gcong chen ldan las (ste'abyung bar 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba la/gcong chen po'i nad de dang ldan pa ⑫la cham pa la sogs pa nad bcu gcig pa 'byung zhing skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de la rtsa sbubs rnams bkag pa las ni skams 113—1073

par 'gyur ba yin la/ de rnams kha bye ba las ni rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /des na grangs kyis 'di gnyis gang yang rung ba gcig gis bzung ①gi/ gnyi ga dus gcig tu 'byung ba ni mi srid do/ /de rnams kyi grangs ni cham pa dang /lud pa dang / dbugs mi bde ba dang / phrag pa na ba dang / spyi bo na ba dang / skad 'gags pa dang / yi ga 'chus pa dang / bshang ba sla ba dang /rtug pa skam pa ⑤dang / slon pa dang / rtsib logs zug pa dang / rims te bcu gcig po 'di dag ni zad byed kyi nad yin no/ /de rnams kyi ni bla brnan ①dag /skad 'gags brang du na ba dang / /kha glal lus grugs mchil snabs mang / /drod nyams kha mnam yin zhes bya/ /zhes bya ba la cham pa la sogs pa de rnams kyi bla brnan ④ rgo skad 'gags pa la sogs pa bdun yin par shes par bya/ nad snga na gnas pa'i steng du nad phyi ma byung nas sdug bsngal dang rjes su 'brel par byed pa ni bla brnan ⑤zhes bya'o/ / de la rlung rjogyur klad pa dang / /rtsib logs zug sha yan lag na/ /skad 'gags mgul pa subs par 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba la/ de la rlung gi ⑦shas che ba las gyur pa'i gcong chen po ni/ klad pa na ba la sogs pa'i mtshan ma 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /mkhris rgyas rkang lag phrag 5pa tsha/ /tshad 'khru khyakhrag tu slon pa dang / /kha mnam rims ⑩'debs myos par 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba la/ de la mkhris pa ⑩shas che ba las byung ba'i gcong chen po ni/ rkang pa dang lag pa dang / phrag pa tsha ba la sogs pa'i nad kyi ⑫mtshan ma 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /bad kan las gyur yi ga 'chus/ /slon lud lus dang yan lag lci/ /mchil snabs mang zhing cham pas 'debs/ /dbugs mi bde skad 'gags drod nyams/ /zhes bya ba 113—1074

la—/ bad kan rgyas pa las gyur pa'i gcong chen po'i nad ni yi ga 'chus pa la sogs pa 'byung ①bar 'gyur ro/ /nad kyis me drod nyam chung bas④/ /'byar bcas ④bad kan rgyas gyur nas/ /rtsa spubs sgo ni 'gags pa dang / /lus zungs drod ni chung gyur pas/ /dwangs ma rang gi gnas su ni/ /ma zhu bla brnan dude dang de/ /skyed cing sha sogs mi 'gyur la/ /khrag ni gyen du 'byung bar byed/ /ces bya ba la/ rlung la sogs pa'i nad me drod duchung zhing nus pa bri ba la sogs pa'i rgyus 'byar bag dang bcas pa'i bad kan rgyas par 'gyur la/rtsa sbubs kyi busgo rnams 'gags shing bkag par gyur pa dang / de bzhin du lus zungs kyi drod nyam chung bar ⑦gyur pas dwangs ma rang gi gnas su legs par ma zhu zhing smin par nus pa'i dwangs ma de las bla brnan dzeeskad 'gags pa dang / brang du na ba la sogs pa rang gi rgyu las byung ba de dang de skyed cing 'byung bar 'gyur la/ des na sha la sogs pa'i lus zungs su mi 'gyur ba dang /de bzhin du khrag gyen du 'byung zhing mchil ma la sogs pa dang lhan cig 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /khong pa nyid du zas 'ju bas/ /dwangs mar 'gyur bar mi byed cing ⑫/ /phal cher dri ma nyid 'gyur gyi⑩/ /lus zungs 'phel bar mi byed do/ /zhes bya ba la/ gang gi phyir gcong chen po'i nad 'di yod pa la/khong pa'i drod kyis ⑪kha zas 'ju bar byed kyi/ me drod gzhan gyis dwangs ma la sogs pa'i rim pa ⑫smin par mi byed do/ /de'i phyir 'phral du dri ma bshang gci nyid du 'gyur bas zungs rnams 'phel shing ⑫rgyas par mi byed de/ dwangs ma'i bcud lus kyang brtas ⑫shing tshim par mi byed do zhes bya ba'i don no/ /dwangs ma ⑫khrag tu mi 'gyur na/ /shar 'gyur ba lta smos ci dgos/ /zad ⑩byed can 113—1075

ni bshang 'phel ba/ /'ba' zhig gis ni gnas par byed/ /ces bya ba la/gcong chen ①gyi skyes bu de'i lus zungs dwangs ma zhes bya ba gang yin pa de yang khrag tu mi 'gyur na/ sha'i lus zungs rgyas pa lta smos kyang ci dgos te/ zad byed dang ldan pa'i skyes bu bshang ba 'ba' zhig nye bar 'phel bas gnas par 'gyur gyi/ dwangs mas khrag la sogs pa sde'aphel bar mi 'gyur ro zhes 'ba' zhig gi sgra ①nges par bzung ba ④yin no/ /mtshan ma chung yang nyam rjochung zhing //nad kyis sman gyi stobs mi bzod/ / spang bya/⑥ ces bya ba la cham pa la sogs pa'i mtshan ma rnams dang / de bzhin du snying ga dang rtsib logs gzer ba la sogs pa'i nad kyi mtshan ma chung du zin kyang / mi mnyam stobs chung zhing nad kyis sman gyi stobs bsten par mi bzod pa gang yin pa de ni spang bar bya ste gsor mi rung ngo / /de las gzhan pa ni/ /thams cad ldan yang gso bar bya//zhes bya ba la/ de las gzhan pa'i nad kyis nyams kyi ⑦stobs bzod cing /nyams stobs dang ldan pa ni mtshan ma thams cad dang ldan pa yin yang gsor rung ba yin pas nad pa nyams stobs dang ldan pa ni rnam pa thams cad du gso bar bya'o/ /de yan chad du grugacong chen po'i nad ⑨bshad zin nas/ de nas shā7 de'i 'og tu de'i yan lag tu gyur pa skad 'gags pa la sogs pa'i nad ston pa'i phyir smras pa ni/ nad ni sna re 'dus pa dang / /zad byed tshil las gyur pa drug /skad 'gags kyi ni dbye ba yin/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa yin te—/ nad sna re re ⑪zhes pa rlung dang mkhris pa dang bad kan dang ⑫so so las gyur pa gsum dang / gsum car ⑫'dus pa las gyur te bzhi pa dang / zad byed las gyur pa dang / tshil las gyur pa ste/ drug po de dag ni skad 113—1076

'gags pa'i dbye ba yin par shes par bya'o/ /de las ①rlung g.yo nyam chung rtsub—/ /gre ba gra mas gang snyam byed/ /de la snum dro 'o mas ②phan/ /zhes bya ba la/ de la skad 'gags pa drug gi nang nas rlung las gyur pa'i skad 'gags pa ni g.yo zhing skad 'gyur te mi brtan pa dang / lus nyam chung zhing khong rmya ba dang / rtsub bag tu gnas pa dang / gre ba nas kyi gra mas gang ba snyam du byed cing na ba yin la/ de la snum bag dang / dro ba dang / 'o mas phan ①pa yin no/ /mkhris pa las gyur rkan lkog tsha/ /skam zhing smra bar mi nus rjo'agyur/ /zhes bya ba la/ mkhris pa las gyur pa'i skad 'gags pa ni/rkan dang lkog ma'i phyogs su tsha bar 'gyur ba de dag nyid skam pa dang / smra bar mi nus shing tshig mi thon pa yin no/ /bad kan mgul pa byugs snyam byed/ /skad kyi gsang dma' ngar ngar 'dzer/ /thogs bcas 'gyur ro thams cad kyi/ /mtshan ma thams cad ldan pa yin/ /zhes bya ba la⑤/ de yang sgra ngar ngar por 'don zhing du'adzer ba dang / thogs pa dang bcas pa ste/ bar bar du 'khrul zhing brjed par 'gyur ba yin no/ /thams cad kyi zhes nad gzhi gsum po thams cad las byung ba'i skad 'gags pa ni mtshan ma gsum po thams cad dang ldan pa yin no/ / zad byed stilas ni drud snyam byed/ /du bas bdugs ltar shin tu na/ /zhes bya ba la/ zad byed ces te gcong chen po las byung ba'i skad 'gags pa ni shog ma drud pa snyam du sems shing na ba dang / skog ma dang rkan gyi phyogs du bas bdugar/ pa ltar shin tu na ba dang smra ba na ⑧yang du bas subs te smra ba snyam du sems par 'gyur ro/ /tshil gyur bad kan bdag nyid can/ /tshig gi ⑨brda sprod mi nus 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba la/ tshil las 113—1077

gyur pa'i skad 'gags pa ni mgul pa byugs pa snyam du byed pa la sogs pa ①bad kan gyi skabs su bshad pa dang mtshan nyid 'dra ba yin no/ /yang de bzhin du tshig brda sprod par mi nus shing shin tu mi gsal bar smra ba yin no/ /'dir ni ②'dus dang tha mar ①spang / /zhes bya ba la/ 'dir skad 'gags pa 'di dag gi nang nas nad gzhi thams cad 'dus pa las gyur pa dang / tshil las gyur pa'i skad 'gags pa ni gsor mi rung bas spang bar bya'o/ /yi ga 'chus pa'i nad rnams ni/ /lce snying gnas pa so so dang / /'dus pa dang ni yid kyi ni/ /gdung ba las gyur lnga pa yin/ /zhes bya ba la/ yi ga 'chus pa'i nad ni rlung la sogs pa'i nad lce dang snying ga las gnas pa so so ste/ gsum po so so las gsum du 'gyur la/ 'dus pa'i nad lce dang snying la gnas pa las bzhi par 'gyur ro/ /yid kyi gdung ba mya ngan dang khro ba la sogs pa rnam pa du ma gsungs pa las yi ga 'chus ④pa lnga par 'gyur ro/ /kha ni bska dang kha mngar bro//rlung ⑤sogs gsum dang rim bubazhin sbyar/ /zhes bya ba la/ rlung la sogs pa las yi ga 'chus pa las gyur pa'i mtshan ma ni rim ④bzhin kha bska ba la sogs par 'gyur te/ rlung las gyur pas ni kha bska bar 'gyur ro/ /mkhris pa las gyur pas ni kha kha bar 'gyur ro/ /bad kan las gyur pas ⑧ni kha mngar bar 'gyur ro/ /kun las gyur pa ro bro med/ /ces gubya ba la/ nad gzhi thams cad 'dus pa las gyur pa'i yi ga 'chus pa ni ro bro ba med pa ste/ dri nga ba yod med kyi nges pa ⑩'di ltar bro zhes bya bar spyobarda sprod mi nus so/ /mya ngan khro sogs nad ji ⑫bzhin/ /zhes bya ba la/ mya ngan dang khro ba la sogs pa las gyur pa'i yi ga 'chus pa la ⑫ni nad ji lta ba nyid las mi 'da' ba yin te/ ro ④113—1078

bska ba la sogs pa gang yang rung ba dang ldan pa yin no/ /de la mya ngan dang 'jigs pas gdung ba'i ①yid las ni rlung 'khrugs par 'gyur zhing ①bska ba yin no/ /khro ba las gyur pas ①mkhris pa skyed par 'gyur ba yin pas kha ba yin no/ /'dod pas gdung ba las ④ni bad kan 'khrugs pas mngar ba bro ba yin no/ /slon bro nad gzhi sna ⑤re kun/ /mi sdug yul las byung lnga pa/ /zhes bya ba la/ slon bro ba ni rnam pa lnga ste/ nad gzhi gsum sna dure las byung ba gsum dang / kun 'dus pa las byung ba gcig dang / mi sdug pa'i don nam yul yid du mi 'ong ba'i yul lam don gzugs ④dang sgra dang dri dang ro dang reg bya rnams las byung ba ni lnga pa yin no/ /'di dag stod du rgyu ba'i rlung / /'khrugs pas nad ni thams cad phul/ /zhes bya ba la/ yi ga 'chus ⑧pa 'di dag ni stod du rgyu ba zhes bya ba'i rlung 'khrugs shing rang gi tha mal pa'i rang bzhin las ⑨gzhan du gyur pa des bad kan dang mkhris pa la sogs pa'i nad thams cad gyen du slong zhing ⑩stod du phul bas nam tshong yan chad nas kha'i bar du khyab par byed pa yin no/ /de rnams bslongs na ⑪kha tsha bro/ /mchil ⑫mang yi ga 'chus sngon byung / /zhes bya ba la/ slon bro ba de rnams la ni nad slong zhing bslongs ⑫nas kha tsha bro ba la sogs pa sngar byung ba yin pas na/ sngon byung ba ste 'di dag ni nad kyi sngar byung ba'i tshul yin no zhes bya ba'i don yin no//rlung gyur ⑫lte ba rgyab tu zug /rtsib logs na zhing zas slon nas/ /cung zad 'byung zhing chad pa dang / /ro bska lbu ⑩ba can du sgyug /sgregs pa'i sgra bcas mdog gnag la/ /sla zhing 'byung dka' sgra dang bcas/ /lud pa kha skam ⑩klad snying na/ /skad 'gags pa dang khong snyom bcas/ /zhes bya ba la/ rlung 113—1079

las gyur pa'i slon bro ba ni lte ba dang rgyab kyi phyogs na zhing zug pa dang / rtsib logs gzer ba dang / skyug ①pa kha zas gyen du 'byung ba dang / de'i 'og tu cung zad 'byung zhing bar bar du chad pa'i tshul gyis ro bska ba'i rnam pa las lbu stib can skyug par 'gyur ro/ /sgregs pa sgra dang bcas par 'byung ba dang /kha dog gnag pa dang / sla zhing dwangs par 'byung ba dang / 'byung bar dka' zhing sgra dang bcas par 'byung ba dang / de bzhin du lud pa la sogs pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro/ /mkhris gyur thal chu ga'adra ba la/ /dud kha ljang sngon mdog ser skyugarjo /khrag bcas ro sgyur tsha zhing dro/ /skom dad brgyal 0tsha gdung bcas yin/ /zhes bya ba la/ mkhris pa las gyur pa'i slon bro ba ni thal chu dang 'dra ⑥bar 'byung zhing kha dog dud khar gnas pa'am/ du ba ltar tsha zhing dku ba'i sgregs pa dang bcas pa kha dog ljang khu ⑦dang sngon po dang ser po dhiskyug cing khrag dang bcas par 'byung la/ ro ni skyur ba dang tsha ba dang ldan zhing dro ba'i bag tu slon la skom pa la sogs pa dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /bad kan las gyur snum pa ⑨bsil/ /nal nal por 'dug dra ba ris/ /ro mngar lan tshwa bro tshabs che/ /chags shing ba spu brtse bar byed/ /gdong skrang ⑩kha nang mngar ba ⑪bro/ /snyom zhing snying na lud pa can/ /zhes bya ba la/ bad kan las gyur pa'i slon bro ba ni snum bag tu slon zhing skrang ba dang / bad kan gyi rgyun nal nal por 'dzag pa dang / skyug ⑫pa dra ba ris sam skar khung gi tshul du gnas pa dang / ro mngar zhing lan tshwa bro ba dang / tshabs ⑫che zhing mang du 'byung ba dang / gre bar chags shing 'byar ba dang / ba spu pags pa brtse zhing reg mi bzod pa dang / gdong skrang ba la sogs ⑫pa dang ldan pa yin no/ /113—1080

gsum char las byung rtags kun ldan/ /'chi ltas las bshad gang de spang / /zhes bya ba la/ rlung la sogs pa'i nad gzhi gsum char las byung ba ni mtshan nyid thams cad dang ldan pa ste/ de ni gsor mi rung bas spang bar bya'o/ /yang 'chi ltas kyi skabs su bshad pa'i slon bro ba'i nad shugs drag ①pa dang /bshang gci bro ba la sogs pa de yang spang bar bya ste gsor mi rung ngo / /rul ⑤dang mi gtsang btsog pa dang / /skyug bro mthong dang thos sogs kyis/ /yid gdungs snying la phog gyur slon/ /mi sdug yul snelas byung ba yin/ /zhes bya ba la—/ rul pa la sogs pa'i dngos po mthong ba dang thos pa dang mnam dupa dang zos pa dang reg pa dang yid la byed pa la sogs pas yid gdungs shing sems bcom par 'gyur dhil/ snying la phog cing gnod dhipar gyur nas/slon pa gang yin pa de ni ⑦mi sdug pa'i yul las byung ba zhes bya ba ste/ mngon par mi 'dod pa'i yul dang phrad pa las byung ⑧ba'o/ /yid mi bde skom srin bee'u ⑨snabs/ /rlung sogs nyid la gnas par brtag /ces bya ba la/ srin bu la sogs pa bzhi pa ⑩ni rlung la sogs pa slon bro ba gsum pa'i mtshan nyid ji lta ba ⑪bzhin du brtag cing dpyad la shes par bya'i/ rlung la sogs pa med par de rnams 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /yid mi bde ba ni sbrum ma zla gnyis lon phan chad mngal ⑫bsal nas 'byung ba la bya'o/ /gzer dang 'phar dang snying na ba⑫/ /bye brag tu ni srin bu'i nad/ /srin bu'i snying nad mtshan ma las/ /de ni shes par bya ba yin/ /zhes bya ba la/ srin bu'i nad las skyes pa'i slon bro ba ni gzer la sogs pa'i khyad par ④bshad pa yin la/ de bzhin du srin bu'i nad kyi mtshan ma mig ⑫gnag pa la sogs pa las ⑩shes par bya'o/ /snying 113—1081

nad nad ①ni re re 'dus/ /srin bu las gyur ②rnam lngar bshad/ /ces bya ba la—/ snying nad ni rlung mkhris pa ①bad kan las gyur pa dang / 'dus pa las gyur pa dang / srin bu las gyur pa ste/ rnam dupa lnga yod par bshad do/ /rlung gis shin tu zug cing na/ /gas dang gshags rjopa snyam du sems/ /bcom snyam sems shing skam la rengs/ /snying ga rjostong snyam zag par byed/ /rgyu med zhum zhing mi dga' la/ /'jigs shing sgra ni mi bzod cing ⑦/ /'phar zhing 'gre la gcus snyam byed/ /rmongs ⑧bag dbugs thung gnyid chung 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba la/ rlung las gyur pa'i snying nad ni snying du zug cing gzer ba dang /btsugs 7pa ltar na ba dang / de bzhin du snying gas pa snyam du sems shing na ba dang / tshal par gshags ⑩pa snyam du sems shing na ba dang / ⑪grugs pa snyam du sems pa dang / khong skam ⑫par gyur pa dang / rengs shing gang ba snyam du sems pa dang / snying ga ⑫stong zhing med pa snyam du sems pa dang / zag cing ⑫g.yos la sems 'phyo ba dang / rgyu med par glo bur du sems zhum zhing mi dga' ste mya ngan du byed pa dang / 'jigs shing dngangs pa dang / sgra mi bzod cing tshig thogs pa la sogs pa la 'khrul pa dang / 'phar zhing 'gul ba dang / sa la 'gre zhing ldog pa dang / snying gcus pa snyam du dung skedung por na ba dang / rmongs ⑩bag tu gyur cing ⑩mi dran pa dang / dbugs thung zhing 'tshubs ⑫pa dang / gnyid chung zhing yar ba ste mtshan nyid de dag dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /mkhris gyur skom dad mgo 'khor ⑪brgyal/ /tsha rngul snying ⑦sgyur lus snyom byed⑫/ /mkhris pa skyur ba slon par byed/ /dud pa khar song meser rims 'debs/ /zhes bya ba la/ mkhris pa las gyur pa'i snying 113—1082

nad la ni skom dad ①la sogs pa 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /snying ga skyur ba dang ②tsha zhing sgregs par ①sgyur ba'o/ /bad kan las gyur snying ga rengs/ /khong na rdo bcug lta bur phyi/ /drod nyams mchil mang lud pa lu/ /gnyid che snyom ④rims yi ga 'chus/ /zhes bya ba la/ bad kan las gyur pa'i snying nad la ni snying ga rengs shing mi 'gul dhibar na ba dang / khong na rdo bcug pa ltar sems shing nang na rdo yod pa lta pyabur lus lci ba dang / de bzhin du me drod nyams pa la sogs pa 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /nyes gsum mtshan nyid thams cad ldan/ /zhes bya ba la/ rlung dang bad kan dang mkhris pa ⑦gsum 'dus pa las byung ba'i snying nad ni de gsum char gyi mtshan nyid thams cad dang ldan par 'gyur ro//srin bus mig ni gnag pa dang / /mun par zhugs snyam byed snying 'phar/ /lus skam g.ya' zhing bad kan 'dzag /'di ni rtag tu sog le yis/ /snying la 'drud ⑧pa lta bur sems/ /mi bzad nad des myur gsod pas/ /de ni rings par gso bar ⑨bya/ /zhes bya ba la/ srin bu las gyur pa'i snying nad ni mig gnag par gyur pa dang / mun pa'i nang du zhugs pa ltar mun 'thibs zhes byed ⑩pa dang / snying 'phar zhing brgal ba dang / lus skam zhing sha zad pa dang / kha nas bad kan ⑪ljan ljin 'dzag pa dang / yang rtag tu snying la sog les 'drud cing gshags ⑫pa lta bur sems te/ srin bu ⑫snying na ba zhes bya ba'i nad mi bzad pa des ⑫ni myur du gsod cing spyo'achi bar byed pas ring zhing ⑩myur bar gso bar bya ste/ gnad chen po snying zhes bya ba 'bus zos pa ni bsad tu)pa chen po skyed par byed pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar snying nad kyi mtshan nyid bshad nas/ da skom dad kyi nad bshad par bya ste/ skom dad 113—1083

rlung mkhris bad kan dang / /'dus pa dwangs ma zad pa dang / /nad 'dres pa las drug tu ①'gyur/ /zhes bya ba la/ rlung la sogs pa'i dbye bas skom dad rnam pa drug yod do/ /nad dang 'dres pa ni rims la sogs pa nad gzhi gzhan dang 'dres pa'i rkyen las skom dad du gyur pa'o/ /de ltar gyur pa thams cad la/ /rlung mkhris gnyis ni rgyu yin te/ /zhes bya ba la/ de ltar skom dad thams cad ldang zhing 'byung ba'i rgyu ni rnam pa gnyis te/ mkhris pa dang rlung yin par shes par bya'o/ /de 'khrugs lus zungs bsil ba ni/ /skams ⑤ nas ldang bar 'gyur ba yin/ /lus kun 'dar zhing mgo 'khor tsha/ /skom dad khong tsha rmongs par byed/ /ces bya ba la/ rlung dang mkhris pa de dag ldang zhing 'khrugs par 'gyur ba ni lus zungs bsil ba ste/ dwangs ma'am bad kan skams nas ①ldang zhing 'byung bar 'gyur la/ rlung dang mkhris pa 'khrugs ④par byed pa de yang lus thams cad 'dar zhing mgo 'khor ba la sogs pa byed pa yin par shes par bya'o/ /lce drud mgul pa glo ba dang / /skam dang skom 'thungs rgyu ba dang / /skam ⑤pas skom dad skye bar 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba la—/ skom dad thams cad ni lce drud pa la sogs pa skam ⑥nas 'byung ba yin par shes par bya'o/ /de rnams kyi ni spyi mtshan nyid/ /kha skam skom gyis mi ngoms dang / /zas la mi dga' skad 'gags dang / /gre ba lce mchu rtsub par 'gyur—/ /lce 'byen byed cing khong snyom la/ /bla ⑦zhing sems ni myos pa dang / /de bzhin skom gdungs nad du 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba la/ skom dad de rnams kyi spyi'i mtshan nyid de thun mong gi mtshan nyid de skams pa nas skom dad du gyur pa'i bar kyis gabastan pa yin par shes par bya'o/ /de la skom kyis gdungs 113—1084
