pa'i nad ni nad ①mi 'byung bar bya ba'i le'u las bshad pa yin no/ /lus skams ⑤rmya zhing 'on pa dang / /rmongs 1bag mgo 'khor snying nad de/ /'di lta bu yi nad rnams ni/ /skom pas gdungs las skye bar 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba la—/ yang skom dad kyis ④gdungs pa las lus skams rjopa la sogs pa'i nad rnams kyang skye bar 'gyur ro/ /rlung gyur khong rmya nyam chung la/ /mur 'gram zug cing klad pa 'khor/ /sna lces dri dang ro mi tshor/ /'on zhing gnyid med nyams stobs zad/ /chu grang 'thungs bun skom 'phel 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba la/ skom dad kyis gdungs pa lus skams pa la sogs pa'i nad rnams kyang skye bar 'gyur ro/ /⑦rlung las gyur pa'i skom dad ni khong rmya ba la sogs par 'gyur te/tshig gi don ni go bar zad do/ /mkhris pa kha nang ro kha brgyal/ /mngar ⑧por mthong zhing rtag par ni/ /kha skam khong tsha ⑨dbugs mnam pa'o/ /zhes bya ba la/ mkhris pa las gyur pa'i skom dad ni kha'i nang gi ro kha ba nas dbugs mnam pa'i bar du 'gyur ro/ /bad kan ldang bas skom rgyu'i rtsa/ /bkag 4)pas rlung ni 'khrugs gyur nas/ /de tshe de yis bad kan ni/ / 'dam bzhin de yis skem ⑪par byed/ /mgul pa gra mas gang snyam sems/ /gnyid che kha nang mngar bar bro/ /lto ba mgo bo tshor ba chung / /rmongs bag slon gyur yi ga 'chus/ /lus skam ⑫kha zas mi 'ju'o/ /zhes bya ba la/ bad kan 'khrugs shing ldang bas chu rgyu bar byed pa'i rtsa sgo rnams su rlung rgyu ba bkag cing g.yogs pa dang / de'i tshe rlung des bad kan de skam ⑫par byed pa ni 'dam ltar skem par byed do/ /dper na phyi'i rlung gis 'dam skem ⑫par byed pa bzhin du rlung gis bad kan skem ④par byed de⑩/ de nas bad kan skams 113—1085

pas mgul pa gra mas gang ba snyam du sems shing tsha la rtsub par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang gnyid che zhing kha'i nang mngar bar bro bar 'gyur ba la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid rnams kyang 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /kun las gyur pa rtags kun ldan//zhes bya ba la/ nad gzhi gsum char gyis bskyed pa'i skom dad ni 'dus pa'i mtshan nyid thams cad dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /bee'u snabs las gyur ①kha zas ni/ /mid dka' rlung mkhris las gyur yin/ /zhes bya ba la/ be'u snabs las gyur pa'i skom dad ni kha zas mid par dka' zhing thogs par 'gyur ba de las ni mkhris pa dang rlung las gyur pa'i mtshan nyid dang ldan par 'gyur ro//tsha bas ngal bas 'phral du na/ /chu grang bsten gyur skom dad che②/ /khong par tsha ba bsdus pa yin/ / skom dad ①de ni mkhris skyes yin/ /zhes bya ba la/skyes bu tsha bas ngal zhing dub par gyur la/ de 'phral du de'i mod la chu grang bsten zhing dhikhrus la sogs pa byas pas/ phyi rol gyi tsha ba khong pa'i nang du bsdus te/ de'i dbang gis skom dad skyes pa gang yin pa de ni ⑤mkhris pa las skyes pa ⑥'byung ba yin no/ /gang yang chang drags me drod rnodzee/ /snum zos skyes pa'ang mkhris 'byung duyin/ /zhes bya ba la/ yang skom dad gang chang ⑨mang du 'thungs shing drags pa las gyur pa de yang mkhris pa las gyur pa nyid yin par shes par bya'o/ /yang de bzhin du me drod rno zhing shas che ba las snum zos pa las byung ba'i skom dad de yang mkhris pa las byung bar shes par bya'o/ /snum zhing ⑩skyur dang lan dza'i bag /zos pas bad kan las skyes 'gyur⑪/ /zhes bya ba la/ kha zas snum bag la sogs pa zos pa las ⑩skom dad skyes pa ni bad kan las byung ba yin par shes par bya'o/ /zad ⑫byed las ni skom dad 113—1086

'gyur—/ /dwangs ma zad dang mtshan nyid 'dra/ /zhes bya ba la/ zad ①byed las skom dad du gyur pa gang yin pa de ni dwangs ma zad pa'i mtshan nyid de⑤/dwangs ma zad nas ①rtsub la skem/ /nyam chung sgra ni zhes bya ba smos pa yin pas 'di nyid las shes par bya'o/ /khong skam ④gcin nad rims nad sogs/ /yun ring ⑤nad ni rims skom nad/ /gang zhig skom dad mi bzad skyes/ /de ni 'dres las byung bar bshad/ /ces bya ba la/ khong skam pa la sogs pa dang 'dres pa dang skom dad gang mi bzad cing brnag par dka' ba skyes pa de ni 'dres pa las byung ba'i mtshan nyid can yin par drang srong rnams kyis bshad do/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa'i rnam par 'grel pa tshig gi don gyi zla zer zhes bya ba0/ slob dpon zla ba la dga' bas rnam par sbyar ba las/nad gzhi'i gnas dzeekyi le'u lnga pa'i rnam par 'grel pa'o// //de nas chang nad kyi nad gzhi bshad par bya'o/ /zhes bya ba la/ rlung la sogs pa ldang zhing 'khrugs pa'i gzhi gcig pa dang / nyes pa gsum las byung bar tshul mthun pas gcong chen po'i 'og tu 'di brtsams pa yin no/ /chang gi nad du gyur pas na chang gi nad dam/ chang las myos pa la sogs pa'i nyes par gyur pas na chang nad de/ myos pa'i rgyu las byung ba'i nad ces bya ba'i skedon no//de yang ⑨myos pa ni sems dang lus zungs 'gyur bar byed pa yin la/ de yang chang la sogs pas tho) myos par gyur pas ()na/ de'i rgyu ni chang yin par bshad do/ /rno dang drod che rtsub drag ⑫skyur/ /nyal po 'dod myur byed dang yang / /gsal dang dang bar byed par bshad/ /mdangs ni 'di las go 113—1087

bzlog yin/ /zhes bya ba la/ chang ni rno ba la sogs pa yon tan bcu dang ldan par bshad la/ mdangs ni chang gi yon tan ji skad du bshad pa 'di las go bzlog pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa yin te/ rngul ba dang grang ba dang snum ①pa dang rags pa dang mngar ba dang brtan pa dang / yun ring por skebyed pa dang /lci ba dang / 'jam pa dang / 'byar bag ①can yin no/ /dug kyang rno stsogs ④yin mod kyis⑤/ /sems la gnod par byed pa yin/ /nus rjopas 'chi bar byed pas na/ /dug ni lhag par mthu che'o/ /zhes bya ba la chang gi yon tan rno ba la sogs pa bcu po 'di dag ni chang 'ba' zhig tu ma zad kyi dug la'ang yod mod kyi⑦/ de'i khyad par ni sems la lhag par gnod cing 'khrul par byed pa'i rang bzhin can gyi nus pa dug la yod pas na/ gang gis 'chi bar byed par 'gyur ba de lta bu'i nus pa dug la yod pa'i phyir/ dug gi nus pa chang bas lhag par mthu che zhing nus pa lhag pa yin no⑧/ /chang ni rno sogs yon tan gyi/ /mdangs kyi yon tan rtul ⑨la sogs/ /bcu po bcu yis 'khrugs byas nas/ /sems ni sgyur ⑩bar byed pa yin/ /zhes bya ba la/chang gi yon tan rno ba la sogs pa bcus mdangs kyi yon tan rtul ba la sogs pa bcu po zil gyis mnan zhing kṛ7'khrugs par byas shing kun du dkrugs nas sems sgyur (/rtezhing rnam pa gzhan du gyur par byed pa yin no⑫/ /ra ro dang po gnyis pa yis/ /bag med pa yi 7gnas la gnas/ /rnam rtog ngan 'joms ⑫rmongs pa rnams/ /bde ba yin snyam sems par 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba la/ ra ro ba'i shugs dang po dang ra ro ba'i shugs gnyis pas ni bag med pa'i gnas la gnas pa ste/ bag med pa'i ⑩nyes par spyod pa rnams 'byung bar byed pa'i 113—1088

rgyur gyur pa ①yin no/ /de nyid kyis ni rang gi rnam rtog ngan pa ②bcom zhing sems kyi kun du rtog pas brlag par gyur pa yin la/ de nyid ni rmongs ④pa ste/bya ba dang bya ba ma yin pa mi byed pa sterjo/ de rnams ni ra ro ba'i shugs dang po dang / gnyis pa'i skabs la gnas pas na/ de bde ba yin par shes shing shin tu bde ba kho nar 'dzin gyi/ de lta bu'i bdag nyid can gyi bde ba yin par ni mi rtogs so/ /'dir bag med pa ni tshe phyi ma'i sdug bsngal gyi rgyu las mi dge ba rnams 'byung ba'i rgyu las ⑤bya la/ de 'byung ba'i gnas la gnas pa ni ra ro ba'i shugs dang po dang gnyis pa las byung ba yin no zhes bya ba'i don no/ /'bring dang chen po ⑥bar gyi tshe/ /rdul dang mun pa'i rang bzhin can/ /glang chen lcags kyu med pa ltar/ /rmongs nga sa mi bya ci yang med/ /ces bya ba la/'bring dang chen po ste ra ro ba'i shugs gnyis pa dang / gsum pa'i bar mtshams su phyin pa'i meskyes bu de rdul ⑧dang mun pa'i rang bzhin du ⑫thob pas na/mi bya ba ci yang med de mi dge ba thams cad mi bya ba ci yang med do/ /rdul dang mun pa'i rang bzhin can/ /smos pas ni skyes bu snying stobs can ni nam mkha' ⑩yang 'di lta bu'i gnas skabs can du mi 'gyur ro zhes ston pa yin no/ /glang chen lcags kyu med pa ltar/ /zhes bya ba bstan ⑪pa ni rang dbang can du ci dgar spyod pa yin te/ dper na glang po che myos pa lcags kyu med pa dag ni mi srun pa'i spyod pa thams cad ston par byed pa dang 'dra bar ra ro ba 'bring dang chen po'i bar tshigs su phyin pa ni skyes bu rmongs pa sdig pa mi dge ba'i las ci yang mi bya ba med de thams cad byed do ces ⑫bya ba'i don no/ / 'di ni kha na ma tho'i gnas/ /spyo'adi ni tshul khrims 'chal ba'i gzhi/ /zhes bya ba la/113—1089

ra ro ba 'bring dang chen po'i bar tshigs ①ni kha na ma tho ba ste/ smad par bya ba yin pas brjod kyis mi lang ba'i sdig pa rnams kyi ④gnas dang gzhi ni 'di dag ①nyid yin no/ /yang 'di nyid ni tshul khrims 'chal zhing gyobaslab pa nyams pa'i gnas sam gzhi yang 'di dag (gluyin no/ /'di gcig ngan 'gror 'gro ba'i lam//mang po ston par byed pa yin/ /zhes bya ba la/ ra ro ba'i gnas skabs kyi khyad par 'di nyid ni ngan song gsum du 'gro ba'i lam du ma'i rgyu yin zhing lam mang po de dag tu khrid cing ston par byed pa'i slob dpon yin no/ /ra ro dugasum/ pa'i tshe na ni/ /sems med par ni ro ltar nyal/ /zhes bya ba la ra ro ba'i shugs chen por phyin cing / de la gnas pa'i tshe na ni sems med par ro ltar nyal te/ tho yor ram/ rtsig pa'am/ mi ro dang 'dra'o zhes bya ba'i don no/ /nyes pa'i ⑦bdag nyid shi ba dulas/ /shin tu ma rungs gnas skabs thob/ /ces bya ba la/ nyes pa'i bdag nyid de shi ba las 7kyang ches thu ba'i ma rungs pa'i gnas skabs thob par 'gyur shāshe ro/ /chos dang chos min bde dang sdug /don dang don min phan dang gnod/ /gang la chags pa ⑪mi shes pa/ /de la 7mkhas pas ji ltar bsten/ /zhes bya ba la/ gang la chags shing mngon par zhen na ⑫chos dang chos ma yin pa la sogs pa shes shing rtogs par mi 'gyur ba'i chang de la mkhas pa blo dang ldan pas ji ltar bsten par bya ste/bsten par mi bya'o zhes bya bar sbyar ro/ /de la chos ni sbyin pa gtong ④ba dang /dkon mchog mchod spyopa la sogs pa'o/ /chos ma yin pa ni srog gcod pa la sogs pa'i sdig pa'i las ⑩byed pa'o/ /bde ba ni mtho ris la sogs pa'i bde ba'o / /sdug bsngal ni sems can dmyal ba la sogs pa'o/ /don ni rgyal 113—1090

po'i khrims su ①bya ba'am/ don du bsgrub par bya'o/ /don ma yin pa ni gzhung lugs 'chol ⑤ba'o/ /phan pa dang gnod pa ni bya ba dang bya ba ma yin pa ste/ de dag gi ①bye brag mi shes pa'o/ /chang las myos 'jigs mya ngan dang / /khro dang srog dang bral ba nas④/ /smyo byed myos dang brgyal bar bcas/ /brjed byed bcas pa kun song nad/ /ces bya ba la/ chang la ni myos pa la sogs pa gnas te/ de dag gi rgyu yin pa'i phyir ro/ /kun song nad ces bya ba ni 'og nas bshad pa'i nad ro dang 'dra bar byed pa ste/ ming gi rnam glugrangs su na thong bar byed pa zhes ⑥kyang bya'o/ /gang du dran pa nyams gcig yod⑦—/ /der ni mi dge thams cad 'byung / /zhes bya ba la/ mang du smras pas ci zhig bya ste/ gang du chang gang la dran pa nyams pa gcig pu yod pa der ni / dngos po gang dang gang dag yod pa thams cad mi dge ba'i tshul thams cad 'byung zhing chos ma yin pa nyid du 'gyur ro/ /mi 'phrod zas ni zos pas kyang / /nad dam yang na 'chi bar 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba la/ gang gi phyir mi 'phrod pa'am mi rigs par sbyar ba'i zas zos pas/ zas de srog gi rten yin yang nad nyid skyed par 'gyur ba'am/ 'chi bar 'gyur ba yin na chang lta smos kyang ci dgos/ chang gi sde tshan ④gsum blo ldanadu// /ngo tsha sogs kyang 'jig par byed/ /ces bya ba la/ gang yang chang gi ⑪ nyes dmigs ni shas cher bsten pas sde tshan tho7gsum la sogs pa nyams shing 'jig par byed pa yin te/sde tshan ⑫gsum ni skyes bus btsal bar bya ba'i chos dang nor ⑫'dod pa'o/ /blo ni shes rab bo/ nyams stobs ldan dang zas zos dang / /zas cher ④za dang snum bag za(9/ /snying stobs lang tshor ldan pa dang / /rtag tu chang 113—1091

'thung de'i rigs skyes/ /tshil dang bad kan shas che la/ /rlung dang mkhris pa ①shas chung dang / /me drod che zhing brtan ①pa rnams/ /shas cher ra ror mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes bya ba la/ skyes bu ①stobs dang ldan zhing nyams 'tshag rjobazang ba dag gis chang 'thungs na shas cher ra ro bar mi 'gyur zhing de'i 'gyur bar mi skye'o/ /yang de bzhin du kha zas legs par zos zin pa'i rjes la 'thungs pa dang / zas cher za zhing mang du zos bupa dang / snum bag dang ldan pa'i kha zas zos pa'am/ rang bzhin gyis snying stobs che ba dang / lang tsho dang ldan zhing dar la bab pa dang / rtag tu chang 'thungs shing ④goms pa dang / de'i rigs las skyes pa ste/ chang 'thungs shing ⑧sred pa'i rigs rgyud du stibyung ba dang / bad kan dang tshil gyi shas che zhing mang ba dang / rlung dang mkhris pa ⑩ shas che zhing brtan pa ste/ de thams cad kyis ⑩chang 'thungs su zin kyang ra ro bar mi 'gyur ro/ /de las bzlog pa ⑫chang dad can/ /khros dang chang rtsub sgyur shas che/ /ma zhur bcas dang mang 'thungs pa/ /gang yin shas cher ra ror 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba la/ de ltar ji skad bstan pa las go bzlog pa nyams stobs chung ba dang / kha zas ma zos pa ⑫dang / kha zas nyung du zos pa dang / rtsub bag zos pa dang / snying stobs chung ba dang /dar la bab pa las yol ba dang / rtag tu chang mi 'thung ba dang / chang 'thungs pa'i stsorigs su ma skyes pa dang / tshil dang bad kan zad pa dang /rlung dang mkhris pa shas che ba dang / khong pa'i me drod chung zhing mi brtan pa dag gis ⑩chang 'thungs na shas cher ra ro bar 'gyur/ yang de bzhin du chang dad can te chang la sred cing yid rton pa dang khros shing 'khrugs pa dang / chang 113—1092

sgyur zhing rtsub pa shas che ba dang / de bzhin du chang ma zhu ba ste/ snga de zhag 'thungs pa'i chang ma zhu ba'i rjes la 'thungs pa dang / de bzhin du shin tu mang du 'thungs pas shin tu ra ro bar 'gyur ro/ /rlung mkhris bad kan kun las byung / /chang nad rnam pa bzhir 'gyur ro/ /zhes bya ba la/ rlung la sogs pa'i nad gzhi ①re re dang / kun 'dus pa las gcig ste chang nad rnam pa dzeebazhir 'gyur ro/ /kun kyang kun las skyes mod ①kyi/ /shas che ba las ming du btags④—/ /zhes bya ba la/ chang nad kun kyang nyes pa gsum char las byung ⑤mod—/ 'on kyang nad gzhi dugang dang gang shas che ba de dang de las phye ste ming du btags ⑦pa yin no/ /de rnams kyi ni spyi mtshan nyid/ /rmongs dang snying ni na ba dang / /'khru zhing rtag tu skom dad che⑧/ /tsha grang rims 'debs yi ga 'chus—/ /mgo bo rtsib rus na dang 'dar/ /gnad ⑨'jig ltag pa na ba dang / /brla rengs rab rib khyer ba dang / /lud pa dbugs mi bde ⑫gnyid med—/ /rngul cher 'byung zhing bshang ba 'gags/ /skrang zhing sems ⑪ni 'khrul ba dang / /bla ⑫zhing slon par byed pa dang / /mgo 'khor ⑫rmi lam ngan mthong ④ba'o/ /zhes bya ba la/ chang nad de rnams kyi spyi'i mtshan nyid de rnam par dbye ba med par thun mong gi rtags ni 'di dag yin no/ /sems rmongs shing shin tu blun bag tu 'gyur ba dang / snying na zhing 'phar ba dang / 'khru zhing bshang ba sla ba dang / rtag par rgyun mi 'chad par skom dad che ba dang /rims tsha ba dang grang ba'i bag das/ gis btab par 'gyur ba'am/ yang na tsha grang ste mkhris pa dang bad kan gyi mtshan nyid dang ldan par 'gyur ba dang /mgo la sogs par ⑫na ba dang / lus 'dar zhing 'gul ba dang / gnad ⑩ 113—1093

rnams 'jig cing 'bye ba snyam du stisems pa dang / ltag pa'i phyogs na zhing zug pa dang / brla rengs shing 'gyur ba mi bde ba dang / mig rab rib khyer zhing mi gsal ba dang / lud pa la sogs pa 'byung ba dang / sems 'khrul zhing nyams ④pa la sogs pa'o/ /rlung gyur khyad par gnyid mi 'ong / /dbugs mi bde zhing klad na 'dar/ /rmi lam du ni 'phyan zhing 'phur/ /gshin po rnams dang gtam smra rmi/ /zhes bya ba la/ rlung las gyur pa'i chang nad ni khyad par bye brag tu gnyid mi 'ong ba la sogs pa 'byung bar 'gyur ba dang / de bzhin du rmi lam kyi ⑦nang na 'phyan zhing yul gzhan nas gzhan du 'gro bar rmi ba dang / nam mkha' la 'phur zhing lding bar rmi ba dang / sngon chad shi ba'i nye du la sogs pa gshin po rnams dang lhan cig gtam smra ba rmi bar 'gyur ro/ /mkhris las ④lus tsha skad 'gags dang / / rmongs bag tshad 'khru skom ⑤mgo 'khor/ /lus mdog ljang dang ser ba dang / /mig dang mkhur tshos dmar bar 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba la/spyo mkhris pa rgyas pa las gyur pa'i chang nad ni lus tsha ba la sogs par 'gyur ro/ /bad kan gyis slon snying na dang / /gnyid che grang 'dar yan lag lci/ /zhes bya ba la/ bad kan shas che ba las gyur pa'i chang nad ni slon pa la sogs pa 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /grang 'dar ni grang lhags kyis phog pa'i lus 'dar ba'o/ /kun skyes mtshan nyid kun dang ldan/ /zhes bya ba la/ nad gzhi kun 'dus pa las byung ba'i chang nad ni mtshan nyid kun 'dren ⑦ma dang ldan pa yin no/ /chang spangs pa las 'phral du ni/ /mang du 'thung ngam ma goms 'thungs/ /de skelas 'joms dang lus skam ⑨nad/ /rlung las sdug bsngal ldan pa 'byung / /nyam 173byed1094

chung ba la ①mchog tu 'byung / /zhes bya ba la/ chang dang 'phrod par gyur pa las kyang de spangs te dus yun ring por lon pa las chang de nyid mod la mang du 'thungs pa'am/ yang na sngar ma goms pa'i chang gzhan 'thungs par gyur na/rgyu de las 'joms byed ces bya ba'i nad dang lus skam zhes bya ba'i chang nad gnyis po rlung la sogs pa las sdug bsngal zhing gso bar ⑤dka' ba 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /rnam pa de gnyis ni skyes bu nyams stobs chung ba la mchog tu shas cher 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /'joms pas bad kan mchil ma mang / /sgog ma skams shing ④gnyid rab che/ /sgra grag mi bzod glong ④bag 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba la/ chang nad 'joms par byed pa zhes bya ba de'i mtshan ma bad kan dang mchil ma'i ljan ljin mang du 'byung bar 'gyur ba dang / de bzhin gog ma skam pa la sogs pa 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ / lud skam ⑤yan lag mgo rab dun/ /snying nad mgul nad rmongs bag dang / /lud pa skom dad slon ④rims 'debs//zhes bya ba la/ chang nad lud pa skam pa zhes bya ba byung bar gyur na/ de'i mtshan ma ni yan lag dang mgo bo shas cher na zhing mi bde ba nas rims kyis 'debs pa'i bar du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /gang zhig chang rnams spangs pas ⑧ni—/ /dbang po thul zhing brtags te byed/ /nam yang de la lus sems kyi/ /skyon rnams 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes bya ba la/ skyes bu gang zhig chang spangs shing chang mi 'thung ba'i brtul zhugs blangs pa de ni dbang po thul zhing zhi la brkam ⑨shas chung ba dang / brtags te byed pa ste bya ba rnams la blo sngon du song bas 'jug par 'gyur ba dang / de bzhin du yang skyes bu de'i lus la dus nam yang lus dang sems kyi nad kyi skyon rnams 'byung bar mi 'gyur te/ lus 113—1095

las ①byung ba'i nad rims la sogs pa dang / sems las byung ②ba'i nad brjed byed la sogs pa 'byung bar mi ④'gyur zhing de'i gnod pas nyen par mi 'gyur ro/ /rdul dang mun pa mi 'phrod zas/ /mchog tu bsten las nad gsum 'byung / /dwangs ma khrag dang sems rgyu ba'i/ /rtsa sbubs bkag pa las byung ba/ /myos dang brgyal dang kun song nadarjo/ /phyi ma bzhin du stobs rab che—/ /zhes bya ba la/ rdul dang mun pa'i rang bzhin la mchog tu bsten pa dang / kha zas mi 'phrod pa za ba la mchog tu bsten cing gnas par ⑤byed pa mi la myos pa dang ⑥brgyal ba dang / kun du song ba zhes bya ba'i nad de rnam pa gsum 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de yang dwangs ma dang khrag dang sems rgyu bar ⑦byed pa'i rtsa sbubs lus la gang dag yod pa de bkag cing chod dzeepa las 'byung bar 'gyur ⑨zhing rgyu byed pa yin la/ yang de dag ni phyi ma bzhin du stobs dang nus pa che ba yin te/ de na myos pa bas ni brgyal ba stobs dang ldan pa yin la/de bas ni kun du song ba stobs dang ldan pa yin no/ /'dir myos nad sna re re kun—/ /khrag chang ⑩dug rnams las kyang 'byung / /zhes bya ba la/ 'dir myos pa dang brgyal ba dang kun du song ba zhes bya ba gsum gyi ⑪nang nas myos pa ni rnam pa bdun te/ nad gzhi re re las ⑫gyur pa gsum dang / 'dus pa las gyur pa dang / khrag dang chang dang dug las gyur pa ⑫rnams so/ /de dag kyang phyi ma bzhin du stobs che ba yin no/ /rlung las gtam la chags pa dang / /mang smra nyung smra spyod pa 'khrul/ /lus ni rtsub gnag dmar ba yi④/ /myos pa rlung las skyes pa yin/ /zhes bya ba la/ rlung las gyur pa'i myos pa ni gtam smra ba la chags par 'gyur ba dang / mang du smra ba la dga' ba dang /113—1096

myur du smra zhing rings par smra ba dang / spyod pa 'khrul zhing nyams pa dang /lus rtsub pa dang / dmar ba'i bag tu gnas pa ni rlung las skyes pa yin no/ /mkhris pa las khro dmar ba dang / /ser por snang zhing rtsod la dga'/ /zhes bya ba la①/ mkhris pa las gyur pa'i myos pa ni lus kyi mdog dmar zhing ser bar dusnang ba dang / rtsod cing 'thab mo la dga' ba yin no/ /bad kan tshig nyung 'byel smra skya/ /sems las che zhing le lo che/ /zhes bya ba la/ bad kan las gyur pa'i myos pa ni tshig nyung zhing 'brel par smra ba dang / kha dog dkar zhing skya ba dang / sems las che zhing le lo che ba yin no/ /'dus pa mtshan nyid kun dang ldan/ /zhes bya ba la/ 'dus pa las gyur pa'i myos pa ni mtshan nyid kun dang ldan pa'i mtshan nyid pyacan yin no/ /khrag las mig dang yan lag rengs/ /mkhris pa'i mtshan nyid ldan pa yin/ /zhes bya ba la/khrag las gyur pa'i myos pa ni mig ser zhing buhar bag tu gnas pa dang / yan lag rengs shing 'gyur mi shes pa yin no/ /gzhan yang mkhris pas rjomyos pa'i mtshan nyid khro ba dang / mdog dmar zhing ser ba dang rtsad ⑥pa la dga' ba yin no/ /chang gis ⑦yan lag skad spyod 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba la/ chang las gyur pa'i myos pa ni sgeyan lag dang skad dang spyod pa gzhan du 'gyur ba 'byung bar 'gyur te/ yan lag 'gyur ba ni lus rnams ⑨gzhan du 'gyur ba'o/ /skad 'gyur ba ni skad gdangs ⑩nyams shing 'gags pa'o/ /spyod pa 'gyur ba ni lus dang ngag dang yid kyi spyod pa nyams shing sngar gnas pa las gzhan du gyur pa'o—/ /dug gis 'dar zhing gnyid rab che/ /de ni kun las myos tshabs che//zhes bya ba la/ dug gis myos par gyur pa ni 'dar zhing lus 'gul ba dang /113—1097

gnyid shin tu che zhing stug ①pa yin no/ /de ni myos pa kun las shin tu tshabs cher myos pa yin te nad kyis ④gnod pa skyed par byed pa yin no/ /khrag sogs pa yis rlung sogs pa'i/ /mtshan nyid lhag par shes par bya/ /zhes bya ba la/ khrag dang chang dang dug las gyur pa'i myos pa las rlung la sogs pa'i nad rang gi mtshan nyid lhag par mtshan nyid kyis shes par bya'o/ /de ni 'di skad ston pa yin te/ khrag dang chang dang dug gi mtshan nyid bshad mod kyi/rlung la sogs pa gang yang rung ba lhag par gnas pa yin no zhes shes par ro①/ /de ltar stsos pa'i mtshan nyid bshad nas/ brgyal ba'i mtshan nyid bshad par bya sterka/ brgyal ba rlung gi bdag nyid can/ /nam mkha' budamar sngo gnag par ni/ /mthong zhing mun par zhugs snyam sems/ /myur du sangs par byed pa dang / /snying na 'dar zhing mgo 'khor la/ /skem zhing bzhin mdog dmar nag 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba la/ brgyal ba'i nad rlung las gyur pa'i bdag nyid can la ni/ skyes bus nam mkha'i me tog rjokha dog dmar ba dang sngo ba dang gnag par mthong bar 'gyur zhing mun par zhugs pa snyam du mun 'thibs zhes byed par 'gyur ba dang / myur du sangs shing dran pa rnyed par 'gyur ba dang /snying na zhing 'dar ba nas/ bzhin ras dang lus kyi mdog dmar nag tu snang bar 'gyur ro/ /mkhris pas dmar ba'am ser por rjoni/ /nam mkha' mthong zhing mun 'thibs ༄shebyed/ /sangs nas rngul dang bcas pa dang / /tsha skom gdungs pas nyen pa dang / /'khru zhing kha dog ser dang dmar/ /mig dmar ser bar snang bar 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba la/ mkhris pa las gyur pa'i brgyal ⑧ba ni nam mkha'i mdog dmar po'am/ ser po nyid du mthong bar 'gyur ba 113—1098

dang / mun 'thibs ①zhes byed cing rmongs nas mi dran par 'gyur ro/ /de nas sangs nas dran pa rnyed pa dang / lus rngul zhing tsha ba la sogs pas gdungs shing nyen par 'gyur ba dang / bshang ba 'khru zhing sla ba dang / kha dog ser zhing dmar bar snang ba dang / mig grudamar zhing ser bar snang bas lta ①bar 'gyur ro/ /bad kan gyis ni sprin lta bur/ /nam mkha' mthong zhing mun 'thibs byed/ /rings ④nas sangs par 'gyur ba dang / /snying na bcas pas rjomachil ma mang / /pags pa rlon 6 pas g.yogs pa bzhin/ /yan lag lci zhing tshor ba chung / /zhes bya ba la/ bad kan las byung ba'i brgyal bar gyur pa'i mtshan ma rgo nam mkha' gnyis par ⑦g.yogs pa lta bur mthong ba dang / mun 'thibs ⑤zhes byed cing mi dran par 'gyur ba dang / brgyal nas yun ring zhig nas sangs par 'gyur ba dang / snying 'phar zhing na ba dang bcas pa'i mchil ma dang bad kan gyi ljan byān mang po 'byung ba dang / pags pa rlon pas stigayogs shing dkris pa bzhin du yan lag dang bcas pa'i lus lci zhing tshor ba chung bar 'byung bar ⑫'gyur ro/ /nyes pa gsum byu mtshan kun ldan—/ /brjed byed gnyis pa lta bu ste/ /myur du 'gyel zhing brgyal 'gyur te//'jigs rung spyod pa med pa yin/ /zhes bya ba la/ nad gzhi'i nyes pa gsum char gyis bskyed pa'i brgyal ba ni mtshan nyid de dag thams cad dang ldan pa dang /brjed byed gnyis pa yin zhing dran pa nyams par 'gyur la/ brjed byed kyis zin pa ltar myur du 'gyel zhing dran pa med par ⑪brgyal bar 'gyur la/ khyad par ni brjed byed kyi gdon lta bu dang ⑫/ 'jigs su ⑫rung ba'i spyod pa med par gzhan thams cad tshul mthun pa yin no/ /lus can myos dang brgyal ba 113—1099

yis①—/ /nad la shugs yod gyur kyang ni/ /rang nyid zhi bar 'gyur ba yin/ /kun zhugs sman med par mi zhi/ /zhes bya ba la/ lus can te mi rnams la myos pa dang brgyal ba'i rlung nad la sogs pa'i shugs drag po yod du zin kyang /rang nyid sman gyis bcos mi dgos par rang nyid zhi zhing ldog par 'gyur gyi/kun du zhugs pa'am kun du song ba zhes bya ba'i brgyal ba'i nad ni sman gyis ma bcos par zhi zhing ldog par mi 'gyur ro/ /kun du zhugs pa zhes gang zhig la bya zhe na/ de'i phyir smras pa ni/ nad ni shin tu stobs che ba/ /'dus pa las gyur kun zhugs pa/ /srog gi gnas la brten pa yis②/ /lus dang ngag yid spyod pa 'phrog /de yis (1skyes bu ro dang ni/ /shing dang rtsig pa 'dra bar byed—/ /rings par gso bar ④ma byas na/ /myur du 'chi bar byed pa yin⑤/ /zhes bya ba la/ rlung la sogs pa'i nad shin tu stobs che zhing dkyel cher sogs pa ༅rang gi rgyu'i khyad par gyi tshogs pas nus pa thams cad 'dus par gyur cing gsum char bya ba'i rtsom pa gcig la zhugs shing 'bras bu gcig 'byed ⑦par byed pa'i kun du zhugs pa'i nad srog gi gnas ⑤snying ga'i gnad la brten cing 'dug par gyur pa na kun du zhugs pa zhes bya ba'i brgyal ba'i nad du 'gyur te/ lus dang ngag dang yid kyi spyod pa 'phrog cing bsdus nas kun du zhugs pa des skyes bu shi ba'i ro dang 'dra bar 'gyur gyikhye/ shing dang rtsig pa ltar sems med par byed pa yin la/ des na ⑩gal te nad de dag gso ba myur du ⑪ma byas na myur zhing rings pa nyid du srog dang bral bar byed pa yin no/ /mtsho zab chu srin mang po can/ /chu 'jing 'jug ngogs med par ni/ /kun zhugs pa ni ⑫nub byed las/ /mi ni myur du gdon par bya/ /zhes bya ba la/ de bas na sman 113—1100

pas kun du zhugs pa zhes bya ba'i nad mi bzad ①pas zin cing sdug bsngal de'i 'dam du bying ba'i mi myur du gdon par bya ste/ de yang dper na mtsho shin tu zab cing rtogs par dka' la/ chu srin byis pa gsod ④la sogs pa'i srog chags gdug pa mang pos gang ba'i chu 'jing 1pha rol du byung ba'i 'jug ngogs med par nub par gyur pa dag ni/ nyam nga ba'i gnas yin pas myur du gdon dgos pa dang 'dra'o/ /rigs pas brten ④dang bral ba'i chang 'thungs pas/ /stsos dregs khro dang bral ba'i shārang bzhin can/ /rang gi dgra bos yongs su 'khyud 'gyur zhing sde/ /rigs dang mi rigs mnyam par byed par 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba la/ chang rigs shing ⑦'os par brten ④pa dang bral ba ste 'og nas smos pa'i stobs dang dus la sogs pa dang sbyar ba med pa ni/ rigs par brten ⑨pa dang bral ba zhes bya ba ste/ de lta bu'i rigs par brten pa med pa ⑩chang 'thungs pas ni myos pa la sogs par ngang gis te⑪/ lus dang lhan cig skyes pa'i dgra bo 'jig rten 'di dang phyi ma'i yon tan 'joms shing 'phrog par byed pas dgra bo ltar gnod par byed pa'i dgra bo rnams ⑫yongs su 'khyud par gyur cing shin tu brtse bar gyur pa ma yin zhing / de bzhin du rigs pa dang mi rigs pa cha mnyam zhing mtshungs pa nyid du sems par 'gyur ba ste/ bya ba dang bya ba ma yin pa'i bye brag phyed par mi 'gyur ro zhes bya ba'i don no/ /stobs dang dus dang yul dang goms spyopa dang / /rang bzhin grogs dang na tshod nad rnams ni/ /legs brtags de dang rjes mthun gang zhig 'thung / /de ni bdud rtsi 'thungs dang mtshungs pa stsoyin/ /zhes bya ba la/ lus kyi nyams stobs dang / dus la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid dam rang bzhin blos legs par 113—1101

rtogs shing ①so sor phyed ⑤nas de dang mtshungs ①par skyes bu gang zhig chang ran zhing ④dus la bab par 'thungs pa de ni bdud rtsi 'thungs pa dang mtshungs pa yin te 5/ skyes bu rigs pa dang ldan par 'thungs pas ⑥gnod pa med par ⑦lus bde bar byed pa'i rgyu yin pa'i phyir ro/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa'i rnam par 'grel pa tshig gi don gyi zla zer zhes bya ba/ slob dpon zla ba la dga' bas nges par sbyar ba las/ nad gzhi'i gnas kyi skele'u drug pa'i rnam par 'grel pa'o// //de nas gzhang 'brum gyi nad gzhi bshad par bya'o/ /zhes bya ba la ji ltar kun du zhugs pa zhes bya ba'i nad bshad ma thag pa de ni srog gi gnas snying la brten cing 'byung ba de bzhin du/ 'dir yang srog gi gnas gzhang la brten te ⑫'byung bas na srog gi gnas la brten par chos mthun pa'i phyir/de'i 'og tu ⑩'di brtsams pa yin no/ /dgra ltar srog chags rnams kyi tshe/ /gzhang 'brum byung bas gsod byed pas/ /de phyir bshang ba'i lam 'gegs pas⑪//gzhang 'brum zhes ni bshad pa yin/ /zhes bya ba la/ gzhang 'brum ni gzhang khar sha'i mdzer pa sbom po skyes pa yin la/ de ni dgra bo ltar srog chags rnams kyi tshe 'phrog cing gzhang 'brum du skyes pas gsod par byed pa'i phyir nges par spyotshig gi tshul gyis na gzhang 'brum zhes bya'o/ /nad kyis lpags spyotshil sha rnams ni—/ /gnod byas dbyebs ni sna tshogs pa'i⑩/ /sha yi myu spyogu gzhang sogs su//skyes de gzhang 'brum yin par bshad/ /ces bya ba la/ nad ces bya ba ni rlung la sogs pa ste/ des pags pa dang tshil dang sha rnams la gnod cing ma 113—1102

rungs par byas nas/ dbyibs dang kha dog sna tshogs shing tha dad pa'i sha'i myu gu sha mdzer sbom po lta bu gnod pa sna tshogs skyed pa gzhang la sogs par skyes shing byung bar gyur pa de la ni gzhang 'brum gyi nad ces bya ba yin par drang srong rnams kyis ①bshad do/ /lhan cig skyes dang phyis 'byung ⑤dang / /skam dang khrag tu 'dzag pa yi/ /dbye bas mdor na rnam gnyis yin/ /zhes bya ba la/gzhang 'brum kyi nad de ni mdor na rnam pa gnyis yin te/ la la ni lhan cig skyes te 'byung ①ba yin la/ la la ④skyes nas phyis 'byung bar 'gyur ba dang /yang de bzhin du skam pa dang gsher ba'i dbye bas kyang rnam pa gnyis su 'gyur te/la la ni skam por gnas pa yin la/ la la ni khrag 'dzag pa dang bcas pa yin no—/ /gzhang ni rgyu ma sbom por brten 7/ /sor ni phyed dang lnga yod do/ /zhes bya ba la/ gzhang ni rgyu ma'i zhabs rgyu ma sbom po la brten cing gnas pa de'i tshad ⑦ni sor phyed dang lnga yod pa yin no/ /gnyer ⑦gsum sor ni phyed dang gnyis/ /zhes bya ba la/ gzhang de ni gnyer ma'i rim pa gsum re re zhing sor phyed dang gnyis gnyis ⑧yod do/ /rim pa de yi nang ma ni/ /phyir 'phul bar ma sel ba yin/ /de yi phyi rol 'dzums pa yinarjo/ /zhes bya ba la/rim pa de rnams kyi rim spyopa nang ma'am/ phugs ma ni dri ma rnams phyir 'phul zhing 'bab par byed pa yin la/ gnyer ma'i rim pa bar ma ni dri ma rnams sel zhing ⑪phyir 'byin pa yin pas na sel ba zhes bya la/ phyi rol gyi gnyer ⑫ma ni dri ma la sogs pa mi ⑫'byung bar sdom zhing 'dzums par byed pas na 'dzums pa zhes bya'o/ /de yi (stephyi rol sor gcig skekha/ /nas ni phyed dang gnyis kyi ⑩tshad—/ /de phan chad ni spu skye 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba la/ 'dzums pa de'i phyi 113—1103

rol sor gcig ni gzhang kha zhes bya la/ gzhang kha de'i tshad ni nas phyed dang gnyis kyi ⑦ tshad yin no/ /gzhang kha'i tshigs ⑤de thams cad ni rkub tu spu skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de la lhan cig skyes pa'i rgyu/ /gnyer ma'i sa bon gnod 'gyur nyid/ /gzhang 'brum/ zhes bya ba la/ de la lhan cig skyes pa dang phyis 'byung ba'i gzhang 'brum gnyis las/ lhan cig skyes pa'i gzhang 'brum 'byung ba'i rgyu ni gnyer ma de 'byung zhing dang por skyes pa nyid kyi tshe/ de'i sa bon khu khrag la sogs pa la rlung las gos par gnod par gyur pa de nyid las gzhang 'brum 'byung ba'o/ /sa bon gnod pa yang / pha mas mi 'phrod zos pa dang / /sngon las/ zhes bya ba la/ sa bon de la gnod par byed pa'i rgyu ni rnam pa gnyis te/ pha dang mas kha zas mi 'phrod ③pa gzhang 'brum skyed ④pa'i rgyu zos pa dang / sngon bdag nyid kyis ⑤de lta bu'i nad ke 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i las byas shing bsags pa'o/ /de gnyis dang 'dus pa/ 'khrugs pa las gyur ⑦de dag ni/ /gsor mi rung ba nyid du bshad/ /ces bya ba la/pha dang ma'i gnod pa'i rgyu dang / sngon gyi las de gnyis dang / nad gzhi 'dus par 'khrugs pa gang yin pa las gyur pa de dag ni gang gi phyir gsor mi rung ba nyid yin te lhan cig skyes pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ / rigs 'byung nad kun de 5dang 'dra/ /zhes bya ba la/ nad gzhan gang yang rung ba kun kyang de dang rngu'adra ste/ dang po lhan cig skyes pa ni gsor mi rung ngo zhes tshig 'dis ston pa yin no/ /lhan cig skyes pa khyad par du/ /rtsub cing brta bar dka' ba dang / /nang du kha bltas ⑩dkar ba dang / /bla brnan ( skyumi bzad can gso dka'—/ /zhes bya ba la/ lhan cig skyes pa'i gzhang 'brum de yang khyad par 113—1104

'di dag dang ldan na lhag par gso dka' ste/ reg pa rtsub par gnas pa dang /brta zhing brtags ①par dka' ba dang / kha nang du blta ⑤zhing phyir mi ③phyogs pa dang / kha dog dkar ba dang / bla brnan ④gyi nad mi bzad pa yod pa ni gso dka' zhing bcos su mi rung ba yin no/ /cig shos drug ste nad tha dad/ /'dres dang 'dus pa khrag las byung / /zhes bya ba la/ lhan cig 'byung ba las cig shos su gyur pa'i phyir khye'abyung ba'i gzhang 'brum ni rnam pa drug yod de/nad tha dad pa las byung ba gsum dang 'dres pa las byung ba dang 'dus pa las byung ba dang khrag las byung ba'o/ /rlung dang bad kan gnyis las duskam/ /khrag dang mkhris pa las rlan can/ /zhes bya ba la/ de la gzhang 'brum skam po khrag mi 'dzag pa ni rlung dang bad kan gnyis 'dus pas zin pa las 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /gzhang 'brum rlan can khrag 'dzag pa ni khrag dang mkhris du /pa 'dres pas zin pa las 'byung bar ⑤'gyur ro/ /nad rnams ldang rgyu sngar bshad pa/ /zhes bya ba la/ nad rnams ldang zhing 'khrugs ⑨pa'i rgyu gang yin pa ni sngar nad ⑪ thams cad kyi nad gzhi bshad ⑪pa'i skabs su skyobashad cing bstan pa yin no/ /'khrugs spyopa de yis khong pa yi/ /me drod nyams shing bshang ba 'phel/ /gzhan yang nyal po ⑫rab drags dang / / bzhon pas ⑫khong 'khrugs stan dag ⑩ni/ /ma snyoms sra dang tsog ⑩pur 'dug /'jam rtsi gce 'u sa dang ni/ /rdo dang gos kyis brud pa dang / /shin tu grang ba'i chus bkrus dang / /rtag tu 'khru bar byed pa dang / /bshang dang gci dang 'phyen ⑫gyi shugs/ /bkag dang nan gyis btsir ba dang / /rims dang skran dang tshad par 'khruspyo/ /'or nad skya rbab bee'u snabs kyis/ /skem rngu /byas gnod par 113—1105

'gyur ba yi/ /spyod pa bsten las 'byung bar ①'gyur/ /bud med zla grangs ma tshang 'phyil/ /zla ba sdogs pas 7gzir las 'byung / /de 'dra dag dang 1gzhan yang rlung bu/ /thur sel 'khrugs pas dri ma ni/ /gzhang gi ⑤gnyer mar de gzhag pyapas/ /de ⑦ni mi mngon gyur pas ⑧gnas/ /gzhang 'brum 'byung bar 'gyur ba yin/ /zhes bya ba la/ nad ldang ba'i rgyu des khong pa'i me drod nyams shing bri la bshang ba zhes bya ba'i dri ma 'phel bar byed pa dang /rgyu gzhan yang bud med la 'khrig bu/pa spyad pa'i nyal po drags par bya ba ⑩dang /bzhon pa las khong 'khrugs pa ste/ rta la sogs pa'i bzhon pa mi ⑪srun pas g.yengs shing 'khrugs par byas pa ⑫dang / stan ⑫mtho dman ma snyoms pa la 'dug pa dang / stan srab pa ④la 'dug pa dang / rtag tu tsog spupur 'dug pa dang / 'jam rtsi gce'u legs par ma btang bas snad pa dang / sa gzhi dang rdo la sogs pas brud ⑩de snad par byas pa dang / shin tu rgyun mi 'chad par chu grang mos bkrus shing reg par byas pa dang / rtag par rgyun tu 'khru bar byed pa dang / bshang ba la sogs pa'i shugs 'byung ba bkag cing brnag pa dang / de dag nyid mi 'byung bzhin du nan gyis btsir ba dang / rims la sogs pa'i nad kyis skem ⑫zhing rid par byas pa dang / lus la sogs pa la spyoganod cing gdung bar 'gyur ba'i las kyi spyod pa bsten pa ⑪de dag las gzhang ⑥'brum 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /yang bud med rnams la ni nad de dag gi steng du zla ba ma tshang zhing / mngal na gnas pa'i sems can skye ba'i dus la ma bab cing / 'phyil ba dang zla ba rdzogs shing tshang bar 7'dug kyang de 3gzir ba ste gnod pa dang bcas par bu btsas pa las gzhang 'brum 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /113—1106

nad kyi rgyu de 'dra ba de dag dang / rnam pa gzhan yang thur du sel ba zhes bya ba'i rlung 'khrugs shing gnod par 'gyur bas ①dri ma sogs par byed de/gzhang gi gnyer ma'i gnas su bkag nas gnas par byed la/ des na gzhang gi gnyer ma de rnams su ni mi mngon par gnas shing gseb tu zhugs pa de dag rul bar 'gyur ba'i gnod pas nyen nas gzhang ⑤'brum skye bar 1'gyur ba yin no—/ /de yi rjosngon tshul me rjodrod nyams/ /brla ni rengs shing na ba dang / /byin pa'i nywa rjon mgo 'khor zhing / /yan lag na zhing mig gnyis skrang mu/ /bshang ba 'khru ba'am ⑧yang na sri⑨/ /rlung chen nang nas ⑩'khyil pa dang / /phal cher lte ba'i 'og nas ⑪rgyu/ /nad bcas bcad pa lta bur sems/ / dka' bar ⑫'byung zhing sgra can 'byung / /rgyu ma krul krul ⑫zer zhing spo/ /skem ④zhing sgregs pa mang du 'byung / /gcin mang bshang nyung yi ga 'chus/ /sgregs pa dud 'dra skyur ba 'byung / /mgo dang rgyab dang brang du gzer/ /snyom ⑫zhing kha dog nyams pa dang / /glong ⑩bag dbang po nyam chung dang ⑩/ /khro zhing bsnyen bkur dka' ba dang / /ma zhu skem nad skya rbab dang / /dmu rdzing sternams la som nyi skyesaspyo/ /zhes bya ba la/ gzhang 'brum de rnams kyi sngon bubyung ba'i tshul lam/ gzugs ni pho ba'i me drod nyams shing stsobri ba dang /brla thog thag na ba dang / byin pa gnyis kyi nya gcus ⑦pa snyam du sems shing na ba la sogs pa dang / bshang ba ched 'ga' ni 'khru zhing sla la/ ched 'ga' ni sri zhing rtug skam du 'byung ba dang / rlung che zhing mang ba dang / rgyu ma'i ④lam bkag nas ④nad nang du 'khyil zhing mi thon pa dang / de nyid kyis na phal cher nad lte ba'i nang na rgyu zhing zug pa dang / phan tshun gzer ba'i 113—1107

nad dang bcas pa dang / rgyu ma'i nang kun du bcad pa snyam du sems pa dang /'byung bar dka' zhing thogs la phyir 'byung ba ①yang sgra can du 'byung ba dang /rgyu ma'i nang phan tshun krul krul zer zhing 'khrog pa dang sbo ba ①dang / skem zhing rid pa la sogs pa dang / gregs pa dud pa dang 'dra bar dku bar 'ong zhing skyur bar 'byung ba dang / mgo la sogs pa ①gzer zhing na ba dang / snyom zhing na ba dang / las la mi brtson pa dang / kha dog nyams pa ste/ thal ba'i rang bzhin kyi kha dog las gzhan du gyur pa med pa dang / spro ba med pa dang / dbang po nyam chung zhing rang rang gi las la 'jug ④mi nus pa dang /khro zhing sems 'khrugs 5pa dang / bsnyen bkur dka' zhing sdug bsngal bas bsnyen bkur bya dgos pa dang / ma zhu ba'i gnas medamu rdzing gi bar gyi gnas ⑦rnams yod par som nyi skyes shing dogs skepar 'gyur ba yin no/ /gzhang 'brum skye bar gyur pa ⑨la/ /'di dag nyid ni 'phel bar 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba la/ gzhang 'brum gyi nad skyes shing byung ⑩ bar gyur pa la/ sngar byung ba'i tshul gyis rtags 'di dag nyid 'phel zhing de'i tshul gsal ba nyid du 'gyur ro/ / de yis (/7'og gi lam bkag pas/ /thur du sel ba'i rlung ldog ste/ /lus dang dbang po kun gnas pa'i/ /rlung gzhan thams cad 'khrugs ⑫par byed/ /de bzhin bshang gci mkhris pa dang / /bad kan lus zungs rten bcas pa/ / 'khrugs shing 7me drod nyams par byed/ /ces bya ba la/ gzhang 'brum des ④ 'og gi lam bshang sgo zhes bya ba bkag pas thur du sel ba'i rlung 'byung bar ldog ⑫/pa na lam bkag pa'i phyir rlung de slar ldog par byed la/ de ltar ldog pa des lus dang dbang po'i tshogs kun la gnas shing brten ⑩pa'i rlung dang me dang 113—1108

mnyam ①du gnas pa dang / khyab byed dang stod du rgyu ba dang / srog cas bya ba thams cad 'khrugs shing ②g.yo bar byed la/ de bzhin du bshang gci la sogs pa rten nam gnas dang bcas pa dang 'khrugs shing ①g.yo bar byed la/khong pa'i me drod kyang nyams par byed do zhes bya bar sbyar ro/ /de nas gzhang 'brum nad can la/ /phal cher thams cad nyer 'byung ④ba/ /skem zhing mchog tu bskyod mi nus/ /stobs zad khong rmya bzhin mdangs nyams/ /lus lhod snying po med 'gyur zhing / /'bus zos pa yi shing 'dra la/ /bla brnan dum lus dag gis 'debs/ /ji skad bshad pa'i gnad gzir zhing ⑦/ /lud pa skam skedang skad 'gags dang / /khas ro mi tshor cham 'debs sgo/ /sgyid skyur rkang lag na zhing slon/ / dzred pa skrang ⑨dang rims nad dang / /khu ba zad cing rab rib slon⑩/ /rde'u chags nad kyis gzir ba dang / /skad 'gags zhum la sems khong chud/ /mchil ma mang 'dor yi ga 'chus/ /rus tshigs kun dang snying lte ba/ /gzhang dang rna (3rtsar gzer dang bcas/ /gzhang nas 'bru ni ma smin btsos⑫/ /khu ba lta bu'i sbyin bag 'dzag /rtug skam sbyin pa'ang ⑫sla bar 'gyur/ /smin dang ma smin bar bar 'khru/ /skya zhing ser dang sngon po yi/ /khrag ni sbyin bag 'khru bar 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba la/de nas sngon po'i khya9tshul gyi 'og tu gzhang 'brum kyi nad can la phal cher 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i tshul ni skem zhing sbeg (nyepa dang / mchog tu smra'am ⑩shin tu bskyod par mi nus shing rtsol ba chung ba dang / nyams stobs zad cing nus pa chung ba dang / khong pa rmya zhing sgyid zhan pa dang / bzhin mdangs nyams shing bzhin ras kyi mdog mi sdug pa dang / lus lhod cing bya ba mi lcogs pa 113—1109

dang / snying po ltar sra zhing mkhrang ba'i bag med de/ de yang dper na 'bus zos pa'i shing ltar shin tu snyi stizhing snying po med pa yin no/ /de bzhin du bla brnan ①gyi nad du ma gzhan ji skad bshad ①pa rnams kyis kyang 'debs par 'gyur ba dang / de bzhin du sngar ji skad bshad pa'i gnad rnams gzir zhing ④gnod par 'gyur ba dang / de bzhin du lud pa la sogs pas gnod cing nyen par 'gyur ba dang / yang de bzhin du skad 'gags pa dang / skad gsang ⑤zhum par 'gyur ba dang / sems khong du ⑥chud cing yid la byed pas gnas dzeepa dang / mchil ma mang du 'byung zhing bad kan las kyis ④ljan ljin mang du 'dor ba dang / yi ga 'chus pa la sogs pa'i nad dang bcas par 'gyur ba dang / de bzhin du rjom smin pa btsos pa'i khu ba lta bur sbyin bag ⑩tu 'dug cing 'byil ba gzhang kha nas 'dzag par 'gyur ba dang / de bzhin du bar skabs bar skabs su lan 'ga' ni bshang ba sri zhing 'gags pas ⑪rtug skam du 'gyur la/ lan 'ga' ni 'khru zhing bee bag tu 'byung bar 'gyur la/ de bzhin du lan 'ga' ni smin par 'khru/ lan 'ga' ni ma smin par 'khru ba nas sbyin bag tu ⑫'khru bar 'gyur ro/ /gzhang 'brum rlung shas che las gyur/ /skem zhing tseg tseg ⑫tsha ba dang / /rnyid ④cing dmar nag rengs pa dang / /mi snyoms rtsub cing sra ba dang / /phan tshun mi 'dra yo ba dang / /rtse mo rno zhing gas pa dang / /bim pa rgya shug 7khardzu ra/ /ras bal sa bon dang 'dra zhing / /la la ka dam me tog 'dra/ /la la yungs kar lta bur skyes/ /mgo dang phrag pa rtsib logs brla/ /chu so dag tu lhag par na/ / sprud pa sgregs ⑩pa bshang ba sriske/ /snying 'phar yi ga 'chus pa skyed/ /lud ⑫dbugs mi bde me drod 113—1110

nyams—/ /rna ba sgra bcas mgo 'khor byed/ /des nyen rtug skam ⑨nyung ngu ni/ /sgra bcas ska rjosla 'dren ma dang / /na zhing lbu ④ba 'byar bag can/ /rtug skam ④tshul gyis 'byung bar 'gyur/ /pags pa sen mo bshang gci dang / /mig dang gdong ni gnag par 'gyuradhi/ /skran dang mcher pa dmu rdzing ⑥ dang / /gtun 'dra de nyid las 'byung 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba la/ gzhang 'brum gyi nad rlung gi shas che zhing rgyas pa las ④ni gzhang 'brum skam zhing khrag mi 'dzag cing skam pa dang / yungs kar gyi lde skegus bskus pa ltar tsha ba'i bag tseg tseg por byed pa dang / rnyid ⑨cing rtse mo yo ba dang / mdog dmar nag tu 'dug pa dang / phur pa ltar rengs shing 'greng ba dang / dbyebs mtho ⑪ dman mi snyoms pa dang / sog le'i kha ⑪ltar rtsub pa dang / rdo la reg pa ltar sra ba dang / dbyebs phan tshun gcig la gcig ⑫mi 'dra ba dang / yo zhing gzhu ltar gug pa dang / rtse mo spyoltar rno ba dang / rtse mo gas shing kha bye ba dang /bim pa zhes bya ba 'bras bu dmar po zhig yod spyopa'am/ rgya shug spyophra mo'i 'bras bu'am shing khardzu ra'i 'bras bu'am ras bal gyi sa bon dang 'dra zhing mtshungs par skye ba dang / yang la la ni ka dam pa'i me tog dang 'dra bar skye la/gzhang 'brum la la ()yungs kar kyi tshad tsam du phra ba skye bar 'gyur ba dang /yang de bzhin du mgo bo la sogs pa lhag par na zhing zug pa dang / sprid pa la sogs pa mang ba dang / bshang ba sri ba la sogs pa nas/ rtug skam gyi ⑩tshul gyis bshang ba 'byung bar 'gyur ba dang / pags pa la sogs pa gnag par 'gyur ba dang / yang rlung gi gzhang 'brum de nyid las ⑫skran la sogs pa yang 'byung bar 'gyur ba yin no/ /mkhris shas ⑪che la rtse mo ni/ /sngo ⑥zhing dmar 113—1111

ser dkar bar snang / /phra shezhing dri mnam khrag sla 'dzag /srab cing 'jam la lhod pa yin/ /mcher pa'i dum bu nee tso'i 2lce/ /srin bu pad pa'i 1mchu 'drar snang / /tsha zhing rnags 4la rims dang rngul/ /skom dad yi ga 'chus rmongs skyed/ /bshang dro 5sla zhing sngo la tsha/ /ser zhing dmar bar 'khru bar 'gyur / /nas 6rul nang 'dra pags pa dang / /sen sogs sngo ser ljang bar 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba la/ mkhris pa shas che ba las gyur pa'i gzhang 'brum ni 'brum bu'i rtse mo sngon po dang / kha dog dmar ser dang dkar por snang ba dang / phra zhing chung ba la sogs pa dang / mtsher pa'i dum bu la sogs pa gang yang rung ba'i rnam pa 'dra ba tsha ba la sogs pa'i bla brnan 7rked pa dang /bshang ba dro zhing sla ba la sogs pa gang yang rung ba'i rnam par 'khru ba dang /nas rul ba'i nang gi dbyibs 'dra ba dang /— pags pa dang sen mo dang mig dang bzhin dang dri ma rnams sngo zhing ser ba dang ljang bar 'gyur ro / /bad kan shas che rtsa ba sgom/ /mthug cing nad kyi shugs dal dkar/ /skrangs shing rgyas la snum pa dang / /'greng zhing zlum la lci zhing brtan/ /'byar bag tshor 1 ba chung zhing 'jam/ /g.ya' zhing reg na dga' bar byed/ /ka ri ra pa na sa yi/ /rus pa ba yi nu sor 'dra/ /chu sor zug cing spo gzhang na/ /lte ba beeng pa bcad snyam sems/ /lud pa dbugs mi bde snying na/ /mchil mang cham 'debs yi ga 'chus/ /gcin sri mgo bo tshor ba med/ /grang ba'i rims ni khyed par byed/ /kha kichu 'dzag cing me drod nyams/ /slon zhing ma zhu'i nad kun skyed/ /bshang ba tshil 'dra bad kan mang / /'khru dang bcas pa 1rte'abyung bar 'gyur/ /'dzag par mi byed rdol mi byed/ /pags pa la 773—1 112

sogs snum zhing dkar/ /zhes bya ba la/ gzhang 'brum bad kan shas che zhing bdo ba las gyur pa'i nad kyeni rtsa ba sbom zhing che ba dang / mthug cing lhun che ba dang / nad kyi shugs dal zhing mi drag pa dang / mdog dkar ba la sogs pa'i rnam pa nas reg na dga' ba'i bar gyi mtshan nyid dang ldan pa dang /shing ka ri ra'i 'bras bu'i rus pa'am/ pa na sa'i 'bras bu'i rus pa dang dbyibs 'dra ba dang / de bzhin du ba'i nu sor gyi dbyibs 'dra ba yin la/de bzhin du chu sor zug pa la sogs pa'i nad skyed pa dang / bshang ba tshil la sogs pa 'byung bar 'gyur ba dang / khrag la sogs pa 'dzag par mi byed cing /rdol 1ba'am kha bye bar yang mi byed pa dang / pags pa dang mig dang sen mo la sogs pa snum zhing mdog dkar bar 'gyur ba yin no/ /'dres las mtshan nyid 'dres ma yin/ /'dus pa 4mtshan nyid kun dang ldan/ /zhes bya ba la/gnyis pa 'dres pa las byung ba'i mtshan nyid ni gang dag las byung 5ba de dag 'dres 6mar snang ba yin la/ nad gsum 'dus pa las byung ba ni mtshan ma thams cad dang ldan pa yin no/ /khrag shas che las gzhang 'brum ni/ /mkhris pa'i mtshan nyid 'dra ba la/ /n+ya gro dha yi myu gu 'dra/ /byi ru 'ol ma se mdog 'dra / /shin tu tsha dro na ba dang / /bshang ba 7shugs kyis rab btsir las/ /'phral 8du khrag ni 'byung ba dang / /de nyid shin tu 'dzag par 'gyur/ /sbal ba 'dra zhing khrag zad las/ /byung ba'i sdug bsngal gyis nyen 'gyur/ /mdog stobs spro ba nyams pa dang / /mdangs 'phrog dbang po zhan 9par 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba la/ khrag shas che zhing rgyas pa las gyur pa'i 7gzhang 'brum ni mkhris pa'i mtshan nyid kyi rnam pa dang 'dra bar 'byung ba dang / dbyibs 1shing n+ya gro

dha'i myu gu dang 'dra zhing / mdog byi 77ru'am 'ol ma se ltar dmar ba yin la/rīgazhang 'brum de ni tsha zhing dro ba dang / na ba dang bshang ba grushugs kyis rab tu bcir ba las 'phral du khrag 'byung zhing / khrag de nyid yang dang yang du /pyashin tu 'dzag par 'gyur ba dang / dbyibs 5sbal ba 'dra ba dang / khrag zad 5pa las byung zhing skyes pa'i sbug bsngal brnag par dka' bas 3nyen cing gzir bye bar 'gyur ba dang / mdog la sogs pa nyams shing shesnabri bar gyur pa dang / mdangs phrogs shing nyams pa dang / dbang po nyam chung shing nus pa zhan par 'gyur ba yin no/ /muṅga ko dra ba'i phye ma/ /tsa na ka ri ra sogs pa/ /rtsub dang bshang ba sri bas rlung / /rang sbyiganas 'khrugs pa rngu stobs ldan pas/ /thur du rgyu ba'i bu ga ni/ /bkag ste smad du rab skams nas/ /bshang ba gci ba 'phyen 7rnams ni/ /'gags pas nad ni mi bzad skyed/ /de yis khong pa rgyab rtsib logs/ /snying gar nad ni shin tu skyed/ /lto sbos gsus pa na ba dang / /snying gcu 1 rgyu ma bcad snyam sems/ /chu sor shin tu zug pa dang / /mkhur bar 7skrang pa 'byung bar 'gyur/ /rlung ni gyen du song gyur na/ /de la slon rims yi ga 'chus/ /snying nad bee'u snabs ma zhu dang / /gcin sri 1gabashang ba 'khru ba dang / /'on dang rab rib dbugs mi bde/ /mgo nad lud pa cham pas 'debs/ /yid kyis 'gyur ba skom dang khrag /mkhris pa skran dang dmu sprung 1 snasogs/ /rlung gi nad gtogs de dang de/ /shin tu mi bzad 'byung bar 'gyur/ /gzhang 'brum gyen du 'khyil gyur pa/ /'di muni mchog tu gnod byed yin/ /zhes bya ba lo/ sran muṅga dang / rtsa 'bru ko dra ba la sogs pa rtsub pa dang / bshang ba sri bar byed pa'i zas kyis thur du sel 113—1114

ba zhes bya ba'i rlung gi gnas 'khrugs shing ldang bar gyur pa stobs dang ldan zhing nus pa che bas thur du rgyu zhing 'bab pa'i bu ga gang yin pa de bkag cing bcad nas—/ ro smad du bshang ba de dag rab tu skams nas/ bshang ba dang gci ba dang 'phyen rnams bkag cing ①phyir ma 'thon pa'i nad shin tu mi bzad cing brnag par dka' ba ④skyed par 'gyur la/ bshang ba la sogs pa 'gags pa des khong pa la sogs par nad shin tu gnod pa skyed la/ lto sbos pa dang gsus pa gcus dhipa lta bur na ba dang / snying gcus pa snyam du sems shing mchil ma 'byung ba dang / rgyu ma'i nang gris bcad pa snyam du sems pa dang / chu so'i phyogs su zug cing na ba dang / mkhur ba gnyis la duskrang pa 'byung bar 'gyur ba dang / rlung de ro stod du gyen du song bar gyur na/ rgyu de las slon pa la sogs pa'i nad rlung las gyur pa'i nad grangs med pa mi bzad pa ⑦du ma dag 'byung bar 'gyur ba dang / gzhang 'brum gyi rgyus rlung gyen du 'khyil pa las gyur pa'i nad 'di ni mchog tu mi bzad rjopar gnod cing sdug bsngal bar byed pa yin no/ /rlung shas che ba'i khong par ni/ /de med par yang de 'byung 'gyur—/ /zhes bya ba la/ khong pa rlung gi shas che zhing lto bar rlung nad rgyas par gyur pa'i srog chags rnams ni gzhang 'brum gyi rgyu de med par yang gyen du 'khyil ba zhes bya ba'i rlung ⑦nad 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /lhan cig skyes dang nad gsum ldan/ /phugs ma'i gnyer mar gang gnas pa/ /de dag gsor mi rung ba yin/ /me drod stobs che sogs kyis 'tsho/ /zhes bya ba la/ gang gi lus la gzhang 'brum lhan cig skyes par gyur pa de ⑧ni gsor mi rung ba yin la/phyis 'byung ba yin du zin kyang nad gzhi gsum char las skyes pa dang / gnyer ma 113—1115

phugs mar gnas pa gang yin pa de dag kyang gsor mi rung ba yin la/ yang de ①ni me drod kyi stobs che ba la sogs pas re zhig 'tsho ②ba tsam du gnas su rung ste/ sogs pa zhes smos pas lus kyi stobs dang / sman gyi ①sbyor ba dang /goms pa dang / sngon gyi las la sogs pa bsdu'o/ /'dres las gyur dang gnyer ma ni/ /bar mar gnas pa gang yin pa/ /lo gcig yan chad lon gyur pa/ /de dag gso dka' yin par bshad/ /ces bya ba la/ yang gzhang 'brum nad gzhi gnyis 'dres par gyur pa dang / de bzhin du gnyer ma rim pa gnyis par brten zhing rjoganas pa dang / de bzhin du lo gcig yan chad lon zhing lo 'das 0par gyur pa de dag ni gso dka' ba yin par bshad do/ /phyi rol gnyer mar byung ba dang / /nad gcig bushas che las byung dang / /skyes nas ring por ma lon gang / /gzhang 'brum ⑦de ni gso bar sla/ /zhes bya ba la/ yang gzhang 'brum gang phyi rol kyi gnyer ma'i rim par brten zhing ④byung ba dang / de bzhin du nad gzhi gcig shas che zhing rgyas pa las byung ba dang / de bzhin du skyes nas yun ring por ma lon zhing ⑨lo gcig man chad kyi nang du byung bar gyur pa'i gzhang 'brum de ni gso sla zhing bcos su rung ba yin no/ /pho mtshan sogs kyi 'og nas ni/ /rang rang skabs bshad/ ces bya ba la/pho mtshan dang / mo mtshan dang / rna ba dang sna gong ⑩la sogs par yang 'brum bu 'byung mod kyi/ de dag ni 'og nas lba ⑪ba'i nad kyi mtshan nyid shes par bya ba la sogs pa rang rang gi le'u las bshad do/ /lte bar skyes/ rta bla ba yi kha 'dra zhing / /'byar bag can la 'jam pa yin/ /zhes bya ba la lte bar skyes pa'i 'brum bu ni srog chags rta bla ba zhes bya ba'i ⑫'bu zhig yod pa'i 113—1116

kha dang dbyibs 'dra zhing 'byar bag can la reg na 'jam pa yin no/ /pags pa'i mdzer ①pa smras pa ni/ /khyab byed kyis ⑤ni bad kan bsdus/ /pags pa'i phyi rol thor bur byed/ /mdzer ①pa 'dra zhing rtsub par gnas/ /pags pa'i mdzer rjopa yin par shes/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa yin te/ rlung khyab byed kyis rjobad kan gyi tshogs bsdus nas thor bur rjo'abyung bar byed de/ de yang pags pa'i phyi rol du gnas par byed cing sha'i mdzer pa 'dra bar rtsub cing reg na mi bde bar gnas pa yin la/ de ni mdzer ⑦pa dang 'dra bas na/ pags pa'i mdzer ⑧pa yin par mngon shes can gyi drang srong rnams kyis shes shing khong du chud pa yin no/ /rlung gis zug cing rtsub par 'gyur/ /mkhris pas ⑨gnag la dmar rtsar 'gyur⑪/ /bad kan gyis ni ⑪snum nyid dang / /rmen bu'i ⑫mdog dang 'dra bar 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba la/ pags pa'i mdzer ⑫pa de rlung las gyur pa yin na/ zug cing na la reg pa rtsub par 'gyur ro/ /mkhris pa las gyur na ④mdog gnag la rtsa ⑫dmar bar 'gyur ro/ /bad kan las gyur pa yin na ni pags pa'i mdzer ⑩pa de snum pa nyid dang / chen bu'i mdog dang 'dra zhing mtshungs pa yin no/ /blo dang ldan pas myur bar ni/ /'bad de gzhang 'brum gso bar bya/ /de yis gzhang ni myur bkag nas/ /dmu rdzing nad ni skye bar 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba la/ blo dang ldan zhing mkhas pa'i sman pas ⑩myur zhing rings par 'bad pa dang ldan pas gzhang 'brum gyi nad gso bar bya'o/ /ci'i phyir zhe na/ gzhang 'brum kyi nad des gzhang gi sgo myur du 'gags par byas nasaske/ 'og nas bshad pa'i dmu rdzing gi nad gang yin pa des skyed cing 'byung bar 'gyur ba yin pas/ de'i phyir nad de ⑩shin tu myur ba kho nar gso bar bya'o/ /113—1117

yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa'i rnam par 'grel pa tshig gi don kyi zla zer zhes bya ba/ slob dpon zla ba la dga' bas rnam par ①sbyar ba las/ nad gzhi'i gnas kyi ②le'u bdun pa'i rnam par 'grel pa'o// //de nas tshad par 'khru ba dang pho ba'i nad gzhi ④bshad par bya'o/ /zhes bya ba la/ gzhang 'brum gyi nad gzhi'i 'og tu 'di brtsams ④pa'i 'brel pa ni/zas dang rlung dag ⑤shugs dgag pa la sogs pa rgyu thun mong yin pas bshad pa yin no/ /nad gzhi sna re kun dang ni/ /'jigs rjodang mya ngan las gyur pa'i//tshad par 'khru ba rnam drug yin/ /zhes bya ba la/ tshad par 'khru ba'i spyond ni rlung la sogs pa nad gzhi sna re las gyur pa dang / kun 'dus pa las gyur pa dang / de bzhin du 'jigs ⑧pa las gyur pa dang / mya ngan las gyur pa ste/tshad par 'khru ba ni rnam pa drug tu 'gyur ro/ /de ni chu 'thungs ⑨drags pa dang / /sha rid sha skam ⑩ma goms pa'i/ /til gyi khu ba ma min 'bru/ /chang rtsub kha zas tshod ma zin/ /gzhang 'brum snum bag drags pa dang / /'bu dang shugs ni bkag las 'byung ⑩/ /zhes bya ba la/ yang tshad par 'khru ba de ni chu 'thungs ⑫drags pa la sogs pa ⑫las shin tu skye ④zhing 'byung bar 'gyur ro//yang de bzhin du sha rid dang / sha skam ⑫rul bag zos pa dang / de bzhin du sngar za ma myong zhing ma zos par til btags pa'i khu ba zos pa dang / de bzhin du ma smin pa'i 'bru las byas pa'i kha zas zos pa dang / chang rtsub cing mang bar 'thungs pa dang / de bzhin du zas kyi tshod ma zin par ⑩gsud bag tu zos pa dang / gzhang 'brum gyis btab pa dang / snum bag mang du zos 713—1118

shing drags pa dang / lto na srin bu yod pa dang / bshang ba la sogs pa'i shugs bkag pa las kyang chad par 'khru ba ①'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de 'dras ⑤rlung ni 'khrugs pa yis/ /chu khams thur du bskyod gyur la/ /de nyid kyis ni me drod nyams/ /de 'og khong pa khyab nas ni/ /bshang ba sla ba nyid du byed/ /de ltar tshad 'khru 'byung bar bshad/ /ces bya ba la/ 'dir ma bshad pa de dang tshul mthun pa dag gis ①rlung 'khrugs shing ldang bar gyur nas/ chu'i khams lus la rjogang yod pa 0thur du bskyod cing 'byung bar byed par du'agyur la/de'i 'og tu de'i khams de nyid kyis pho ba'i me drod shin tu nyam chung bar byas nas/de nas de'i 'og tu chu'i khams de nyid kyis multo ba'i nang bshang bas khyab par byas nas/ de nas bshang ba de sla zhing gsher bag nyid du byed par gyur te/tshad par 'khru ba ni tshul de ltar 'byung ba yin par ⑧bshad cing brtags ⑨pa yin no/ /de yi 'byung 'gyur mtshan ma ni/ /bshang lam snying ga lto bar zug /lus snyom bshang ⑪ba sri ba dang / /sbo zhing kha zas mi 'ju ba'o/ /zhes bya ba la⑪/tshad par 'khru ba de phyis 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i mtshan ma'am rtags ni bshang ba las gzhang kha'i phyogs dang snying ga dang lto ba'i phyogs su zug cing na ba dang /lus dang yan lag snyom ⑫zhing phyi ba dang / bshang ba sri ⑫ba la sogs pa 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ / de las rlung gyur bshang chur ④bcas/ /nyung zhig ske'abyung zhing gzer sgra bcas/ / 'gags shing ⑫'byung bar 'gyur ba dang / /rtsub bee lbu ⑩bar bcas pa 'am/ /gong bur yang dang yang du 'byung / /de bzhin bu ram tshig pa 'dra/ /sbyin bag bcas shing bcad (stesnyam sems/ /kha skam gzhang ni snad pa dang / /spu langs pa dang 'khru ⑪ba yin/ /zhes bya ba la/113—1119

tshad par 'khru ba de dag gi nang nas rlung las gyur pa'i 'khru ba ni bshang ba na ba ①dang chur bcas te/ chu rul ba lta bu ④'byung ba dang / mkhregs shing nyung zhig 'byung ba dang / sgra dang bcas shing gzer ba dang bcas par 'byung bar 'gyur ba dang / 'gags shing ska ⑤bar 'byung bar 'gyur ba dang / mdog rtsub pa dang / sla zhing rkyang rkyang por 'byung ba dang / lbu rjob dang 'dren mar 'byung ba dang / gong bur chags shing bar bar na mdud pa yod pa 'dra bar 'byung ba dang / yang dang yang du skad cig ma re rer rjo'abyung ba dang / de bzhin du bu ram tshig pa'i mdog 'dra bar 'byung ba dang / sbyin bag la sogs pa'i rnam pa dang ldan par 'khru ba yin no/ /mkhris pas duser zhing gnag pa dang / /sngo zhing du ba'i ⑦mdog 'dra la/ /khrag bcas shin tu dri mnam pa/ /skom dad brgyal tshe rngul dang bcas/ /gzer bcas gzhang skekha tsha dang bcas/ /gzhang khar thor bu 'byung ba yin/ /zhes bya ba la/ mkhris pa las gyur pa'i tshad par 'khru ba ni/ 'khru ba'i mdog ser po la sogs par 'khru bar 'gyur te/tshig gi don ni go bar zad do/ /bad kan las gyur ska ⑨ba dang / /'byar bag ska ⑩zhing nal nal po/ /snum zhing bee'u snabs bad kan bcas/ /rgyun du 'khru zhing phyi la mnam/ /ska ⑪zhing nad rjes 'brang ba dang / /gnyid che khong snyom ⑩yi ga 'chus/ /nyung zad nyuminyung zad 'khru dang bcas/ /ba spu brtse zhing glongs ⑩bcas dang / /chu so lto ba gzhang kha lci/ / bshang yang ⑫bshang ba ma btang snyam/ /zhes bya ba la/ bad kan las gyur pa'i tshad par 'khru ba ni 'khru ⑩ba ska zhing gar ⑩gar por 'byung bar 'gyur ba dang / 'byar bag la sogs pa dang bcas par 'byung ba dang / khong snyom pa ni ⑫bya ba rnams la spro 113—1120

ba chung ba'o/ /glongs pa ni nad rnams bskyod ①par gyur pa'o/ /lci ba ni chu so dang lto ba dang gzhang kha kun tu lci zhing sbom pa snyam du sems pa'o/ / bshang yang ②bshang ba ma btang ba snyam du sems pa ni bshang ba bshang zhing 'dor ①du zin kyang khong lci bas ma bshang ba snyam du sems shing yang dang yang du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /kun skyes mtshan nyid kun dang ldan/ /zhes bya ba la/ nad gzhi kun 'dus pa las skyes pa'i tshad par 'khru ba ni nad gzhi ④gsum char gyi mtshan nyid dang ldan pa yin no/ /'jigs rjopas sems ni 'khrugs gyur pa/ /rlung gis mkhris bcas bshang ba ni/ /sla byed de nas 'khru ba ni/ /tsha zhing sla la 'phyo ba dang du/ /mtshan ma rlung mkhris las byung 'dra/ /mya ngan las byung de dang 'dra/ /zhes bya ba la/ 'jigs pa'i rgyus sems 'khrugs shing glongs par gyur pa rlung gis mkhris pa dang bcas pa'i bshang ba sla zhing gsher bar byed ⑦ la—/ de nas de'i 'og tu tshad par 'khru ba 'byung bar 'gyur ba ni 'khru ba'i rang bzhin tsha zhing dro ba dang / sla zhing gar bag med pa dang / 'phyo zhing chur mi 'bying ba dang / mtshan ma rlung dang mkhris pa las byung ba dang 'dra ba yin par slob dpon rnams kyis bshad do/ /mya ngan las byung ba'i tshad par 'khru ba'i mtshan nyid kyang rlung ⑧dang mkhris pa las byung ba'i tshul de dang mtshungs shing 'dra ba yin par bshad do/ /mdor na tshad 'khru rnam gnyis te/ /ma zhur bcas dang ma zhu ⑨med/ /khrag bcas khrag med/ ces bya ba la/ tshad par 'khru ba ni mdor ⑩na rnam pa gnyis yin te/ smin pa dang ma smin pa'i rnam pa'am—/ khrag dang bcas pa'am khrag med pa'i rnam pas so/ /de las ni/ /dang po bshang gci chur 'bying 'gyur/ /dri mnam lto ni spo ba dang / /113—1121

mkhregs shing mchil snabs shin tu mang / /zhes bya ba la/ tshad par 'khru ba min pa dang ma smin pa ①de gnyis kyi ②nang nas/ dang po ma smin pa'i 'khru ba'i mtshan nyid ni 'khru bar 'byung ba'i bshang ba de rang bzhin lci zhing / chu la bcug na ④nang du 'bying zhing nub par 'gyur ba dang / dri mnam zhing nga ba dang / lto sbo ba la sogs pa dang ldan par 'gyur ba yin no/ /smin pa de las bzlog pa yin/ /zhes bya ba la/ bshang ba rjosmin pa'i mtshan nyid de las go ⑤bzlog pa yin te/ bshang ba yang zhing chur mi 'bying ba dang / lhag par dri nga ba med pa dang / lto sbo ba la sogs pa rjomed pa yin no/ /bad kan smin pa'am ④chu nang 'bying / /zhes bya ba la/ bad kan gyi rgyu las tshad par 'khru ba ni/ smin zhing ma zhu ba med pa yin yang chu'i nang du 'bying bar 'gyur ba yin no/ /gang zhig tshad 'khru 'bad pa ni/ /med des pho ba'i nad du 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba la/ skyes bu gang la tshad pa'i nad kyis ⑤thebs par gyur nas spang bar bya ba'i dngos po spang bar bya ba la 'bad pa med par gyur na/ des ⑨grang ba la sogs pa'i pho ba'i nad du 'gyur ro/ /me drod nyams par byed pa yi/ /zas bsten ⑩pa yis me drod nyams/ /zhes bya ba la/ pho ba'i nad de yang khong pa'i me drod nyams par byed pa'i kha zas dang btung ba bsten zhing ⑪longs spyod pa las me drod nyams shing grang ba'i pho ba'i nad du 'gyur ro/ /pho ba'i nad dang tshad par 'khru ba la khyad par ci zhig yod ce na/ de'i phyir smras pa ni/gang zhig zhu nas bshang ba ni/ /be'u snabs bcas dang bee'u snabs med/ /'khru ba de ni tshad 'khru ste/ /rang bzhin gyis ni myur gsod byed/ /ces bya ba la—/ nad kyi khya5khyad par gang dag gis zas zhu bar gyur nas bshang ba be'u 113—1122

snabs dang bcas pa'am/ be'u snabs med pa'i rnam par 'khru bar gyur pa ni ①tshad par 'khru ba zhes bya ste/ de ni rang gi rang bzhin gyis myur du gsod cing gnod par byed pa yin no/ /ma zhu kha zas ma zhu dang / /zhu ba smin pa'ang ①mi 'khru 'gyur/ /rgyu med yang dang yang sri ①ba'am/ /rgyu med yang yang bee bar 'byung / /pho bar ma zhu sogs shing 'khru/ /yun ring na bar byed pa yin/ / zhes bya ba ladu/ pho ba grang ba'i ma zhu ba'i nad ni bshang ba ma zhu ba'i bee'u snabs sam/ zas dang bcas par nges par 'khru bar 'gyur la/ zas zhu nas ni bshang ba sri bar 'byung bar mi 'gyur bas ma smin par 'khru bar 'gyur ro//yang rgyu med par glo bur du bshang ba de yang dang yang du sri ba dang / yang lan 'ga' ni rgyu med par bshang ba de sla bar yang dang yang du 'byung zhing 'khru bar du'agyur ro/ /yang pho ba'i ma zhu ba de ni yun ring du sogs shing bshang ba rjo'akhru ba dang / yun ring por na bar byed cing myur du gsod par mi byed pa yin no//de ni nad sna re re 'dus/ /las byung rnam pa bzhi yin no/ /zhes bya ba la/pho ba ma zhu ba'i nad de ni rnam pa bzhi yod de/ rlung la sogs pa'i ⑦nad gzhi re re nas ④skyes pa dang / 'dus pa las byung ba'i bzhi ⑨yin no/ /de yi sngon tshul snyom pa dang / /ring nas 'ju zhing skyur bag 'byung / /mchil mang kha yis ⑩dri mi tshor/ / rmya snyom ⑪skom zhing yi ga 'chus/ /lto sbo slon ni ⑫bro ba dang / /rna ba rgyu ⑫ma sgra dang bcas/ /zhes bya ba la/ pho ba ④ma zhu ba grang ba'i nad de (nyephyis 'byung ba'i ⑩tshul ni yan lag snyom zhing ⑫nyam chung ba dang /pho ba'i me drod zhan zhing spyozas rid nas 'ju ba dang / de bzhin du sgregs ⑪pa —sgyur bag 'byung ba la sogs pa yin no/ /spyi yi mtshan nyid skem pa dang / /du 113—1123

ba mun dang rims kyis 'debs/ /brgyal zhing mgo na bshang ba 'gags①/ /rkang pa lag pa skrangs par 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba la/ pho ba'i nad bzhi char gyi ①spyi'i thun mong gi mtshan nyid ni lus skem zhing rid pa nas rkang pa dang lag pa skrangs par 'gyur ba'i sdebar yin par shes par bya'o/ /de la ④rlung la rkan skams shing / /rab rib rna bar sgra 'byung dang / /rtsib logs brla dang chu sor na—/ /bshang ba yang dang yang du 'byung / /yang yang rjosbo zhing gsud pa dang //ro rnams kun la brkam kye pa dang / /bkres skom rgyu ma byebacad snyam sems/ /zas zhu nas ni sbo ba dang / /zas zos nas lduni bde bar 'gyur/ /rlung gi snying nad skran ⑨gzhang 'brum/ /mdzer pa skya rbab 'byung bar ⑩dogs/ /bshang ba 'byung dka' ska ⑪slar 'byung / /de yang be'u snabs sgra can 'byung / /gzhang na lud ⑩pa dbugs mi bde/ /zhes bya ba la/ de la pho ba'i nad bzhi po'i nang nas rlung la sogs pa'i pho ba'i ⑫mtshan nyid ni rkan skams par 'gyur ba dang / mig rab rib kyis 'debs pa dang / rna bar sgra zi zi por 'byung ba dang / rtsib ④logs la sogs pa na bar 'gyur ba dang / mngar ba la sogs pa'i ro rnams kun la brkam ④zhing chags pa dang / rgyu ma bcad pa bzhin du sems shing na ba dang / zas zhu nas lto sbo bar 'gyur ba dang / de ltar na na bas ⑩kha zas zos shing longs spyad na sla bar 'gyur ba dang / rlung las gyur pa'i snying nad la sogs pa 'byung bar dogs shing yid gnyis su 'gyur ba dang /yun ring zhig na ⑩bshang ba 'byung zhing thogs la na bar 'gyur ba dang / ska ⑫ba dang sla ba la sogs pa'i khyad par '-i7ldan par 'byung ba yin no/ /mkhris pa du sngo zhing ser ba dang / /ser po sla bag 'khru bar 'gyur/ /mnam zhing sgregs 113—1124

sgyur snying shog tsha/ /yi ga 'chus zhing ①skom dad che/ /zhes bya ba la/ mkhris pa las gyur pa'i pho ba'i nad ni 'khru ba sngo zhing ser ba 'dres ⑤mar 'byung ba'am/ser por 'byung ba la sogs pa yin no/ /bad kan las gyur 'ju dka' zhing / /zas slon yi ga 'chus pa dang / /khar chags mchil ma mang ba dang / /lud pa snying nad cham pas 'debs/ /snying ga mer mer por sems shing / /lto ba tshor ba ①chung zhing lci/ /sgregs pa dri mnam mngar 'byung snyom⑦/ /bud med mi dga' me drod chung / /bee'u snabs bad kan 'dres par 'khru/ /bshang ba lci bar rjo'abyung bar 'gyur/ /rid pa min yang nyams stobs chung / /zhes bya ba la/ bad kan las gyur pa'i pho ba ma zhu ba'i nad kyis 'khru ba ni/ kha zas 'ju bar dka' rjozhing ring zhig nas 'ju bar 'gyur ba la sogs pa'i nad kyis 'debs pa dang / snying ⑦mer mer por gyur cing khengs pa ⑤snyam du sems pa dang / lto bar tshor ba chung zhing lus lci ba dang / sgregs pa mnam zhing shas che ba'i legs par mi 'byung ba dang / yan lag snyom ⑨pa dang / bud med la dga' ba med cing nyal po la mi gdung ba dang me drod chung zhing bshang ba bee'u snabs la sogs pa dang ldan par 'byung ba dang / rid pa ma yin zhing sha ma zad kyang nyams stobs chung zhing nus pa zhan par 'gyur ba yin no/ /kun skyes mtshan nyid 'dren mar ldan/ /zhes bya ba la/ nad gzhi ⑩gsum char las byung ba'i pho ba'i nad ni mtshan nyid thams cad dang ldan zhing rtags kun tu ⑪'dres pa yin no/ /ma snyoms la sogs me drod gsum/ /yan lag char phye gang bshad pa/ /de yang pho ba'i nad du 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba la/ ma snyoms pa la sogs pa'i me drod gsum po ⑫ste/ me drod ma snyoms pa dang / me drod 113—1125

shas che zhing rno ba dang / zhan zhing ①rtul ba gsum po lus kyi sdeganas su yan lag char phye ba'i skabs su bshad pa gang yin pa de yang pho ba'i nad du 'gyur ba'i rgyu yin no/ /snyoms pa bder gnas rgyu yin no/ /zhes bya ba la yang me drod ma nyams shing snyoms pa gang yin pa de ni lus bde bar gnas shing nad med pa'i rgyu yin no/ /rlung nad rde'u nad mdze nad dang / /gcin snyi dmu rdzing mtshan par 1rdol/ /gzhang 'brum pho nad ces bya brgyad/ /nad chen gso bar dka' ba yin/ /zhes bya ba la/ pho ba'i nad kyi zhar la rlung nad la sogs pa brgyad po ni nad chen po yin zhing shin tu gso dka' ba yin par bshad pa yin no/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa'i rnam par 'grel pa tshig gi don gyi zla zer zhes bya ba/ 5 slob dpon zla ba la dga' bas rnam par sbyar ba las—/ nad gzhi'i gnas kyi le'u brgyad pa'i rnam par 'grel pa'o// //de nas gcin 'gags pa'i nad gzhi bshad par bya'o/ /zhes bya ba la/'di brtsams pa'i 'grel ⑤pa ni 'di yin te/ dri ma reg bupa'i nad gzhi'i le'u bshad nas/ gci ba zhes bya ba'i dri ma dwangs pa'i ④nad gzhi'i le'u gnyis kyis thu bshad pa yin te/ gcin 'gags ⑨pa ni gcin ba ba la sogs pa ste/de'i nad gzhi bshad par bya'o zhes pa'o/ /lgang pa lgang pa7 mgo pho mtshan/ /rked pa rlig pa gzhang kha ni/ /gzhang kha'i rus par brten gyur zhing ⑩/ /gcig tu 'brel pa yin par bshad/ /ces bya ba la/ lgang pa la sogs pa lus kyi 7char gtogs pa rnams ni 'brel pa gcig cing mdor bsdus pa gcig yin par bshad la/ de dag gi gnas sam rten ni gzhang gi nang na ⑫gnas te 113—1126

de dang 'brel lo zhes bya ba'i don no/ /lgang pa kha ni thur bltas kyang / /gcin 'dzag pa yi rtsa sgo nas/ /rgyun mi 'chad par 'dzag pa yis/ /ngos gnyis nas ni phre ①'us 'gengs/ /zhugs pa gang yin de yis ni/ /gcin 'gags ②pa dang gcin snyi ba'i/ /gso dka' gnad ①la brten pa'i nadadu/ /nyi shu skyed par byed pa yin/ /zhes bya ba la/ gang gi phyir beeng pa de ni kha thur du bltas te gnas pa yin du zin kyang / gcin 'dzag cing rgyu bar byed pa'i rtsa'i sbubs ⑤phra mo las rgyun mi 'chad par 'dzag cing 'bab par byed pa'i rtsa'i ngos gnyis na gnas pa de las gcin gyi phre'u 'dzag pas lgang pa du'agengs par byed la/ gang las zhugs pa'i rtsa de nyid kyi sgo nas rlung la sogs pa'i nad zhugs nas/ de las gcin 'gags ④pa'i nad nyi shu dang / gcin snyi ba'i nad nyi shu gso zhing bcos par dka' ba'i gnad kyi nad ⑧skyed par 'gyur ro/ /lgang pa chu so pho mtshan na/ /cung zad yang dang yang du ⑨'byung / /sri ba rlung las gyur pa yin/ /zhes bya ba la/ rlung las gyur pa'i gcin sri ba'i mtshan nyid ni/ skyes bu lgang pa dang chu so'i phyogs pho mtshan lhag par na zhing /gcin cung zad yang dang yang du 'byung ba yin no/ /mkhris pa las gyur ser tsha ⑩naske/ /mdog dmar/ zhes bya ba la/ mkhris pa las gyur pa'i gcin sri ba'i gcin gyi ⑪mdog ser por 'byung ba'am/ mdog dmar zhing khrag 'dra bar 'byung la/ de dag kyang tsha ba dang na ba dang bcas par 'byung ba ⑩yin no/ /bad kan las gyur pa/ lgang pa pho mtshan lci zhing skrangs/ /'byar bag dal gyis 'byung ⑫zhing thogs/ /zhes bya ba la/ bad kan las gyur pa'i gcin 'gags (stepa ni/ beeng pa dang pho mtshan gnyis lci ba dang / skrangs par 113—1127

'gyur ba dang / 'byar bag dang bcas shing thogs pa dang bcas pas 'gags shing gcin 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /nad kun las byung mtshan kun ldan/ /zhes bya ba la/ nad gzhi gsum char 'dus pa'i gcin sri ba ni nad kyi ①mtshan nyid gsum car ④dang ldan pa yin no/ /gang tshe rlung gis lgang pa'i kha/ /bkag pa de tshe gcin mkhris pa/ /bad kan khu chur bcas pa ni/ / rim gyis ①skams par byas pa las/ /mi bzad rde'u chags 'gyur te/ /ba lang mkhris par gi rjowang ltar/ /thams cad bad kan la rjobarten 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba la/ gang gi tshe rlung gis nad 'khrugs par gyur nas/ beeng pa'i kha bkag nas gnas pa de'i tshe gcin mkhris pa dang bcas pa'am/ bad kan dang bcas pa'am/ khu chu dang bcas pa burim gyis skam ④par byed kyi/ gcin 'ba' zhig skam par ⑧ni mi byed la/ de'i tshe ni rde'u chags par 'gyur te/ de yang mi bzad par na la⑨/gso dka' zhing thogs par ⑩'gyur ro/ /de yang dper na ba lang gi mkhris pa skam zhing 'thas pas rim gyis gi ⑪wang skye ba dang 'dra bar rde'u chags par 'gyur ro/ /de yang thams cad bad kan la brten zhing ⑫gnas par 'gyur ro/ /'di yi sngon tshul mtshan nyid ni/ /lgang pa sbo zhing de yi ni/ / nye 'khor ⑫kun tu rab tu na/ /gcin yang lhag par dbre bro zhing / /gcin 'gags ⑫rims 'debs yi ga 'chus/ /zhes bya ba la/ de nas rde'u chags pa 'di'i sngon byung ba'i mtshan nyid dam rtags ni lgang pa sbo zhing rgyas pa dang / de bzhin du de'i nyen kor lgang pa'i mgo dang / pho mtshan dang rlig pa la sogs pa kun tu thog thag rab tu na zhing zug pa dang / gcin dbre ba ⑫la sogs par 'gyur ro/ /spyi yi mtshan nyid lte ba dang / /beeng mgo lgang pa'i srubs na zhing / /de yis 113—1128

gcin 'byung sgo bkag pas/ /gcin gyi ①rgyun ni 'chad cing 'byung / /de byung zin nas bde bar byed/ /bee zhing ba lang tshil 'dra la/ /de bskyod ①pa yis khrag tu 'gyur/ /drag shul spyod pas rab tu na/ /zhes bya ba la/ spyi'i mtshan nyid dang ④thun mong gi rtags ni lte ba la sogs par na zhing zug pa dang /rde'u chags pa des gcin 'byung ba'i rgyun srang gi sgo bkag pas/ gcin gyi ④rgyun chad cing srus srus ⑦'byung ba dang / de byung zin zhing ⑥de dang bral nas bde bar byed pa yin pa'am/ yang na rde'us bkag pa de bzhin du gyur ④na bde bar 'byung ba yin no/ /gcin 'byung ba de yang dwangs shing ⑧sla la ba lang gi tshil 'dra ba 'byung ngo / /yang de bskyod mucing rta la sogs pa'i bzhon spyopas g.yengs par gyur na khrag tu 'byung bar 'gyur la/ drag shul kyi spyod lam tshar bcad de rkyug ⑩pa'am/ smyung ba byas pas rab tu na zhing mi bde bar 'gyur ro//de la rlung gyur shin tu na/ /so 'thams sdom zhing lus 'dar la/ /pho mtshan nyed cing lte ba 'tshir/ /rgyun du na zhing mkhun ⑫par byed/ /bshang ba 'phyen ⑫dang bcas par 'byung / /gcin kyi thigs pa yang yang 'ong / /rde'u gnag cing rtsub pa dang / /chu sor tsher mas ④gang snyam byed/ /ces bya ba la/rde'u chags pa spyode rnams kyi nang nas rlung las gyur pa'i rde'u chags par gyur pa ni—/ shin tu na bas gzir zhing de nyid kyis ⑫na so 'thams par sdom zhing krig krig 'cha' bar 'gyur ba dang / lus 'dar zhing bskyod pa dang / pho mtshan nyed par byed pa dang / lte ba'i phyogs lag pa gnyis kyis ⑩'tshir bar byed pa dang / nyin mtshan rgyun du mkhun spyozhing nga ro 'byin pa dang / bshang ba 'phyen ⑪dang bcas par 'byung ba la sogs pa yin no/ /mkhris pas bu lgang 113—1129

pa tsha ba dang / /btsos pa snyam byed rab tu dro/ /go bye'i 'bras bu'i ①dbyibs 'dra la/ /rde'u mdog dmar zhing ser la gnag /ces bya ba la/mkhris pa las gyur pa'i rde'u chags pas ni lgang pa shin tu na zhing btsos pa snyam sdebyed la/ de bzhin du rab tu dro ①ba dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /rde'u'i dbyibs kyang bse shing gi ④'bras bu'i dbyibs dang 'dra rjol/ rde'u'i kha dog kyang dmar ser du 'dug cing rtsa gnag pa yin no/ /bad kan gyis rjobasil lci ba dang / /beeng pa'i nang du zug cing na/ /rde'u che zhing 'jam pa la/ /sbrang rtsi'i mdog gam yang na dkar/ /zhes bya ba la/ bad kan las gyur pa'i rde'u chags pas ⑦rgo reg na bsil ba dang rang bzhin lci ba dang / lgang pa'i nang lag pas mnyes shing ⑧btsugs pa ltar na ba la sogs pa yin no/ /'di dag byis pa rnams la ni/ /phal cher 'byung bar 'gyur ba yin/ /gnas dang sha ni chung ba'i phyir/ /bzung ⑨dang dbyung ba bde ba yin/ /zhes bya ba la/rde'u chags pa gsum po 'di dag ni phal cher ram/ mang du byes pa rnams la 'byung bar 'gyur ba yin no/ /de yang byis pa rnams la 'byung ba ni rde'u bzung ba dang dbyung ba ⑩bde ba yin no/ /ci'i phyir zhe na/ gnas dang sha chung ba'i phyir te/ beeng pa chung ba nyid kyi phyir dang / sha chung zhing srab pa'i phyir bzung ⑪ba dang / dbyung ba gnyis ka bde ba yin no/ /mi chen khu ba las byung rde'u/ /khu ba bkag pas ⑫'byung bar 'gyur/ /gnas las 'phos pa phyir ma byung / /rlig par gnas pa rlung gis ni/ /skams nas nye bar bsdus gyur pa/ /de ni khu ba rde'u chags yin/ /lgang par ⑫gcin ni sri byed cing / /tsha zhing skrang bar ④byed pa yin/ /zhes bya ba la/ mi chen po lta bu las byung ⑫113—1130

ba'i rde'u 'byung bar 'gyur la/ de yang khu ba bkag pa'i gzhi stilas byung la/de yang khu ba gnas las 'phos par gyur cing / nyal po spyad skepa'i bar chad du gyur pas/ phyi ma lam log par song ba de rlig pa dag gi bar na gnas pas na/rlung gis bsdus te ④khu ba de skams nas gong por byas pa de ni khu ba'i rde'u chags pa zhes bya rjol/ de yang beeng par gcin sri ba la sogs par byed cing rlig pa skrang bar rjobyed pa yin no/ /de ni skyes ma thag tu ni/ /khu ba zhu ste sla bar 'gyur—/ /zhes bya ba la/ rde'u skyes ma thag ring po ma lon par khu ba zhu zhing bee bag tu 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /phyogs der mnan na zhu bar byed/ /ces bya ba la/ rde'u de phyogs gang du chags pa'i phyogs der mnan pa tsam kyis zhu zhing 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /rde'u gses/ ma lta bur gnas/ /rlung gis phye mar bshig gyur pa/ /de 'dir tshul bzhin 'byung zhes bya/ /gcin dang lhan cig phyir 'byung 'gyur/ /lugs bzhin mi 'byung rde'u chags/ /zhes bya ba la/khu ba rde'u chags pa rlung gis phye mar bshig pa ni/ gseg ma lta bu zhes bya ste gseg ma phye ma lta bu rjode rlung tshul bzhin du 'byung bar 'gyur bas ni gcin dang lhan cig phyir ⑦'byung bar 'gyur la/ rlung lugs bzhin mi 'byung ste/'khyil na ni rde'u chags par byed kyi/ gcin dang lhan cig phyir 'byung bar mi byed do/ /gcin ni bkag par ④byas gyur pas/ /rlung gis beeng pa'i kha bkag nas/ /gcin 'gags na zhing g.ya' bar 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba la/skyes bus gcin 'byung ba nan gyis bkag par gyur pas de'i skyon gyis rlung gis ⑨beeng pa'i sgo bkag nas gcin 'gags shing g.ya' ba'i nad skyed ⑩par 'gyur ro//lan 'ga' rang gnas las spangs ⑪nas/ /ldang pa rgyas te kha che zhing / /113—1131

mngal 'dra sbom zhing log par 'dug /der stini na zhing tsha bar byed/ /'phar zhing gcus ②pa snyam du sems/ /thigs pa tsam du 'dzag pa dang / /lgang btsir rgyun ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /rnam pa gnyis po 'di dag ④ni/ /rlung gi beeng pa'i nad ces bya/ /gso dka' gnyis pa rlung gi rjoyin/ /mthu che shin tu gso dka' yin/ /zhes bya ba la/ yang rlung lan 'ga' ste/ tshe 'di'am—/ tshe rabs gzhan gyi rgyu'i ⑤dbang gis rang gi dhi'adug pa'i gnas las spangs dhishing bskyod de⑤/ lgang pa de rgyas par byas nas kha'i zheng che ba ⑨mngal 'dra ba dang / sbom zhing log par 'dug pa rang gi tshad las che la gnas las 'phos te log par 'dug par gyur na lgang pa der na ba la sogs par 'gyur la—/ gcin thogs kṛ 7pa tsam du nyung zhig 'dzag par 'gyur la/ lgang pa btsir na rgyun du 'bab cing 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de ltar rnam pa gnyis po de dag ni rlung las gyur pa'i lgang pa'i nad ces bya ba'o/ /de ni gso dka' ba yin la/ de gnyis las kyang gnyis pa ni rlung shas che ba'i phyir shin tu yang gso dka' ba yin no/ /bshang lam dang ni lgang pa yi/ /bar na rlung ni brten gyur pa—/ /gtun 'dra sra zhing mtho ba dang / /mi 'gyur gnas byed mdud pa can//rlung nad gtun 'dra de sbos bcas/ / bshang gci 'phyen ⑪ni 'gag byed yin//zhes bya ba la/ bshang ba'i lam dang gzhang ⑩dang lgang pa'i bar na rlung brten zhing thorte gnas par 'gyur ba de ni gtun 'dra zhing de'i rnam pa can yin la/gzhan yang mtho zhing mthug ⑫la mi 'gyur bar gnas pa'i mdud pa spyocan lta bu de ni lto ⑫sbos pa dang bcas pa'i nad skyed par 'gyur ro/ /log rgyu 'khyil bar byed pa yi/ /rlung gis chu sor mi bzad gzer/ /gcin la zhugs te 113—1132

'khyil byed cing / /rengs byed lci zhing gcus ①snyam byed/ /gcin ni nyung shas nyung shas 'byung / /yang na bshang gci gtong tshe 'byung / /'di ni rlung nad 'khyil ba yin/ /zhes bya ba la/ rlung thur du rgyu ba'i lam 'gags te 'khyil ①nas zlum por gnas pa de chu sor brten par 1gyur na/ mi bzad pa'i gzer bskyed de gcin la zhugs nas gcin de 'khyil zhing sri bar byed pa la sogs pa'i tshul byed pa'am/ yang na gcin nyung shas nyung shas 'dzag par 'gyur ro/ /de lta bu'i rlung las gyur pa'i gcin nad de ni 'khyil ④ pa zhes bya ba yin no/ /gcin ni yun ring bkag dugyur pa/ /sri zhing 'byung bar mi 'gyur la/ /gcin thon nas ni nad tshabs 'bri/ /zhes bya ba la/ yang gcin yun ring zhig bkag cing brnag rjopar gyur pa ni phyis gtong ba'i tshe sri zhing bde blag tu 'byung bar mi 'gyur la/ de ni gcin thon nas nad tshabs 'bri ba'i gcin nad ces bya'o/ /gcin bkag pa yis gnod gyur pa/ /gang tshe rlung gis bzlog ⑦gyur pa/ /lte ba'i 'og nas lte ba'i bar/ /gcin gyis gang gyur de yi tshe/ /rab tu na zhing spo ba dang / /zas mi zhu zhing me drod 'gags/ /de ni ltor ⑧gcin 'gags zhes ⑨bya/ /zhes bya ba la/ gcin bkag cing brnag ⑩pa'i skyon gyis nad du gyur pa de ni dus gang gi tshe rlung gis gyen du bzlog par gyur pa'i tshe lte ba'i 'og nas lte ba'i bar du na ba la sogs pa'i nad skyed ⑪par 'gyur te/ de ni lte ⑫bar gcin 'gags pa zhes bya'o/ /gcin 'byung bu ga 'chus pa 'am/ /rlung gis bkag ⑫nas gcin nyung 'byung / /beeng pa mtshan sbubs nor bur ni/ /gnas nas de 'og rim gyis ⑫'dzag /nad bcas pa 'am nad med pa/ /gcin ni chad dang bcas par 'byung / /lhag 113—1133

ma lus te mtshan lci yin/ /zhes bya ba la/ gcin 'byung ba'i bu ga 'chus pa la sogs pa'i skyon nam/ yang na rlung gis bkag ①pas gcin nyung du 'byung zhing sri bar 'gyur ba dang / de yang lgang pa'am mtshan gyi sbubs sam④ pho mtshan gyi rtse mo nor bu zhes bya ba la gnas nas rim kyis 'dzag par 'gyur zhing /de nad dang bcas pa'am nad med par gcin chad cing sri bag dang bcas pas 'byung la/ 'byung ba'i lhag ma lus pas de mtshan lci bar 'gyur ba yin te pho mtshan khong lci ba'o/ /lgang pa'i kha nang zlum zhing sra/ /cung zhig 'phral du 'byung 'gyur na/ /gcin sogs rde'u lta bu ①ni/ /gcin gyi mdud par de bshad do//zhes bya ba la/ lgang pa'i kha'i nang zlum por gnas la sra bar gyur cing cung zhig 'phral du 'byung la/ de lta bu'i nad de ni rde'us ④'gags pa lta bur na la/mtshan ma de lta bur na ba la ni gcin gyi mdud pa zhes bya'o/ /gcin snyoms pa las nyal po byasarjo/ /rlung gis khu ba bskyod rjogyur pa/ /gnas las bskyod cing gcin gtong tshe/ /sngon nam phyi nas thal chu dang / /mdog 'dra 'byung bar 'gyur ba yin/ /khu ba 'dres ⑦par de bshad do/ /zhes bya ba la/ gcin snyoms shing ④'byung bar 'dod pa dang / skyes pas bud med la nyal po byas nas rlung gis ⑨khu ba bskyod cing g.yos par gyur pas gnas las ⑩bskyod cing 'phos par gyur pa de gcin gtong ba'i gcin gyi sngon du'am gcin gyi ⑩phyi nas thal chu dang mdog 'dra bar gyur pa ⑫de ni khu ba dang gcin 'dres pa zhes bya'o/ /rtsub cing skem lhomil rlung gis ni/ /gang tshe rtug skam ⑫nad gyur pa/ /gcin 'byung bu gar song nas ni/ /bshang ba dang 'dres de yi tshe/ /gcin ni bshang ba'i dri can 'byung / /bshang ba 'gags par de bshad do/ /zhes bya 113—1134
