ba la/ skyes bu khong rtsub cing skem ①por gyur pa dag rlung gi nad kyis gang gi tshe rtug skam gyi ⑤nad du 'gyur zhing gyen du bskyur bar gyur pa ①na/ de'i tshe gcin 'byung ba'i bu gar song zhing kun tu khyab pa dang / bshang ba dang gcin 'dres par gyur la/ des na gcin de bshang ba'i dri ma can du 'gyur zhing 'byung la/ de lta bu'i gcin sri ba de ni bshang ba 'gags ④pa'i gcin sri ba zhes bya bar bshad do/ /mkhris pa drag shul kha zas ni/ /rno tsha nyi tshan la dusogs kyis/ /'phel zhing rlung ni zhugs gyur pa/ /beeng pa'i nyen kor tsha zhing na—/ /gcin ni ser por 'gyur ba 'am thu/ /yang na khrag bcas khrag nyid 'byung / /tsha zhing sri la yang yang 'byung / /de ni tsha rlung zhes byar bshad/ /ces bya ba la/ mkhris pa'i shas meche zhing rtsol ba drag bo rjol sogs pas rlung zhugs pas bskyod par ⑨gyur pa la ni beeng pa'i nyen kor tsha ba la sogs pa'i nad 'byung ste/ de ni gcin sri ba'i tsha rlung zhes bya ba yin no/ /rtsub sbung lus ni rmya ba yi⑪ / /lgang par gnas pa'i mkhris pa rlung / /gcin zad tsha dang na bar bcas/ /skyed ⑪pa de yang de skad bshad/ /bad kan mkhris pa gnyis ka la—/ /rlung gis bskyod par gyur na ni/ /de tshe gcin sri ser ba dang / /dmar zhing dkar la ska ⑫ba 'byung / /de ni tsha bcas gi wang ngam/ /dung gi phye ma'i mdog 'dra 'am/ /yang na skam zhing mdog kun ldan/ /de ni gcin nyams nad du bshad/ /ces bya ba la/ skyes bu khong rtsub cing lus rmya zhing nyam chung bar gyur pa la/ gang gi tshe lgang par gnas pa'i mkhris pa dang /rlung gnyis ni gcin zad pa la sogs pa skyed par byed de/ de yang mkhris pa dang rlung las gyur pa'i gcin sri ba'i nad ces bya bar ⑫de skad du bshad do/ /113—1135

yang gang gi tshe mkhris pa dang bad kan gnyis la yang rlung gis bskyod byung g.yos par gyur pa de'i tshe/ gcin shas cher sri zhing kha dog ser po la sogs pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro/ /de yang tsha ba dang bcas shing gi wang la sogs pa gang yang rung ba'i mdog gam/ yang na skam zhing mdog thams cad dang ldan par 'byung ste/ de ni gcin nyams pa'i nad ces bya'o zhes ①drang srong rnams kyis bshad do/ /de ltar gcin 'gags las byung ①ba'i/ /mtshan nyid rgya cher bshad nas ni/ /de 'og gcin snyi las byung ba'i/ /nad gzhi'i mtshan nyid bshad pa yin/ /zhes bya ba la/ de ltar ji skad du bshad pa'i tshul kyis sngar rnam par spyad rngupa'i tshul gyis gcin 'gags shing sri ba las byung ba'i nad kyi mtshan nyid rgya cher bshad cing bstan nas/ de'i 'og tu gcin snyi zhing 'dzag pa las byung ba'i nad gzhi'i mtshan nyid drang srong rnams kyis bshad pa yin no/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa'i rnam par 'grel pa tshig gi don kyi zla zer zhes bya ba/ slob dpon zla ba la dga' bas rnam par sbyar ba las/ nad gzhi'i gnas kyi le'u dgu pa'i rnam par 'grel pa'o// //de nas gcin snyi ba za khu'i nad dmigs bshad par bya'o/ /zhes bya ba la/'di brtsams pa'i 'brel pa ni/ de 'og gcin snyi ba las byung ba'i nad gzhi'i mtshan nyid bshad pa yin no sha4zhes gzhung rtsom pa nyid kyis bshad pa las shes par bya'o/ /gcin snyi'i nad ni nyi shu ste/ /zhes bya ba la/ gcin snyi ba'i ⑤nad ni nyi shur 'gyur ro/ /ste zhes bya ba ni tshig gi ⑦lhag ma'o/ /de la bad kan las gyur bcu/ /mkhris pa las drug rlung gyur bzhi/ /zhes bya ba la/113—1136

de la gcin snyi ba'i nad nyi shu las/ gcin nad za khu bcu ni bad kan las gyur pa yin te/ chu 'dra ba dang / bu ram shing gi khu ba 'dra ba dang / gar po dang / chang 'dra ba dang / 'bras btags pa'i chu 'dra ba dang / khu chu 'dra ba dang / bye ma lta bu dang / bsil mo dang / bags kyis ①'byung ba dang / kha chu ltar 'byung ba'i za khu zhes bya'o/ /mkhris pa las gyur pa ②ni drug ste/ nas tshig ③'khus pa'i thal chu 'dra ba dang / sngon po dang / nag po dang / skyer pa 'dra ba dang / btsod ④khu 'dra ba dang / khrag 'dra ba ste rnam pa drug yin no/ /rlung las gyur pa ni bzhi ste/ zhag dang / rkang dang /glang po che'i ⑤za khu dang / sbrang rtsi lta bu'i ⑥gcin snyi ba'i nad do/ /de rnams tshil gcin bad kan skyed/ /zas dang skom gyi tshul las ni/ /phal cher de dag 'byung bar byed/ /mngar dang sgyur dang lan tshwa dang / /lci zhing 'byil la ⑦bsil ba dang / /'bru mar chang dang gsher ba'i sha /dar ba bu ram bu ram shing / /gnas gcig stan gcig la rtag gnasadu / /mal stan cho gar mi ldan la/ /brten nad ⑨gcin snyi'i nad skyed ( 7byed/ /ces bya ba la/gcin ⑪snyi ba'i nad nyi shu po de dag ni las dang kha zas dang / spyod tshul dang gcin dang bad kan skyed par byed pa de las ⑫byung zhing / phal cher te mang du de dag 'byung zhing / gcin snyi ba'i nad skyed par byed pa'i rgyu yin la/gzhan yang mngar ba nas bu ram shing gi bar gyi dngos po ming gis smos pa'i zas dang skom yang de 'byung bar byed pa yin la/ spyod lam gyi rnam pa gnas gcig dang stan gcig la rtag tu gnas pa la sogs pa'i bya ba des bskyed 4sapar gtogs pa dang / mal stan cho ga dang mi ldan pa ste stan rlan can dang grang ba 113—1137

la sogs pa'i lam na gnas pa las gcin nad skyed par byed par 'gyur ro/ /bad kan 'khrugs pas beeng par gcin/ /snyi 'gyur lus gsher rngul tshil dang //sha glongs ①lgang par brten ④gcin snyi/ /mkhris pas ①khrag kyang zad byas nas//bad kan sogs zad gcin nad skyed/ /ces bya ba la/ bad kan 'khrugs par gyur pa las lus kyi gsher bag dang rngul la sogs pas glongs rjoshing gnod par byas la/ khrag kyang zad par byas nas bad kan las gyur pa yang zad par byas te④/ gcin la gnas pa'i mkhris pas gcin nad za khu skyed par byed do/ /rlung 'khrugs pa dang de zad las/ /lus zungs lgang par 'khus te skyed/ /ces bya ba la/ lus zungs rnams la ⑥rlung 'khrugs shing ldang ba dang / mkhris pa la sogs pa zad pas dwangs ma la sogs pa'i lus zungs lus kyi bcud du ⑦gyur pa lgang par 'khus shing ③'dus par byas nas gcin snyi ba'i nad skyed par byed do/ /de byung gso bya 'tsho tsam dang / /spang bya gcin nad rnam gsum 'gyur/ /mdor na mi mthun bya ba dang / /nad dmigs chen po nyid kyis 'byung / /zhes bya ba la/ bad kan dang mkhris pa dang rlung de dag las byung ba'i gabyun snyi ba'i nad ni gso bar bya ba dang / re zhig 'tsho ba tsam du gnas pa dang spang bar bya ba rnguste/ rnam pa gsum du 'gyur la/ de yang mdor na ⑩mi mthun par bya ba ste/ gang gi phyir snum pa la sogs pa rlung nad la phan pa de ni bad kan la gnod la/ gang kha ba dang bska ba la sogs pa bad kan la phan pa tukyede ni rlung la gnod do/ /de bzhin du mkhris pa la phan pa bsil ba dang / mngar ba dag ni rlung dang bad kan la gnod de/ gzhan yang nad dmigs chen po'i dpyad kyis kyang 'byung ste/ mi mthun pa gso bas 113—1138

lus zungs ①zad cing skem ⑤pa'i lus 'jig par byed pa'i nad dmigs chen po'i tshul kyis kyang ①'byung ngo / /de rnams kyi rjoni spyi'i mtshan nyid/ /gcin ni rnyog ma can rjodu 'byung / / gnod dang gnod bya khyad med kyang / /rjode dus mekhyad par nyid dang ni/ /gcin byu mdog sogs dbye ba yis/ /gcin snyi'i dbye ba brtag ④par bya/ /zhes bya ba la/ gcin nad de ⑨thams cad kyi spyi'i mtshan nyid dang / rtags ni gcin rnyog ma ⑪ can dul dul po mang du 'byung bar 'gyur ba yin no/ /⑩gcin snyi'i dbye ba du mar 'gyur ba de ni 'dus shing phrad pa'i khyad par nyid de/ gnod pa dang gnod par bya ba'i 'phel 'bri'i khyad par nyid dang / gcin gyi ⑫mdog dang ro dang dri dang reg bya'i khyad par las gcin snyi ba'i dbye ba brtag par bya zhing yongs su shes par bya'o/ /dang zhing mang la dkar zhing bsil/ /dri nga med cing chu 'dra la/ /gcin snyi chu yi za khu yin/ /zhes bya ba la/ gcin snyi ba'i nad chu'i za khu zhes bya ba ni dang zhing rnyog ma sked pa la sogs pa'i khyad par dang ldan pa'i chu'i rnam pa dang 'dra ba'i gcin 'byung bar 'gyur ba yin no/ /cung zad rnyog can sbyin bag can⑫/ /bu ram shing khu lta bur mngar/ /za khu bu ram shing khu yin/ /zhes bya ba la/gcin nad za khu bu ram shing khu ④lta bu ni cung zad rnyog pa yod pa la sogs pa la bu ram shing gi khu ba ltar shin tu mngar ba'i gcin 'byung ba yin no/ /zhag lon na ni ska sngonyebar 'gyur/ /za khu gar po zhes bya'o/ /zhes bya ba la/gcin nad za khu gar po ni gcin ra/tshan mo 'das kyi bar du ma gcis par bzhag pa ste ska ba ⑩gar por 'byung ba yin no/ /steng na dwangs ma 'og na ska⑩/ /chang 'dra chang gi za khu yin/ /zhes bya ba la/ gcin nad chang gi za khu zhes bya 113—1139

ba la phyir 'byung ①ba na steng gi phyogs dwangs mar gnas shing 'og ska ④bar 'gyur ba yin te/ de lta bu'i gcin 'byung ba la bya'o/ /ba spu ldang zhing 'bras btags ④'dra/ /dkar zhing mang 'byung 'bras phye 'dra/ /zhes bya ba la/gcin nad za khu 'bras phye 'dra ba ni/ gcin 'byung ba na ba spu ldang zhing bshor la—/ gcin nyid 'bras btags pa 'dra ba dkar por rjo'abyung zhing mang du 'byung ba yin no/ /khu chu 'dra ba'am khu ba 'dres/ /khu ba 'dra ba'i za khu yin/ /zhes bya ba la/ gcin nad za khu khu chu 'dra ba ni gcin khu ba dang bcas par 'byung ba'am/ khu ba dang 'dra bar gcis pa la bya'o/ /gcin ni bye tshigs dri ma can/ /bye ma'i za khu zhes bya'o/ /zhes bya ba la/ gcin nad bye ma'i za khu zhes bya ba ni bye ma'i tshigs ma 'dra bar dri ma lus dhipa'i gzugs can 'dra ba dag tu 'byung ba yin no/ /gcin snyi mang du rjo'abyung zhing bsel/ /mngar ba de bsel za khu yin/ /zhes bya ba la/ gcin nad bsil ba'i za khu zhes bya ba ni gcin 'byung ba'i reg pa bsel zhing mang du 'byung ④la/ ro mngar ba dag tu 'byung ba yin no/ /dal gyis nyung zad nyung zad 'byung / /bags kyis 'byung ba'i za khu yin/ /zhes bya ba la/ gcin nad bags kyis 'byung ba'i za khu zhes bya ba ni gcin 'byung ba'i rgyun dal gyis nyung zad nyung zad du chad cing chad cing 'byung ba yin no/ /kha chu 'dra ba'i nal nal po/ /'byil bag kha sdechu'i za khu yin/ /zhes bya ba la/ gcin nad za khu 'dra ba ni kha chu 'dra bar ⑨za khu nal nal por 'byung zhing 'byar bag can du 'byung ba yin no/ /de ltar bad kan las gyur pa'i gcin snyi ba bcur bshad pa yin no/ /dri ro kha dog reg bya ni—/ /nas tshig ⑩'khus 'dra nas tshig ⑪can/ /zhes bya ba la/ gcin 113—1140

nad nas tshig ①'khus pa'i thal ba 'dra ba ni nas tshig ⑤'khus pa'i thal ba'i chu dang dri dang ro la sogs pa 'dra zhing mtshungs pa la bya'o/ /za khu sngon po kha dog sngo—/ /zhes bya ba la/ gcin nad za khu sngon po zhes bya ba ni 'dab ①ma sngon po'i khu ba 'dra ba'i gcin 'byung ba la bya'o/ /za khu nag po snag tsha 'dra/ /zhes bya ba la/ za khu nag po ni snag tsha'i mdog ltar gcin nag po 'byung ba la bya'oske/ /gcin snyi tsha zhing mdog ser ba/ /de ni skyer pa 'dra ba yin/ /zhes bya ba la/ gcin nad za khu skyer pa 'dra ba ni gcin tsha zhing gcin gyi rjomadog skyer pa'i khu ba 'dra bar ⑤'byung ba yin no/ /mnam zhing btsod kyi khu ba ⑥ 'dra—/ /btsod kyi za khu zhes bya'o/ /zhes bya ba la/ za khu btsod 'dra ba zhes bya ba ni dri mnam zhing btsod kyi khu ba 'dra ba mnam pa'i gcin 'byung ba la bya'o—/ /dri nga tsha zhing lan tshwar bcas/ /khrag 'dra khrag gi za khu yin/ /zhes bya ba la/ za khu khrag 'dra ba ni dri nga zhing mnam la tsha tseg tseg byed pa dang /cung zad lan tshwa bro ba dang / khrag gi mdog 'dra bar 'byung ba yin te/ de ltar na mkhris pa las gyur pa'i gcin snyi ba'i nad drug bshad pa yin no/ /zhag gi za khu zhag dang 'dres/ /zhag nyid gcin du 'byung ba yin/ /zhes bya ba la/za khu zhag 'dra ba ni zhag 'dren mar 'byung ba'am/ zhag nyid gcin gyi rnam par 'byung ba yin no/ /rkang 'dres pa 'am rkang nyid ni/ /yang dang yang 'byung rkang za khu/ /zhes bya ba la/ za khu rkang 'dra ba zhes bya ba ni rkang dang 'dres pa dang / rkang nyid yang dang yang du gcin du za khur 'byung ba ni gcin nad ⑦rkang 'dra ba'i za khu zhes bya'o/ /glang chen myos ltar rgyun du ni/ /gcin shugs dal bar 'byung 'gyur la④/ /chu ser bcas shing rnyog bcas 'byung / /113—1141

glang chen za khu zhes bya'o/ /zhes bya ba la/ glang po che'i za khu ni glang po che dregs ①pas myos pa ltar rgyun du 'byung zhing gcin gyi shugs dal gyis 'dzag cing 'byung bar 'gyur la/ chu ser dang bcas par 'byung zhing 'dzag ⑤par 'gyur ba la bya'o/ /sbrang rtsi'i za khu sbrang rtsi 'dra/ /zhes bya ba la/ za khu sbrang rtsi 'dra ba zhes bya ba ①sbrang rtsi dang 'dra zhing ro yang bska rjob dang mngar bar 'byung ba yin no/ /de ni rnam pa gnyis su 'gyuradhi/ /lus zungs zad pas rlung 'khrugs pa'am/ /nad kyis rtsa sbubs bkag ste 'byung / /zhes bya ba la/ sbrang rtsi 'dra ba'i za khu de ni rnam pa gnyis su 'byung bar 'gyur ro zhes grags te④/lus zungs rnamyo/sa zad pa las/ rlung 'khrugs pas nad du gyur pa ni rnam pa gcig ⑦yin no/ /yang na nad gzhi gsum gang yang rung bas rtsa sbubs bkag ste—/ rlung rgyur ma ster ba las byung ba ni rnam pa gnyis ⑧yin no/ /nad kyis bkag pa'i mtshan ma dag /de ni rgyu med par 'byung zhing / /skad cig zad stong ⑨gang 'gyur ba/ /gso bar dka' ba nyid du 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba la/za khu sbrang rtsi 'dra ba zhes bya ba de rlung la sogs pa'i nad kyis lgang pa'i kha bkag beeng / sbu gu 'gags par byas pa'i mtshan ma'am/ rtags ni 'byung zhing skye ba'i rgyu med par skad cig cing stong par ⑩'gyur la/ stong pa ⑩nyid las kyang ched 'ga' 'gengs shing gang ba lta bur snang bar 'gyur te/ de ni gso bar dka' ba nyid yin no/ /thams cad dus su ma bcos na/ /sbrang rtsi 'dra ba'i za khur 'gyur⑫/ /gang zhig thams cad mngar 'gyur bas⑫/ /phal cher sbrang rtsi'i za khu yin/ /sbrang rtsi'i za khu zhes bya kun/ /mngar ba las ni bshad pa yinarka/ /zhes bya ba la/ gcin nad za khu thams cad kyang sbrang rtsi'i za khu zhes 113—1142

bya ste/ ci'i phyir zhe na/ de thams cad dus su ma bcos shing ma gsos na sbrang rtsi 'dra ba'i za khur 'gyur ba dang / yang gang zhig gcin nad thams cad ①mngar ba'i bag las mngar ba las 'gyur zhing ③/ phal cher sbrang rtsi lta bu'i mdog can yin pas sbrang rtsi'i za khu zhes bya ba'i sgrar bshad do/ /zas mi 'ju zhing yi ga 'chus/ /slon lud gnyid che cham pas 'debs/ /bad kan las byung za khu la/ /bla brnan sdede dag 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba la bad kan las byung ba'i za khu la ④ni zas mi 'ju ba la sogs pa'i bla brnan ⑤'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /pho mtshan kye beeng par zug pa dang / /rlig 'bras bye zhing rims kyis 'debs/ /tsha skyur skom dad brgyal dang 'khrugs⑦/ /mkhris pa las gyur bla brnan ⑧yin/ /zhes bya ba la/ mkhris pa las gyur pa'i gcin nad la ni pho mtshan dang lgang pa'i phyogs su khab kyis ⑨phug pa ltar zug pa dang /rlig 'bras bye ⑩bar 'gyur ba la sogs pa'i bla brnan ⑪'byung bar 'gyur ro⑫/ /rlung las skyes pa'i snying 'phar zhing / /lus 'dar snying na zas la brkam/ /gzer ⑫zhing gnyid med skem pa dang / /lud pa dbugs mi bde ba 'byung / /zhes bya ba la/ rlung las gyur pa'i za khu'i nad la ni snying 'phar ba la sogs pa'i bla brnan ④'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /kham phor rus ⑫sbal 'dra ba can/ /sgu ⑩bo me dbal phra mo dang / /sran chung 'dra dang yungs kar ⑫'dra/ /bu bcas 'byung dang bi da ri/ /khong 'bras zhes bya'i 'bras 'brum bcu/ /gcin nad ma bcos pa las 'byung / /tshigs dang gnad dang sha che ba'i/ /srog gi spyoganas su 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba la/ gcin nad za ⑪khu de ma bcos pa las ni kham phor 'dra ba la sogs pa'i 'bras kyi rjo nad bcu po 'byung 113—1143

bar 'gyur la/ de yang khyad par du ni tshigs dang gnad rnams dang / sha che ba ①la sogs pa srog gi gnas su 'byung zhing skye bar 'gyur ro/ /mtha' ma ①mtho zhing dbus ma dma'/ /gnag cing rnag dang nad bcas ①pa/ /dbyibs dang tshad ni kham phor 'dra/ /nor bu kham phor zhes bya'o/ /zhes bya ba la/ 'bras gang mtha' ④ma kun nas mtho zhing dbus ma medama' bar 'dug pas kham phor gyi dbyibs 'dra la/ kha dog gnag byung rnag dang nad du bcas pa ni 'bras sam thor bu kham phor lta bu zhes bya'o/ /nang du zug cing na byed la//nye ⑦'khor dag tu cher mched cing / /'jam zhing rus ⑦sbal rgyab 'dra ba'i/ /'bras nad rus sbal can ⑧zhes bya/ /zhes bya ba la/ rus ⑨sbal can zhes bya ba'i 'bras nad ni nang du shas cher zug cing na bar byed la/ rtsa'i ⑩nye 'khor du mched cing ⑪sbom pa la sogs pa'i khyad par dang ldan pa yin no/ /sra zhing rtsa yi dra ba can/ /snum zhing 'dzag la khyon che ba⑫/ /na zhing nang zug bu ga ni//phra mor ldan pa dra ba can/ /zhes bya ba la/ thor bu du ba can zhes bya ba ni/sra zhing rtsub ⑫pa dang / rtsa ris kyi dra bas khebs pa dang / snum pa la sogs pa'i khyad par dang ldan pa yin no/ /nang du zug cing na la rnags④/ /rgyab bam lto ba dag tu ni/ /thor bu chen po kha dog gnag /sgu ⑫bor 'dug pas sgu bor bshad/ /ces bya ba la/ 'bras nad sgur po ⑩zhes bya ba ni/ nad tshabs che zhing nang du zug la rnag ⑩kyang nang du rnags ⑫pa ni/ rgyab la sogs pa'i phyogs gang yang rung bar skye ba yin no/ /skyes ma thag tu pags ⑪pa tsha/ /shin tu na byed me dbal te/ /dmar zhing gnag la gas pa dang / /tsha zhing rmugs byed me dbal phra/ /zhes bya ba la/ me dbal phra mo zhes bya ba'i nad ni 113—1144

skyes ma thag gi rjes thogs nyid la pags pa tsha zhing bsregs ①pa snyam du sems la/shin tu na ba'i me dbal kun tu mched par byed cing mdog dmar ba la sogs pa'i khyad par dang ldan pa yin no/ /sran chung 'dra ba'i ①tshad dang dbyibs/ /mnyam pas sran chung can yin te/ /tshad dang dbyibs ni yungs kar 'dra/ /myur du smin zhing ①nad tshabs che/ /zhes bya ba la/ 'brum bu sran chung zhes bya ba ni tshad dang dbyibs sran chung dang 'dra ba yin no/ /de bzhin du tshad dang dbyibs yungs kar rjo'adra ba'i 'brum phran yang yod de/ de ni myur du smin zhing ⑤nad tshabs che ba yin no/ /yungs kar 'dra ba'i 'brum phran gyis/ /yongs su bskor bas chu bur ⑥can/ /bu bcas che zhing mang ba la rab phra'i 'brum bus khyab gyur pa'o/ /zhes bya ba la/ 'bras nad bu bcas zhes bya ba ni yungs kar 'dra ba'i 'brum phran gyis ⑦yongs su bskor cing / de bzhin du ldun che ba dang / mang zhing shin tu phra ba dang / du mas khyab cing g.yogs skepa yin no/ /ldum ⑨bu bi da ri ltar zlum/ /sra ba bi da ri zhes bya/ /zhes bya ba la/ bi da ri zhes bya ba'i 'bras nad tho) ni ldum bu bi da ri zhes bya ba'i dbyibs ltar zlum por gnas la/ rdo ⑪ltar shin tu sra ba yin no/ /khong 'bras gzhan du bshad pa yin/ /zhes bya ba la/ khong 'bras zhes bya ba'i nad ni skabs gzhan du bshad de/ 'di'i rjes thogs kyi ⑩le'u las bshad pa yin no//de la dang po'i 'bras nad gsum/ /bu bcas dang ni bi da ri/ /tshil chen las byung brnag ⑫dka' yin/ /zhes bya ba la/ de la 'bras kyi nad 'di dag gi nang nas dang po'i gsum po khar thor ④zhes bya ba dang / rus ⑫sbal zhes bya ba dang / dra ba can zhes bya ba gsum dang / bu bcas dang bi da ri zhes bya 113—1145

ba lnga po gal te tshil che ba'i mi la byung na brnag par dka' zhing nad tshabs che ba yin no/ /gzhan dag mkhris pa shas che zhing / /tshil chung ①las byung brnag ⑤nus 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba la/ snga ma las gzhan pa'i 'bras nad ①lhag ma lnga po mkhris pa'i nad las byung rjozhing / mi tshil chung ba las byung ba ⑤yin na/ de ni brnag nus shing nad tshabs chung la bugaso sla ba yin no/ /de rnams nad shas tshuji ltar che'i/ /gcin snyi ba yi dbang las 'byung / /zhes bya ba la 'bras bu'i nad de rnams ni gcin snyi ba'i nad kyi ⑤dbang las byung zhing / rang rang gi nad ji ltar shas che ba bzhin du de'i rnam par 'byung bar 'gyur ro⑨/ /bad kan gyi za khu la ⑩ni bad kan shas che bar 'gyur la/ rlung dang mkhris pa ⑩shas che ba'i za khu las kyang rlung dang mkhris pa'i 'bras nad du 'gyur ro/ /'di dag za khu med par ⑫ni/ /gnod gyur tshil las 'byung 'gyur te/ /ji srid dngos po mi snang ba/ /de srid shes par mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes bya ba la/ thor bu'i ⑫nad 'di dag ni za khu'i nad med par mi tshil ches pa las nad du ⑫gyur pa dag las ⑩'byung bar 'gyur te/ de ni ji srid rang gi dngos po lto dang rgyab la sogs pa ⑩gsal por mi snang ba de srid kyi ⑫bar du shes shing rtogs par mi 'gyur ro/ /kha dog ljang ba'am dmar spyoba'i gcin/ /za khu'i sngon tshal med pa yis⑪/ /gcin 'byung gang de za khu ⑦min/ /de ni khrag mkhris yin zhes ⑥bya—/ /zhes bya ba la/ gang zhig gcin gyi mdog ljang ba la sogs par byung la/sngon du byung ba'i tshul med pa de ni za khu'i nad yin par slob dpon gyis ma bshad de/ gcin 3ni khrag mkhris kyi rang bzhin can yin par shes par bya'o/ /lus rngul yan lag mnam zhing lhod pa dang / /stan dang mal dang gnyid kyi bde 113—1146

la chags/ /snying mig rna ba kha lce byugs snyam byed/ /lus spom ①skra dang sen mo ring ba dang / /bsil bag dga' zhing gre ba rkan skams shing / /kha nang ro mngar rkang mthil lag mthil tsha/ /gang du gcis par grog ma 'du 'gyur ba⑤//gcin nad za khu'i tshogs ni phyis 'byung tshul/ /zhes bya ba la/ gcin nad za khu'i tshogs nyi shu po phyis 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i rtags sam tshul sngon du 'byung ba ni—/ lus la ④rngul 'dzag pa dang / yan lag dri nga zhing mnam la lhod cing rmya ba dang / stan la sogs pa la 'dug pa'i bde ba la chags shing sred pa dang /snying ga la sogs pa lus kyi bu ga rnams su dri ma 'phel bas byugs shing rkyang nul byas pa snyam du sems pa dang / lus mthug ④cing spom pa dang / de bzhin du skra la sogs pa ⑤shin tu ring zhing 'phel ba dang / bsil bag la dga' zhing grang ba 'dod pa dang / gre ba dang rkan skams par 'gyur ba la sogs pa yin no// za khu sbrang rtsi'i dhimadog 'dra 'byil ba dang / /sbrang rtsi'i ro 'dra ba la gnyis su rtog④ /lus brtas ⑧bad kan can kyi za khu ⑨'am/ /nyes pa zad pas rlung gi bdag can yin/ /zhes bya ba la/ gcin nad za khu sbrang rtsi'i mdog 'dra ba la/ lci zhing 'byil ba shal ma li'i ⑩khu ba 'dra bar gnas pa/ sbrang rtsi'i ro ltar mngar ba la/ skyes bu blo dman pa dag tshul gnyis su rtog cing dpyod par byed de/ lus kyi nyams brtas ⑪par byas pa'i dbang gis ci 'di bad kan las byung ba yin nam/ yang ⑫bad kan la sogs pa'i nyes pa zad par byas pa'i nyams dmad pa las byung ba'i rlung gi bdag nyid can yin no/ /⑫zhes blo zhan pa dag rtog par byed par 'gyur ro/ /sngon tshul bcas pa'i bad mkhris za khu dang / /gang yang rim ④gyis rlung nad za khur 'gyur⑫/ /mkhris 113—1147

pa las gyur ①gang yin gso bar dka'/ /gal te tshil nad shas chung gyur gso sla—/ /zhes bya ba la/ sngon byung ba'i tshul gyis ①lus rngul ba la sogs pa dang bcas par 'byung ba'i bad kan dang / mkhris pa las gyur pa'i za khu ②ni gso dka' ba yin la/ de bzhin du gang yang rim kyis bad kan la sogs pa las 'byung ba'i rlung nad kyi za khu bude yang gso dka' ba yin no/ /de bzhin du mkhris pa las rim gyis byung ba'i za khur ⑤gyur pa ni gso bar dka' ba yin la/ gsor rung ba ni ༅mkhris pa las gyur pa yang yin la/ tshil gyi nad shas che ba yang ma yin na gso bar sla dzeeb yin no/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa'i rnam par 'grel pa tshig gi don gyi zla zer zhes bya ba/ slob dpon zla ba la dga' bas rnam par sbyar ba las/ nad gzhi'i gnas kyi le'u bcu pa'i rnam par 'grel pa'o// //de nas khong 'bras dang rgyu rlugs ⑧dang skran nad kyi nad gzhi bshad par bya'o—/ / zhes bya ba la/⑨ gcin snyi ba'i nad gzhi'i le'u'i ⑩skabs su slob dpon gyis⑩/ khong 'bras gzhan du bshad pa yin/ /zhes bya ba la/ de'i phyir 'di brtsams pa yin la/ rgyu rlugs (stedang skran nad dag de dang tshul mthun par le'u 'di brtsams (9pa yin no/ /kha zas khengs bu ④rab tsha dang / / rtsub dang skam 7dang tsha gyur zos/ /nyal ba'i spyod pa mi bde bas⑩/ /khrag nad skyed 'gyur de dang des/ /pags pa sha tshil rus pa dang / /khrag dang chu ba chu ba che/ /phyi dang nang du skrangs gyur pa/ /rtsa ba che zhing nad tshabs che/ /zlum pa'am 'jong par gnas pa gang / /khong 'bras de ni rnam pa drug /nad 113—1148

dmigs sna re 'dus pa dang / /khrag dang smas ①pa las byung ba'o/ /zhes bya ba la—/ kha zas g.yos zin nas mtshan mo 'das shing zhag lon pa'i khengs bu ②la sogs pa rgyud ①du zos pa dang / khrag nad skyed ④par 'gyur ba'i rgyu gzhan dag tu bsten pa de ༷dang des nad bskyed pas ⑥pags pa la sogs pa'i phyi dang nang gi cha la brten te skrangs par gyur pa gang yin pa de rtsa ba che zhing dbyung bar dka' la/ nad tshabs che zhing brnag par dka' ba'i skrang pa mezlum zhing kha zheng che ba'am/ 'jong par gnas shing dpangs skyering ba gang yin pa de ni khong 'bras zhes bya ⑨la/ khong 'bras de ni rlung la sogs pa'i nad sna re re 'dus pa dang / khrag dang smas ⑪ pa las byung ba ste rnam pa drug yin no/ /'dir phyi'i yan lag de dang ⑪der/ /rab na mdud pa 'dra la mtho/ /zhes bya ba la/'dir khong 'bras gnyis yod pa'i nang nas phyi ni lte ba dang / gzhang la sogs pa'i yan lag de dang der mi bzad par rab tu na ba dang / mdud pa byas shing brgyus pa ltar rdog rdog por 'dug pa dang / mtho zhing 'phags pa yin no//nang gi shin tu mi bzad cing / /gting ring skran ltar sra ba yin/ /grog mkhar lta bur mtho ba dang / /me dang mtshon ltar myur gsod byed/ /ces bya ba la/ nang gi khong 'bras ni shin tu mi bzad cing brnag par dka' bar na ba dang / gting ring zhing nang du nub pa ⑩dang / skran ltar sra zhing rem rem por gnas pa dang / grog mkhar gyi sa spungs pa'i rtse mo ltar mtho bar gnas pa dang / phyi'i khong 'bras pas nang gi khong 'bras myur du gsod par byed pa yin te—/ de yang me dang mtshon gyis myur du gsod par byed pa dang 'dra ba (ge'adir yang myur du gsod par byed pa yin no/ /lte ba chu so mchin mcher ⑩pa /113—1149

glo dang snying lto brla rtsa dang / /mkhal ma gnyis sam gzhang du'ang 'byung / /zhes bya ba la/ khong 'bras de ni lte ba dang chu so la sogs pa'i gnas gang yang rung ba'i lus kyi phyogs gcig tu ①'byung bar 'gyur ba ⑤yin no/ /de la rlung gyur nad tshabs drag /dmar nag ring zhig lon nas ni/ /'byung zhing smin pa dbyibs mi snyoms/ /ran zhing 7mgo 'khor sbo ba dang / /g.yo zhing 'pho la ④sgra dang bcas/ /zhes bya ba la/ khong 'bras de rlung las gyur pa ni nad tshabs drag cing rno ba dang / mdog dmar nag tu gnas pa dang / yun ring zhig lon nas 'byung zhing smin pa yin gyi/ myur du 'byung zhing smin pa ma rjoyin pa dang / nad kyi dbyebs mtho dman dang che chung mi snyoms pa dang / tshad ha cang mi che zhing ran pa la sogs pa yin no/ /mkhris gyur zangs ltar dmar rtsa gnag /skom dang tsha rims rmongs bag skyed/ /ldang zhing smin pa myur ba pya yin—/ /zhes bya ba la/ mkhris pa las gyur pa'i rmongs pa ⑦ni/ mdog dmar ba la sogs pa gang yang rung ba dang ldan pa dang / skom pa la sogs pa dang ldan par ldang zhing 'byung ba dang byun zhing ⑧rnags pa myur ba yin no/ /bad kan las skya g.ya' dang bcas/ /slon zhing bsil la sla ⑨ba dang / /glal zhing lci la yi ga 'chus/ /'byung zhing smin pa yun ring ⑩thogs/ /zhes bya ba larka/ de la bad kan las gyur pa'i khong 'bras ni kha dog dkar zhing skya ba dang /g.ya' ba la sogs pa'i nad dang bcas pa dang / 'byung ba ⑪dang smin pa'i dus yun ring du 'gor ⑩ba yin no/ /'dus pa las gyur 'dren ma yin/ /zhes bya ba la/ spyo'adus pa las gyur pa'i khong 'bras ni mtshan nyid 'dren ma dang ldan pa yin par ⑩khong du chud par bya'o/ /'dir ni phyi nang gnyis mtshan nyid/ /113—1150

don gyi dbang las shes par bya/ /zhes bya ba la/ khong 'bras bzhi po 'dir rab tu na ba dang / shin tu mi bzad par na ba'i rang gi mtshan nyid kyis ①phyi dang nang gnyis kyi mtshan nyid don gyi dbang las shes par bya ste/ rigs mthun pa dang mi mthun pa'i mtshan nyid shes pa las phyi nang gi mtshan nyid rnam par dbye bar bya zhing shes par bya'o/ /de ni 'di skad ston te/ rlung las gyur pa'i khong 'thas kyi mtshan nyid phyi dang nang du rnam par phye ste ma bshad mod kyi/'on kyang dmar ba nyid la sogs pa ④phyi rol du snang bar rig ①pa de ni de ④nyid las shes par bya ⑤la/ gang yang lto sbo ba dang yi ga 'chus pa la sogs pa nang gi rnam pa yin par 'thad pa de ni de nyid kyi mtshan ma yin par shes par bya'o/ /'brum bu nag pos khebs shing gnag /rab tsha na zhing rims kyis 'debs/ /mkhris pa'i rtags ldan phyi 'am rjonang / /khrag gyur bud ⑦med nyid la 'byung / /zhes bya ba la/ khrag las gyur pa'i khong 'bras gang yin pa de ni 'brum bu nag pos khebs shing gang ba yin la/ mdog ni gnag pa yin zhing rab tu tsha ba la sogs pa dang ldan pa dang / mkhris pa'i rtags zangs ltar dmar ba la ⑤sogs pa dang ldan pa de ni phyi'i yin yang rung nang gi yin yang rung ste/ de ni bud med kho na la 'byung gi skyes pa la ni ma yin no/ /mtshon la sogs pas smas ⑨/pa yis/ /rma byung mi 'phrod bsten pa las/ /rma kha'i tsha ba rlung gis phul/ /khrag bcas mkhris pa 'byung bar byed/ /khong 'bras bla brnan ⑩nad mang zhing / /khrag mkhris mtshan nyid can dag byed/ /ces bya ba la/ gang mtshon dang rdo la sogs pas smas ⑪shing snad par gyur pa des rma byung ⑫ba dang / mi 'phrod pa'i kha zas bsten cing longs spyad spyopas rma kha'i tsha ba rlung gis phul zhing bskyod pa ⑨113—1151

dang bcas pa'i mkhris pa 'byung zhing 'dzag par 'gyur ba de las khong 'bras bla brnan ①gyi nad mang zhing khrag dang mkhris pa'i mtshan nyid dang ldan par 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /bla brnan de yi rjodabye ba yang / /gnas ①kyi dbye ba las bshad do/ /zhes bya ba la/ khong 'bras de rnams kyi bla brnan nad bslangs buthabs su byung ba de'i dbye ba ni/ rang rang gi gnas sam rten gyi dbye ba las tha dad par gyur par drang srong rnams kyis bshad do/ /lte bar byung na skyigs bu ste—/ /zhes bya ba la/ khong 'bras de lte bar byung na bla brnan skyigs ⑤bu zhes bya ba 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /chu sor gcin 'gags rnag tu 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba la/ chu sor khong 'bras byung na gcin 'gags shing 'byung dka' la/rnag dang bcas shing dri mnam par 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /mcher pa dbugs mi bde/ zhes bya ba la/ mcher par khong 'bras byung na dbugs mi bde ba'i bla brnan du'abyung bar 'gyur ro/ /mchin par/ /dbugs 'byung 'gags ⑦skom mgo 'khor 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba la/ mchin par khong 'bras byung na dbugs 'byung ba 'gags shing gluskom dad dang / mgo 'khor ba'i nad kyis 'debs pa'i bla brnan du'abyung bar 'gyur ro/ /glo bar byung na sgog nad 'gyur//zhes bya ba la/ khong 'bras glo bar byung na gog ma'i ⑫nad rnams su 'gyur ro/ /snying byung ⑩yan lag kun gzir snyam/ /rab ⑫rmongs mun sros snyam du byed/ /snying 'phar na bar 'gyur ba yin/ /zhes bya ba la/ khong 'bras snying la byung na lus kyi yan lag kun dang snying ga shin tu gzir ⑫ba snyam sems shing bskyod mi nus pa lta bur 'gyur ba dang / de bzhin du rab tu rmongs shing 'du shes stor bar 'gyur ba dang / mun par zhugs pa snyam du sems pa dang / snying 113—1152

'phar zhing g.yo ba dang / na ba dang bcas par 'gyur ro/ /lto ba rtsib logs phrag pa'i bar/ /na zhing lto sbos 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba la/khong 'bras lte bar byung na lte ba dang / rtsib logs kyi bar dang / phrag pa gnyis kyi bar du na ba dang / lto ba de nyid sbos shing stikhrul khrul zer ba 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /chu so mdoms par byung ③brla na/ /zhes bya ba la/ khong 'bras chu so dang mdoms ①bar du byung na brla na zhing 'gul mi shes par 'gyur ro/ /mkhal mar byung na rked pa rgyab/ /rtsib logs su ni na bar 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba la/ khong 'bras mkhal ma gnyis su byung na rked pa dang rgyab dang rtsib logs su na zhing zug par 'gyur ro/ /gzhang du rlung ni thur 'byung 'gags/ /zhes thu bya ba la/ gzhang gi nang du khong 'bras byung na rlung thur du 'byung ba'i gags byed cing nang du ④'khyil bar 'gyur ro/ /zhu dang ma zhu phyed nyid zhu/ /de dag 'or nad lta bur bshad/ /ces bya ba la/ zhu ba'i gnas dang ma zhu ba'i gnas dang phyed tsam zhu ba ste/ legs par ma zhu ba'i gnas su byung ba bude dag ni 'or nad dam skrang bag gi nad kyi mtshan nyid dang 'dra bar bshad de/ skrang pa chung ba nad tshabs chung / /zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i gzhung gis ston to/ /lte ba yan chad smin khar 'dzag /ces bya ba la/ khong 'bras lte ba yan chad kyi nang na yod pa de dag smin par gyur na/ kha'i sgo nas rnag ⑦la sogs pa'i nad rnams 'dzag cing 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /lte ba man chad gzhang du 'dzag /ces bya ba la/ lte ba man chad kyi nang na khong 'bras gnas pa las smin par gyur pa gang dag yin pa de gzhang gi sgor rnag ⑤la sogs pa 'dzag par 'gyur ro//lte bar gnas pa gnyis kar 'dzag /ces bya ba la/ khong 'bras lte ba'i nang 113—1153

du byung na lus kyi dbus na gnas pa yin pa'i phyir kha dang gzhang gnyis ka nas 'byung stizhing 'dzag pa yin no/ /khong 'bras kyi ni nad dmigs rnams/ /'dzag 5las rma ltar shes par bya/ /zhes bya ba la/ khong 'bras kyi nad gzhi zhu rlung la sogs pa rgo rang gi 'dzag dnghapa ji lta ba las rma'i tshul bzhin du shes par bya'o—/ /ji ltar rma la rnag dang gsher bag 'dzag pa'i tshul las nad gzhi'i thutshul shes par bya ba mdo'i gnas su ji skad bshad pa de bzhin du 'dir yang tshul de dang 'dra bar brtag par bya'o/ /de las 'dus pa las gyur dang / /snying dang lte ba chu sor gnas/ /phyi 'am nang du bye ⑥ba 'am/ /smin te kha nas 'dzag pa ni/ /nyam chung bla brnan ⑦ldan pa spang / /zhes bya ba la/ 'dus pa las gyur pa'i khong 'bras gang yin pa de ni gsor mi rung bas spang bar bya'o/ /de bzhin du rlung la sogs pa 'ba' zhig las gyur pa yin yang snying ga dang lte ba dang chu sor gnas pa yang spang bar bya'o/ / de bzhin du nang ngam phyir kha bye zhing smin te zag pa yang spang bar bya'o/ /yang snying ga la sogs par gnas pa dzren te kha nas 'dzag par gyur pa nyam chung ba'i nad pa la byung ba yang spang bar bya'o / /de bzhin du bla brnan kyi nad yod pa dag kyang spang bar bya'o/ /⑤de bzhin ⑨bud med bu btsas pa'am/ /sbrum ma'am 7nu zho yod pa dang / /nu zho med pa'i nu ma yi/ /rtsa sgo kha byer phyin gyur nas/ /phyi yi khong 'bras mtshan nyid can/ /skrangs shing sra ba 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba la/ ji ltar khong 'bras zhes bya ba'i nad khong du kyezos pa la sogs pas skye ba bzhin du bud med bu btsas pa'am/ sbrum ma nu mar nu zho dang bcas pa'am/ nu zho med pa'i nu ma'i rtsa kha bye bar phyin nas phyi'i khong 'bras kyi mtshan nyid rab tu na ba 113—1154

dang / mdud pa 'dra zhing mtho ba la sogs pa ①'byung bar 'gyur te/ de yang skrang pa dang 'dra snyeba'i rang bzhin ③du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /④ de ni nu ma'i khong 'bras zhes bya ba yin no/ /bu mo rnams kyi nu rtsa'i khya sgo/ /phra bas 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes bya ba la/ nu ma'i khong 'bras de ni bu mo gzhon nu la ④'byung bar mi 'gyur te/ ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni ④nu ma'i rtsa sgo shin tu phra bas de 'byung bar mi 'gyur ba yin no/ /rlung ni rgyu lam 'gags pas 'khrugs/ /skrang dang gzer ni skyed cing rgyu/ /chu so rlig par phyin pa dang / /rlig par rgyu ba'i rtsa dag ni/ /bcir ⑦nas rlig pa pags pa dag kye /'phel zhing rlig rlugs ⑩nyid du byed/ /ces bya ba la/ rlung rang gi rgyu ba'i lam 'gags shing phan tshun rgyu ba'i go skabs su 1skyuchud par gyur pas 'khrugs shing nad skyed pas na skrang ⑫pa dang / gzer ba'i nad skyed cing rgyu nas rlig pa skrang bar ⑫byed cing / chu so dang rlig par phyin nas de la brten te/ meeg ④pa'i gnas su rgyu ba'i rtsa dag rab tu btsir zhing gnod par byas nas/ rlig pa dang pags pa 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i rlig rlugs skenyid byed par 'gyur ro/ /nad khrag gcin tshil rgyu ma las/ /rlig rlugs ⑩de ni rnam bdun 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba la/ rlig rlugs spertezhes bya ba'i nad de ni nad dmigs so so dang /khrag las byung ba dang / gcin dang / tshil dang / rgyu ma las byung ba ste rnam pa bdun yin no/ /rgyu ma gcin skyes pa 'am rlung / /rgyu ma'i dbye ba 'ba' zhig gzhan/ /zhes bya ba la/ rgyu ma'am/ gcin las skyes pa'i rlig rlugs spyodag kyang rlung las gyur pa dang 'dra mod kyi/ rgyu ma 1she'aba' zhig gi dbye bas tha dad pa yin zhing gzhan yang rjom yin no/ /rlung gyur rkyal pa gang 113—1155

'dra zhing / /reg na rtsub cing rgyu med na/ /zhes bya ba la/ rlung las gyur pa'i meeg rlugs ni ①rkyal pa rlung gis gang ba 'dra zhing / reg na rtsub pa dang /de bzhin du rgyu med par glo bur du na bar byed pa yin no/ /mkhris gyur u dusmra ra yi/ /'bras bu smin 'dra tsha dro 'drul/ /zhes bya ba la/ mkhris pa las gyur pa'i rlig rlugs ①kyi nad ni u dusmra ra'i 'bras bu smin pa dang mdog 'dra la/de bzhin du tsha ba la sogs pa dang ldan pa yin no/ /bad kan las bsil lci zhing snum/ /g.ya' zhing sra la nad tshabs chung / /zhes bya ba la/ bad kan las gyur pa'i rlig rlugs ⑦kyi nad ni/ bsil ba la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa yin no/ /khrag gyur gnag sticing 'brum bus khyab/ /mkhris pa'i rlig rlugs ⑤mtshan nyid ldan/ /zhes bya ba la/ khrag las gyur pa'i rlig rlugs pyani snag tsha ltar gnag cing / 'brum bu nag pos khyab pa dang /mkhris pa'i rlig rlugs ④kyi mtshan nyid u dusmra ra'i 'bras bu min pa dang 'dra ba la sogs pa dang ldan pa yin no/ /tshil gyur rlig rlugs ⑧bad kan 'dra/ /'jam zhing tā la'i 'bras bur mtshungs/ /zhes bya ba la/ tshil las gyur pa'i rlig rlugs ⑨kyi nad ni/ bsil zhing snum pa ⑪la sogs pa bad kan gyi mtshan nyid dang 'dra ba dang / yang de 'jam zhing tā la'i 'bras bu dang mtshungs shing 'dra ba yin no/ /gcin brnag ⑪pa la brten pa rnams/ /gcin las 'byung bar de 'gyur te/ /rkyal pa chu yis gang ba ltar/ /g.yo 'gyur ⑫nad dang bcas shing 'jam/ /gcin 'gags pa dang rlig pa yi⑫/ /'og tu skrang bar byed par 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba la/ gcin snyoms la brnag cing ④nan gyis 'geg ⑩par byed pa la brten pa'i skyes bu rnams la ni/ gcin las byung ba'i 113—1156

rlig rlugs ①'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /⑤de ni rkyal pa chus gang ba ltar g.yo zhing 'gul bar 'khrug ①par 'gyur la/ de yang nad dang bcas shing 'jam zhing mnyen ④par 'gyur ba dang / de bzhin du gcin 'gags shing sri ba dang /de bzhin du rlig pa'i 'og tu gdu bu ltar skrang bar ⑤byed par 'gyur ro/ /rlung 'khrugs pa yi zas dang ni/ /chu grang la ni rkyal ba dang / /shugs bkag babyung dang khur ⑦dang lam/ /yan lag log par gcus ④pa dang / /rlung 'khrugs pa ni gzhan gyis kyang / /gang tshe rgyu ma phra mo'i cha/ /rlung gis log par phul 'gyur ⑦te/ /rang gi gnas nas thur du bskyod/ /chu so'i tshigs su phyin pa dang / /de tshe mdud pa ltar glo ⑨'gyur/ /zhes bya ba la/ rlung 'khrug par byed pa'i kha zas rtsub pa dang / bska ba la sogs pa bsten pa dang / de bzhin du chu grang mo la rkyal gyis brgal ba dang / de bzhin du bshang gci la sogs pa'i shugs 'byung ba bkag pa dang / nan gyis btsir ba dang / khur la sogs pas gnod par 'gyur ba'i rgyu gzhan dag gis rlung 'khrugs ⑩par gyur pa'i dus gang gi ⑪tshe rgyu ma phra mo'i cha ste/ rgyu ma phre'u phyogs gcig log par phul te/ rang gi gnas nas thur du bskyod cing chu so'i tshigs su rlung gnas pa de'i tshe/ mdud pa ltar glo ba'i skrang bag skyed par 'gyur ro/ /yal bar bor na rlig pa cher skye zhing / /sbo zhing na la rengs par rlung gis byed/ /rab tu gzer zhing nang na sgra dang bcas/ /gang bar byed cing bcug kyang slar 'byung byed—/ /ces bya ba la/ nad nge yal bar bor zhing gso ba ma byas na/ rlig pa skye zhing 'phel bar 'gyur ba dang / lto sbo zhing rengs par rlung des skyed par byed pa dang / yang rlung des ⑫rab tu gzer zhing ⑫nyen pas rlung ⑫sgra dang 113—1157

bcas shing krul krul zer ba dang / yang rlung gis gang bar byed cing phyung ba de bcug kyang slar 'byung bar byed pa yin no/ /rgyu rlugs ①'di ni gso dka' ste//rlung gi rlig rlugs ⑤'dra ba yin/ /rtsub cing gnag la dmar ba'i rtsa①/ /phra mo'i dra bas khebs pa yin/ /zhes bya ba la/ rgyu rlugs ④zhes bya ba'i nad 'di ni gso dka' zhing bcos par mi nus pa yin la/ yang de ni rlung gi rlig rlugs ltadang mtshan ma 'dra ba yin te/ rlung gyur rkyal pa gang 'dra zhing / /reg na rtsub cing rgyu med na/ /zhes bya ba'i gzhung gis bstan pa yin no/ /yang de bzhin du rtsub cing mdog gnag la 4dmar ba'i rtsa'i tshogs phra mo'i dra bas khebs shing khyab par 'gyur ba yin no/ /skran brgyad nad ni so so dang / /'dres dang 'dus pa las gyur dang / /zla dzeematshan gyi ni nyes pa yis/ /brgyad pa bud med rnams la 'byung / /zhes bya ba la/ skran ni rnam pa brgyad yod de/de yang rlung la sogs pa'i ④nad gzhi so so las byung ba gsum dang / nad gzhi gnyis gnyis dang ⑨'dres pa'i ldan pa las gyur pa gsum dang / nad gzhi gsum car ⑩'dus pa las gyur pa gcig ⑪dang / bud med rnams la zla mtshan gyi nad kyi nyes pa las byung ba gcig ste/ de ltar na spyir brgyad yin no/ /rims dang slon dang tshad 'khru sogs/ /skyug sman sogs dang las rnams kyis/ /skem gyur rlung skyes zas za dang / /bkres te chu grang 'thungs gyur pa'am/ /skom 'thungs rjes la gang zhig ni/ / rkyal dang mchong spyob la sogs pa/ /bsten ⑫pas lus ni dkrugs byas dang / /slon ⑫mi bro yang skyugs spyopa dang / /rlung la sogs pa 'byung ba yi/ /shugs bkag pa 'am gcin bcir ba'am⑩/ /snum dang dugs ni ma bsten ⑫par/ /sbyang ba'i las ni byed pa dang spyo/ /113—1158

sbyangs zin myur du tsha ba dang / /bad kan skyed pa'i zas skom sbyad/ /rlung rgyas pa yi nad rnams ni/ /so so'am 'dres pa'am 'khrugs gyur pa'am/ /kun nas khrag dang bcas 'khrugs pas/ /sbubs ①can la ni brten ⑤gyur nas/ /steng 'og lam ni bkag nas su/ /gzer sngon 'gro zhing reg tu rung / /shin tu mtho ①zhing mdud pa'i gzugs/ /skran ni skyed par 'gyur ba yin/ /zhes bya ba la/ skran 'byung ba'i rgyu ni rims la sogs pa'i nad rnams dang / de bzhin du sgyug ④sman la sogs pa ste/ skyug busman dang bkru sman dang / bkru sman drag bo mas gtong rjob dang / 'jam rtsi dang / mgo bo'i bkru sman zhes bya ba'i dpyad kyi ⑦sbyor ba nyes pa dang / de bzhin du drag shul gyi nad rnams kyis skem zhing sbegs ④par gyur pa dang / rlung skyes pa'i zas rtsub cing kha ba la sogs pa za ba dang / de bzhin du bkres shing zas za bar 'dod pa'i skabs su zas ma zos par chu grang mo 'thung ba'am⑨/ yang na skom 'thungs pa'i rjes la rkyal ⑩ba dang mchong ba dang nyal po bsten pa dang / rta rgyug pa la sogs pa la brten cing / lus 'khrugs shing ⑪bskyod par ⑫byas pa dang / yang na slon mi bro ba ⑫bzhin du nan gyis slon zhing sgyugs pa dang / rlung dang bshang gci la sogs pa'i shugs 'byung bar ldog ④bzhin du nan gyis bkag cing brnag skepa dang / de dag nan gyis btsir ba dang / yang na snum dang dugs kyi cho ga yang dang yang du bya ba ma bsten ⑫cing goms par ma byas par sbyang ba'i las skyug ⑩sman dang bkru sman la sogs pa gtang spyob dang / yang na sbyangs zin cing skyug ⑩sman btang ba la sogs pa byas zin pa'i rjes thogs nyid la myur bar lus tsha bar byed pa'i zas skom la bsten ⑦pa dang / de bzhin du bad kan skyed pa'i meljan 113—1159

ljin 'phel ba'i zas skom longs spyad pa dang / de bzhin du rlung rgyas shing 'phel ba'i nad kyi dri ma rnams so sor 'khrugs par 'gyur ba'am/ gnyis pa'i ldan pa sti'akhrugs pa'am/ yang na gzhi ⑦thams cad 'khrugs pa'am/ khrag dang bcas pas ①'khrugs shing g.yos pas sbubs chen po ste/ lto ba zhes bya ba'i lus kyi dbyibs ④kyi cha de la brten cing gnas nas de'i 'og tu rtsa bo che'i nang du zhugs te/ steng dang 'og gi lam bkag nas skran skyed par 'gyur la de yang gzer sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas nad skyed par 'gyur zhing / reg tu rung ba shin tu mtho rjozhing 'bur bar mdud pa'i gzugs can ltar ril ril por gnas pa'i skran zhes bya ba skyed par 'gyur ba yin no/ /skem pas bad kan mkhris bshang ba'i/ /rgyun srang 'gags par gyur pa yis④/ /rlung ni khong par gnas bcas pa/ /rtsub pas sra bar gyur pa yin/ /rang gnas ldang gyur rang dbang can/ /gzhan gnas la brten gzhan dbang can/ /gong por gyur pas gzugs med kyang / /gzugs can ltar gnas skran zhes bya/ /chu so lte ba snying ga dang / /rtsib logs la ni gnas pa yin/ /zhes bya ba la/ skem zhing lus zungs zad pas lan 'ga' zhig rlung 'khrugs shing ldang bar 'gyur la/lan 'ga' zhig ni bad kan dang mkhris pa dang bshang ba ⑦rgyu ba'i bu ga'i lam srang 'gags par 'gyur bas 'khrugs par 'gyur la/ 'khrugs pa'i rlung de khong pa'i nang du gnas bcas shing brten par gyur pa yin la/ des na skertsub pa'i rgyus sra zhing mkhrang bar gyur pa yin la/ rlung de rang gi gnas na gnas pa'i tshe na ni rang dbang can zhes bya ba la/ rang gi gnas bad kan dang mkhris pa'i gnas la brten pa'i tshe na ni gzhan dbang can zhes bya'o/ /yang nad de ni 113—1160

gong por gnas pas na reg tu rung bar gyur pas/ rlung de gzugs med pa ste sra ba ma yin du zin kyang gzugs can lta bur gnas shing mdud pa'i gzugs su 'dug pas ming skran zhes bya bar ① btags pa yin no/ /de yang chu so la sogs pa'i gnas su ①gnas pa yin te/ chu so dang lte ba ①snying ga dang rtsib logs rjogayas g.yon te lngar gnas pa yin no/ /rlung las mjing ayopa klad pa spyogazer—/ /rims 'debs mcher na rgyu ma 'khrug /bshang sri khab kyis gtsags ⑦ snyam na/ /dbugs 'byin yang dang yang mi phyin/ /lus rengs kha ni skam pa dang / /skem ④zhing me drod mi snyoms dang / /lpags ⑨sogs gnag cing rtsub pa dang / /rlung skran g.yo ba yin pa'i phyir/ /dbyibs ni brtag ⑩ par mi mngon zhing / /gnas 'phel 'bri dang na ba dang / /grog mas khyab pa lta bur ⑪ni/ /skran ni 'gul zhing zug pa yin/ /zhes bya ba la/ rlung las gyur pa'i skran nad ni mjing ba dang klad pa gzer ⑫ba la sogs pa'i nad kyis 'debs par 'gyur ba ⑫dang / khab kyis gtsags ⑫pa snyam du na zhing zug pa dang / dbugs 'byin par skedaka' zhing yang dang yang du mi thon pa dang /lus rengs shing ⑩'gyur mi shes pa dang / skem zhing rid pa dang / pags pa dang mig dang sen mo dang gdong dang ⑩lce la sogs pa gnag pa dang / rlung gi rang bzhin g.yo ⑫zhing mi brten pa yin pa'i phyir dbyibs dang rang bzhin brtag par dka' zhing gnas gcig na mi 'dug pa dang / 'phel ba dang 'bri bar snang ba dang / na zhing zug pa dang grog ⑪mas khyab cing gang ba lta bur skran de 'gul ba dang / zug cing na ba yin no/ /mkhris las tsha zhing sgregs skyur brgyal—/ /'khru zhing lus rngul skom rims 'debs/ /pags pa la sogs ser 113—1161

por snang / /skran ni reg par mi bzod dang / /tsha zhing 'bar la dro ba dang / /rang gi gnas ni bsregs snyam byed/ /ces bya ba la/ mkhris pa las gyur pa'i skran ni tsha ba la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa dang / skran mang zhing reg par mi bzod cing na ba dang / tsha 'ur 'ur po la sogs pa dang ldan pa yin no//bad kan slon bag yi ga 'chus/ /me drod nyams shing grang rims 'debs/ /cham pa khong snyom ①dang ga lci/ /lud pa lu zhing beegs 1sogs dkar/ /skran phugs ring zhing sra kyeb dang / /lci zhing rang gnas brtan byand chung / /zhes bya ba la/ bad kan las gyur pa'i skran nad ni slon ⑤bag la sogs pa dang ldan par phyon zhing pags pa dang sen mo la sogs pa dkar zhing skya ba dang / de bzhin du skran phugs ring zhing rdo ltar sra ba dang / lci zhing tshor ba med pa lta bu dang / rang gi gnas na brtan par gnas shing mi 'gyur ba dang nad tshabs chung zhing rgyu ba dal ba yin no/ /phal cher rang gnas 'dug pa dang / /rang gi ⑦dus su nad skyed byed/ /ces bya ba la/ skran de dag ni phal cher nad rang rang gi gnas na 'dug cing brten la/ rang merang gi ldang ba'i dus su nad skyed par byed pa yin no/ /de yang rlung las gyur pa'i skran nad phal cher ni dku'i (shwaphyogs su gnas la/ mkhris pa las gyur pa'i skran ni phal cher lte ba la gnas so/ /bad kan las gyur pa'i skran ni phal cher rtsib logs gnyis dang snying gar gnas so/ /rang gi dus ni nyin mtshan dang zas zos pa la sogs pa nad rang rang 'byung ba'i dus su rlung dang mkhris pa dang bad kan las gyur pa'i skran lhag par ldang zhing na bar 'gyur ro/ /gnyis las byung ba'i skran gsum po//mtshan nyid 'dren mar khya 3ldan pa yin/ /zhes bya ba la/ nad gzhi gnyis 113—1162

'dres pa las byung ba'i skran gsum ni mtshan nyid gnyis po gang dag yin pa de'i cha 'dren ma dang ldan pa yin no/ /kun skyes mi bzad na zhing tsha/ /myur smin sra mtho de gso dka'/ /zhes bya ba la/ nad gzhi gsum po kun 'dus pa las skyes pa'i skran ni mtshan nyid thams cad dang ldan zhing mi bzad par na ba dang / lhag par tsha ba dang / myur du smin pa dang sra zhing dpangs mtho ba yin te/ de ni gso dka' ba yin pas gso dpyad kyis bcos kyang mi 'tsho'i/ /khrag gi skran ni gang yin pa/ /de ni bud med nyid la 'byung / /zhes bya ba la/skran brgyad pa khrag las gyur pa'i skran ni bud med kho na la 'byung gi skyes pa la ni 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /zla mtshan dus sam bu gsar btsas yang na mngal gyi nad can gyis/ /bud med rlung skyed bsten gyur pas/ /rlung ni 'khrugs par gyur pa las/ /zla re 'byung bar byed pa yi/ /zla mtshan mngal du bkag pas ni/ /de ni mngal chags 'drar snang zhing / /mtshan ma gsal bar ston byed de/ /snying 'phar nu 'dzag yid mi bde/ /skem pa la sogs tshul du snang / /zhes bya ba la/ zla mtshan dang ldan pa'am/ zla mtshan gyi dus la bab pa ①gsar du btsas pa'am/ zla ba ma tshang bar 'phyil ②bar gyur pa dang / yang na bud med mngal nad can gyis rlung skyed par byed pa'i zas dang skom bsten cing spyad par gyur pas/ bud med de'i rlung gi nad 'khrugs par gyur pa las zla ba re re zhing rgyu bar byed pa'i zla mtshan bkag cing phyir 'byung du mi ster bas zla re 'byung ba de mngal na bu chags ①pa lta bu'i tshul de sogs rjoshing 'phel bar gyur nas/ mngal du chags pa'i mtshan ma snang zhing gsal bar ston par byed de/ snying 'phar ba la sogs pa'i mtshan ma snang ba 113—1163

yin no/ /de nas ①rim kyis rlung 'dres dang / /mkhris pa yi ni rgyu yis na/ /rlung dang mkhris pa las byung ba'i④/ /skran ni khrag de skyed byed yin/ /na zhing sra la tsha zhing 'khru/ /skom dad rims sogs bla brnan ①'byung / /nad kyi khrag la brten pas na/ /mngal gnas dag tu lhag par gzer④/ /mngal nas dri nga 'dzag pa dang / /na zhing 'phar la zug par byed/ /ces bya ba la/ dus kyi rim gyis rjorlung dang khrag de 'dres shing 'dus par gyur pa dang / mkhris pa'i rgyur gyur pa nyid kyis nad phyokhrag de rlung dang mkhris pa las byung ba'i skran kyi nad khrag de skyed dzeepar byed cing bla brnan ⑧kyi nad na zhing sra ba la sogs pa 'byung ⑨bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du lhag par yang nad kyi khrag la brten cing gnas pas—/ mngal gyi gnas su lhag par gzer zhing na ba dang / mngal nas dri nga ba ⑩'dzag pa dang / sogs par ⑪byed par 'gyur ro/ /mngal chags 'dra yang yan lag med/ /'on kyang skran ni 'gul gzer ldan/ /de nyid der ni gong por gnas/ /lan 'ga' 'gul bar byed pa yin/ /'di ni ltor 'phel mi byed kyi/ /skran nyid 'phel bar byed pa yin/ /zhes bya ba la/ gal te khrag gi skran chags pa de mngal na bu chags pa dang cha 'dra na yang yan lag la sogs pa dang ldan pa'i sems can yod pa ma yin gyi/ 'on kyang 'gul zhing gzer ba dang ldan pa yin no/ /yang skran de nyid ni mngal gyi gnas der gong por gzugs can du gnas la/ lan 'ga' yun ring zhig nas 'gul bar byed pa yin no/ /yang 'di'i mngal du bu chags nas ⑫'phel bar byed pa ma yin gyi/ /spyogazhan du khrag las chags pa'i skran nyid 'phel bar byed pa yin no/ /rang gi nad gzhi la brten nas/ /des ⑫der skran nad thams cad skyed/ /yun ring 113—1164

nas ①ni smin 'gyur ba'am/ /yang na ma ①smin/ /zhes bya ba la/ nad rang rang gi nad gzhi'i tshul la brten cing gnas nas skran thams cad skye bar 'gyur ba yin la/ rgyu des ①na yun ring zhig nas rjosmin par 'gyur ba'am/ yang na smin par mi 'gyur ro/ /khong 'bras kyang / nad khrag la ni brten pa'i phyir/ /shin tu myur bar rjosmin par 'gyur/ /de phyir myur du tsha 'gyur bas/ /khong 'bras zhes ni de la bshad/ /ces bya ba la/ yang khong 'bras su gyur pa ni khrag nad rjoshin tu gnod par byed pa la brten cing gnas pa yin pa'i phyir shin tu myur zhing rings par smin cing rdol ⑦bar 'gyur ro/ /de nad skekyi phyir myur du tsha zhing sreg par byed pas de la ming khong 'bras zhes bya bar bshad do/ /nang gnas skran ni chu so dang / /lto ba mchin pa snying na zhing / /me drod mdog nyams ⑨nyams stobs 'bri/ /shugs ni 'gag par 'gyur ba yin/ /zhes bya ba la/ nang na gnas shing brten pa'i mtshan ma ni chu so la sogs par na ba dang / me drod la sogs pa nyams shing 'adzre ba ni bshang gci ⑩la sogs pa'i shugs 'byung ba 'gag ⑪par 'gyur ba yin no/ /phyi rol de las bzlog pa ste—/ /khong pa'i yan lag nad ⑫tshabs chung / /phyogs de'i ⑫mdog ni nyams pa dang / /phyi rol du ni mthong zhing 'phags/ /zhes bya ba la/ phyi rol du byung ba'i skran ni nang du 'byung ba'i skran gyi mtshan ma de las go bzlog pa yin te/chu so la sogs par na bar mi 'gyur ba dang / me drod la sogs pa nyams par mi 'gyur ba dang / shugs mi 'gag cing bde blag tu 'byung ba dang khong pa'i yan lag lte ba la sogs par nad tshabs chung zhing shas che bar mi na ba dang /skran chags pa'i phyogs ④de'i mdog nyams shing kha dog gzhan du 'gyur ba dang /113—1165

de bzhin du phyi rol du lhag par mthong zhing 'phags pa yin no/ /lto sbo lhag par mi bzad na/ /rgyu ma'i sgra bcas mi bzad na/ /sbo bcas lto ba na ba dang //rlung gi nad kyis steng 'og bkag /de ni ten gyi zhes byar bshad/ /ces bya ba la/ lto ①sbo zhing sgra dang bcas pa dang / steng 'og tu rlung gi lam bkag pas lhag par mi bzad par na zhing / brnag par dka' ba la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa de ni/ lto sbo ③hen kyi nad ces bya ba yin par slob dpon gyis bshad do/ /sra zhing gtun 'dra mdud pa can/ /gtun 'dra gyen du mtho bar gnas/ /hen gyi 1mtshan ldan/ zhes bya ba la/ nad gang sra zhing rdo'i gtun 'dra zhing mdud pa can du gnas la/ gtun ④rdo dang dbyibs 'dra zhing gyen du mtho bar 'jong bag tu gnas pa ten gyi mtshan nyid dang ldan pa ni gtun 'dra ba zhes bya'o/ /gtun bu ni/ 'phred gnas de dang tshul 'dra yin—/ /zhes bya ba la/ gtun bu zhes bya ba'i nad ni 'phred du thad kar gnas kyi/ gyen du 'gro ba ma yin la/ nad kyi tshul ni gtun 'dra ba dang mtshungs te/ de lta bu'i nad la ni gtun bu zhes bya'o/ /zhu ba'i gnas nas gzhang ⑤pho mtshan/ /rlung ni mi bzad na zhing rgyu du/ /thur du zug pa yin par ⑦bshadaske/ /ces bya ba la/ zhu ba'i nad ⑤ lte ba'i 'og tu ⑨gnas gzhang dang pho mtshan dag tu rlung rgyu zhing / lhag par na bar byed pa de ni thur du zug pa zhes bya'o—/ /de las bzlog pa gyen du zug pa'o⑩/ /zhes bya ba la/ gyen du zug pa zhes bya ba'i nad ni de las bzlog pa ste/ gzhang dang pho mtshan gyi gnas nas lte bar ⑩gyen du zug cing na 7la gyen du zug pa zhes bya'o/ /sgregs pa mang zhing bshang ba 'gags pa dang / / 'grangs za ⑫mi nus rgyu ma sgra dang bcas④/ /113—1166

sbo zhing hen langs kha zas 'ju mi nus/ /skran ni nyer 'byung mtshan ma yin par bshad—/ /ces bya ba la/ mi gang la skran nye bar 'ongs par 'gyur ba'i sngar 'byung ba'i tshul ni sgregs pa mang po yang dang yang du 'byung bar 'gyur ba dang /bshang ba 'gags shing sri ba dang / 'grangs ①shing tshim par za ma ②nus pa dang / rgyu ma sgra dang bcas shing mi gsal ba'i sgra krul krul zer ba dang / sbo zhing lto rgyas la hen langs pa dang / me drod zhan pas kha zas 'ju bar mi byed pa ste/ de dag ni skran ring po mi thogs par 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i mtshan ma yin par slob dpon gyis ①bstan cing bshad pa yin no/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa'i rnam par 'grel pa tshig gi don kyi zla zer zhes bya ba/slob dpon zla ba la dga' bas rnam par sbyar ba las/ nad gzhi'i gnas ④kyi le'u bcu gcig pa'i rnam par 'grel pa'o// //de nas dmu rdzing gi ⑦nad gzhi bshad par bya'o/ /zhes bya ba la/ 'di na pyakhong 'bras la sogs pa dang tshul ⑦'dra bas 'di brtsams pa yin no/ /nad kun me drod nyams las skye/ /lhag par dmu rdzing nad skye zhing / /ma zhu dri ma can gyi zas/ /dri ma sogs las skye bar 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba la/ gang gi phyir nad thams cad kyang pho ba'i me drod nyams pa las skye bar 'gyur ba yin mod kyi—/ khyad par du'am/ lhag par dmu rdzing gi ⑧nad ni/ pho ba'i me drod nyams pa las skye bar 'gyur la/ de bzhin du ma zhu ⑨ba rnam pa bzhi dang /dri ma can gyi ⑩zas rul pa dang / zhag lon pa'i khengs bu dang / 'dren ma la sogs pa'i ⑪skyon dang ldan pa spyobasten pa dang / de bzhin du nad kyi dri ma 113—1167

yun ring du 7sogs shing 'phel bar 'gyur ba ⑤las dmu rdzing gi nad skye zhing 'byung bar 'gyur te/ de dag ni nad kyi rgyu bstan pa yin no/ /nad kyis ①chu ni rgyu ba'i rtsa/ /steng dang 'og tu bkag nas ni/ /srog dang thur sel la gnod de/ /pags pa sha yi bar gnas nad/ /lto ba bkang ste dmu rdzing skyed0//ces bya ba la/ rlung la sogs pa'i nad kyis chu'am/ bad kan kyi tshogs rgyu ba'i rtsa lus kyi steng 'og tu rgyu ba bkag nas rgyu des srog ces bya ba'i rlung la sogs pas gnod cing 'khrugs par byas nas pags pa dang sha'i bar na yod pa'i nad drangs te/ lho ba bkang nas dmu rdzing skyed ⑤cing 'byung bar byed pa yin no/ /de yang rnam pa brgyad 'gyur te/ /nad gzhi tha dad 'dus ⑦mcher pa / /dri ma 'gags dang rgyu rdol dang / /zhes bya ba la/ dmu rdzing de yang grangs kyi dbye ba rnam pa brgyad du 'gyur te/ rlung dang mkhris pa rjo bad kan gyi nad gzhi tha dad pa las byung ba gsum dang / gsum char 'dus pa las byung ba gcig dang / mcher pa las byung ba dang / dri skem 'gags pa'i dmu rdzing dudang / rgyu ma rdol ba'i dmu rdzing ⑩dang / chu'i dmu rdzing ⑪ste rnam pa brgyad do//des gzir rkan dang mchu bskams ⑫shing / /rkang pa lag pa gsus pa skrangs/ /spyod pa kha zas nyams stobs 'bri45/ /skem zhing gsus pa cher skyes la/ /mi ni yi dwags gzugs can 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba la/ dmu rdzing gi nad des gzir ④cing nyen pa'i mi ni rkan dang mchu bskams ⑩par gyur pa dang / rkang pa dang pags ⑩pa dang lto ba skrangs pa ⑩dang / lus kyi spyod pa nyams pa dang / kha zas za ba'i rtsol ba nyams pa dang / lus kyi nyams stobs 'bri spyozhing zad pa dang / skem spyozhing sha dang khrag zad pa dang / gsus pa cher skyes shing rgyas 113—1168

par 'gyur te/ mdor na mi de yi dwags kyi gzugs can lta bu'am/ 'chi ba dang 'dra bar 'gyur ro/ /de ni 'byung 'gyur mtshan ma dag /bkres pa med cing zas kun ni/ /ring nas tsha zhing sgyur ①bcas 'ju/ /'ju dang mi 'ju mi shes la/ /'grangs ④par za yang mi nus shing / /stobs ni rtag tu zad par 'gyur—/ /cung zad bskyod kyang dbugs mi bde/ /bshang ba 'phel zhing 'gags ③par byed/ /rkang pa gnyis su cung zad duskrang / /chu sor na zhing zas yang ba/ /cung zad zos kyang gsus pa rgyas/ /rtsa rgyas lto ba'i gnyer ma 'jig /ces bya ba la/ dmu rdzing de nye bar 'byung ba'i mtshan nyid dam sngar byung ba'i tshul ni zas ⑤ma zos kyang bkres pa'i bag med pa dang / ro drug dang ldan pa'i kha zas kun kyang tsha ba dang bcas shing skyur bag gi rnam pas ⑦ring zhig lon nas ⑦gdod 'ju ba dang / zas zos pa zhu bar gyur tam/ skezhu bar ma gyur pa stiblos rtogs shing shes par mi 'gyur ba dang / 'grangs ⑩par za zhing longs srud par mi nus pa dang / lus kyi stobs nyin mtshan rtag tu zad cing 'bri bar 'gyur ba dang / lus bskyod ⑪pa'i g.yo 'gul gyi bya ba cung za da byas kyang / dbugs mi bde zhing brtsegs spyopa dang / bshang ba nang du 'phel zhing sogs la phyir mi 'byung bar 'gags pa ⑫dang / de bzhin du rkang pa skrangs spyopa nas lto ba'i gnyer ma 'jig cing mi snang ba'i bar gyi mtshan ma 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /dmu sprung nad ni thams cad la/ /snyom zhing nyam chung 'gyur ba dang / /dri ma sri zhing me drod chung / /tsha zhing skrangs la gsus pa sbo/ /mjug spyotu chu ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba la/ dmu rdzing thams cad kyi spyi'i mtshan ma ni snyom pa la sogs pa yin te/ snyom 7pa ni gnyid ⑫kyis myos 113—1169

pa snyam du yul ①'dzin par mi nus pa'o/ /tsha ba ni lus tsha ba 'ur 'ur pos khyab pa'o/ /dmu rdzing ⑤de dag thams cad kyi 'jug gam mthar ni lto ba'i nang du chu 'byung zhing des gang bar 'gyur ro/ /thams cad chu med bar du smug/skrang med khur ltar lci ma ⑦yin/ /rtsa dra'i ④skar khung ris kyis ⑤khebs/ /rtag tu sgra ni 'ur 'ur zer/ /rlung gis lte ba rgyu mar zhugs ⑦/ /shugs bskyed nad ni 'jig par 'gyur/ /snying ga lte ba rked pa dang / /gzhang dang chu so na bar byed/ /rlung ni sgra dang bcas par rgyu/ /bshang ba 'gags shing megaci ba nyung / /me drod chung min skam pa min/ /kha ⑧ni ro bro med ma kyeyin/ /zhes bya ba la/ dmu rjing gi nad thams cad ni/ dmu chur ma gyur par sha mdog smug cing dmar bar snang la/ skrang pa'i tshabs ⑩mi che zhing cung zad skrangs skyepa dang / khur bu ltar shin tu spru ba ma yin pa dang / rtsa'i dra ba'i tshogs kyis skar khung ltar g.yogs shing khebs pa dang / rtag tu ⑫dus thams cad du khong pa'i nang na sgra 'ur 'ur por grag cing bar snang gi 'brug ltar sgra grag ⑫pa dang /rlung lte ba dang rgyu mar zug cing na bar byed pa nas/ sgra'i ⑩shugs bskyed cing byung nas 'jig ste ⑩mi snang bar 'gyur ba dang / yang rlung gis ⑩snying ga la sogs par na zhing zug par byed pa dang / yang rlung de lto ba'i nang na sgra dang bcas shing rgyu zhing phan tshun 'gro ba dang / bshang ba 'gags shing sri bar byed pa dang / gcin gyi tshogs nyung bar byed pa dang / khong pa'i me drod shin tu chung ba ma yin pa dang / skam zhing zas la gdu ba ma yin pa dang / kha'i nang na ro bro ba med pa ma hurteyin te ro dang bcas pa yin no/ /de la rlung gi dmu rdzing ni/ /rkang lag rlig pa lho ba skrang tsho3/ /lto ba rtsib logs rked ⑪rgyab na/ /113—1170

tshigs rnams bye ba ①snyam du sems/ /lud pa skam zhing yan lag snyom/ /ro smad lci zhing bshang gci 'gags/ /pags pa la sogs gnag la smug /glo bur du ni 'phel zhing 'bri/ /gsus par zug cing na ba dang / /rtsa bran nag pos khyab cing rgyas/ /brdabs ①na rkyal pa dbugs kyis ni/ /gang ba lta bu'i sgra dang ldan/ /'dir rlung ①nad dang sgrar bcas pas/ /thams cad du ni rgyu bar byed/ /ces bya ba la/ de la dmu rdzing rjornams kyi nang nas/ rlung las gyur pa'i dmu rdzing rjoni rkang pa dang lag pa la sogs pa skrang par 'gyur ba dang /rjorus pa'i tshigs men zhing zhig pa snyam du sems pa dang / lud pa bad kan med par skam por 'byung ba dang / yan lag snyom zhing ⑧grugs pa snyam du sems pa dang / lus kyi ro smad lci zhing gdeg dka' ba snyam du sems pa dang /bshang gci dri ma 'gags shing ⑨sri ba dang / pags pa dang sen mo dang mig dang lce dang bshang ba la () sogs pa mdog gnag cing smug par snang ba dang /rgyu med par glo bur du de'i lho ba cher 'phel zhing ⑪'azi bar 'gyur ba dang /zug cing shas cher na ba dang / rtsa bran gyi tshogs nag pos khyab cing rgyas par 'gyur ba dang / lto ba la lag pa la sogs pas brdabs shing bsnun na rkyal pa dbugs kyis gang ba la mnan pa lta bu'i sgra dang ldan pa dang / dmu rdzing ⑫'di la rlung sgra dang bcas pas ⑫thams cad du rgyu zhing 'gro bar byed pa yin no/ /mkhris pa'i dmu rdzing ④rims 'debs rgyas④/ /lus tsha skom dang kha ro kha/ /mgo 'khor tshad 'khru pags pa sogs/ /ser zhing gsus pa'i mdog rtsa sngo/ /rtsa ni ⑩dmar ser dag gis khyab/ /rngul dang tsha bar bcas pas sreg⑩ /ngab 'byung reg na 'jam pa dang / /myur du smin cing nyer gdung 'gyur/ /zhes 113—1171

bya ba la/ mkhris pa las gyur pa'i dmu rdzing ① ni rims kyis 'debs pa la sogs pa 'byung ba dang / pags pa dang sen mo la sogs pa mdog ser ba dang /gsus pa'i mdog rtsa sngo bar snang ba dang / rtsa'i mdog dmar po dang ser po dag gis ⑤/khebs pa dang / lus rngul zhing tsha ba dang bcas pas me ltar sreg ④par byed pa dang / ngad 'byung zhing du ba 'thul ba lta bu 'byung bar 'gyur ba dang / reg na 'jam zhing mnyen pa dang / myur du rmin cing tshos par mi 'gyur ba dang / nye bar gdung zhing bsreg ④par 'gyur ba yin no/ /bad kan dmu rdzing lhu tshigs ⑪na/ /tshor ba med cing skrang la lci/ /gnyid ⑥che slon zhing yi ga 'chus/ /lud pa dbugs mi bde lpags ④sogs/ /skya zhing lto ba mkhrang la snum/ /rtsa yi ri mos khyab cing che/ /ring nas ⑧'phel zhing sra ba dang / /reg na grang zhing gsus pa lci/ /zhes bya ba la/ bad kan las gyur pa'i dmu rdzing ni yan lag gi lhu tshigs na zhing snyom pa dang / tshor ba med cing beem bem por 'gyur ba dang / skrang ⑨pa la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa dang / pags pa nas bshang gci'i bar du skya zhing dkar ba dang / lto ba sra zhing rem rem por 'dug pa dang / rtsa ris kyi ⑪ mdog skya bas khyab pa dang /che zhing sbom pa dang / ring zhig nas ⑪'phel zhing rgyas pa dang / rdo ltar sra ba dang / reg na grang zhing bsil ⑫ba dang / gsus pa lci zhing brtan pa yin no/ /gnas gsum 'khrugs pa de dang de/ /bud med kyis byin dri ma rdul//dbyig ⑫dug dug sogs kyis gnod 'gyur/ /khrag bcas dri ma bsags pa ni/ /ltor song gnod pa skyed byed de/ /kha skam mgo 'khor brgyal bcas pa'i /rtags gsum ldan pa'i dmu rdzing skyed/ /myur du smin cing mi bzad na/ /de 113—1172

ni grang dang rlung dang char/ /phrad pas shin tu gnod par 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba la/ nad gzhi gsum char skyed ①par byed pa'i rgyu nad thams cad kyi ④nad gzhi'i skabs su bshad pa rnam pa ①mang po de dang de dag dang / de bzhin du bud med kyis dbang du byas pa'i phyir/ srog chags kyi yan lag las byung ba'i skra la sogs pa rjodri ma dang rdul 'byin par 'gyur ba dang / de bzhin du dbyig dug dang dug la sogs pa byin pas gnod par gyur pas rjokhrag dang bcas pa'i rlung la sogs pa'i nad kyi dri ma bsal zhing rjo'aphel bar 'gyur ba de lto bar song zhing / phyin nas gnod pa'i nad skyed cing 'byung bar byed de/ de kha skam pa la sogs pa dang ldan pa'i dmu rdzing ⑦nad gzhi gsum gyi mtshan ma dang ldan pa skyed par byed pa de skeni myur du smin zhing ⑨brnag par dka' bar mi bzad par na ba yin no/ /yang dmu rdzing gi ⑩nad de ni grang ba la sogs pa dang phrad pas shin tu gnod cing nad 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /mang du zos pas bskyod pa dang // bzhon pa drag ⑪tu 'gro ba dang / /las lam nyal po drags ⑫pas dub/ /sgyug sman drags dang nad kyis ⑫skem/ /g.yon logs gnas pa'i mcher pa ni/ /gnas las 'phos te 'phel ba dang / /yang na dwangs ma sogs pas khrag / rgyas byas ④de ni 'phel gyur ⑫dang / /de ni gtun bu bzhin rab sra/ /de nas rus ⑩sbal rgyab 'dra bar⑩/ /rim gyis 'phel bar 'gyur spyonas ni/ /lto bar dmu rdzing ⑪chags par byed/ /lud pa dbugs mi bde skom dad/ /kha yis ro ni mi tshor zhing / /lci zhing na la rims kyis 'debs/ /sha mdog skya zhing mi sdug la—/ /brgyal zhing slon ( kyepar byed pa dang / /tsha zhing myos dang ldan par 'gyur—/ /rtsa mdog dmar ba'am mi sdug pa'am/ /sngo zhing ser la ri mor 113—1173

bcas—/ /zhes bya ba la/ mang du zos shing ha cang 'grangs drags ①pas bskyod pa dang / rta (kyedang rnga mo la sogs pa'i bzhon pas drag tu ①bskyod cing 'gro ba dang / las dang lam kyis dub pa la sogs pas g.yon logs na duganas pa'i mcher pa gnas las 'phos te 'phel zhing rgyas par 'gyur ba dang /yang na dwangs ma la sogs khyepa'i lus zungs rnams kyi dukhrag 'phel zhing rgyas par byas pa'i dbang gis mcher pa de 'phel bas gnas las 'phos pa'am/rang gi gnas nyid du 'phel bar gyur ④la/ de nas ni mcher pa de dang por bugatun bu ltar sra bar 'gyur la/ de nas khyade'i 'og tu rus ⑫sbal gyi rgyab 'dra bar rim gyis ⑪'phel zhing rgyas par 'gyur gyi cig car 'gyur ba ni ma yin gyi/de ltar lto bar dmu rdzing ⑫chags par 'byung bar byed la de yang dbugs mi bde ba la sogs pa nas rtsa ris sngo zhing ser ba'i bar du 'gyur ro/ /de la rim gyis nad rnams ni/ /bshang 'gags nad ⑫dang lto sgos dang / /rmongs bag skom ⑫ tsha rims kyis 'debs/ /lus lci lto sra yi ga 'chus/ /zhes bya ba la/mcher pa'i skran de la rlung la sogs pa'i nad rnams ni rim ⑫bzhin du bshang ba 'gags ⑩pa la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa yin par shes par bya'o/ /de yang bshang ba 'gags pa dang na ba dang / lto spos pa las ni rlung yin par shes par bya'o/ /rmongs ⑩bag dang skom dad tsha ba dang rims kyis 'debs pa las ni mkhris pa yin par shes par bya'o/ /lus lci ba dang lto sra ba dang yi ga 'chus pa las ni bad kan yin par shes par bya'o/ /mcher ba lta bur mchin skye g.yas logs/ /gnas 'phos dmu sprung skyed ces ⑪bya/ /zhes bya ba la ji ltar mcher pa g.yon logs na 'dug ste/ rgyu'i khyad par gyis 'phos shing lhung 113—1174

nas 'phel bar 'gyur ba de bzhin du mchin pa g.yas logs na ①gnas pa yang 'phos shing thur du lhung la 'phel bar gyur nas dmu rdzing ⑤skyed par shes par rngubya'o—/ /bya sgo sru dang bcas pa'i zas/ /zos pas bshang lam gnas 'gags te/ /gzhang 'brum dang ni rtug skam ④dang / /rgyu mar chags pa'i zas kyis kyang / /thur du sel ba'i ⑤rlung 'khrugs te/ /bshang bas spyobad mkhris bkag nas ni/ /lto bar dmu rdzing chags par byed/ /des ni tsha skom rims dzred 'byung ⑦/ /lud pa dbugs ⑧mi bde brla na/ /klad ⑨snying lte ba gzhang kha na/ /dri ma 'gags slon yi ga 'chus/ /lto bar rlung ni 'khyims par byed/ /brtan zhing rtsa ni sngo la smug /rtsa ris snang ba'am mi snang 'gyur/ /phal cher lte ba'i 'og tu ni/ /ba lang mjug 'dra 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba la/ bya sgro phra mo dang spu'i tshogs dang bcas pa'i zas zos shing longs spyad ⑩pas bshang ba'i lam gyi gnas 'gags ⑪shing 'byung du mi rung bar 'gyur ba dang /gzhang 'brum gyis ()gzhang 'gags par byas pa'am/ rgyu mar chags shing thogs par byed pa'i zas sran ma ma sha ⑫dang zar ma la sogs pa zos pas thur du sel ba'i rlung 'khrugs par 'gyur te/ bshang ba la sogs pas bkag nas lto sra ⑨bar dmu rdzing spyochags par gyur ⑩te/ ltor 'khyil zhing shā)dri ma 'gags pa'i dmu rdzing des ⑫nad pa la tsha zhing skom pa la sogs pa 'byung bar 'gyur ba dang / lto bar rlung 'khyims te rlung phyir 'byung bar mi byed cing nang du 'khyil bar byed pa dang / brtan pa la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa dang / yang dmu rdzing ⑪de ni phal cher mang du lte ba'i 'og tu ( 7dbyibs ba lang gi mjug ma 'dra bar 'byung zhing skye bar 'gyur ro/ /rus sogs zug rngur 113—1175

bcas pa'i zas/ /zos sam shin tu drag zos pa/ /rgyu ma rdol lam ①gas gyur nas/ /bu ga de nas ma zhu bar/ /spyir ⑤'dzag bshang lam las 'byung zhing / /bshang bcas nyung shas nyung ①shas ni/ /sha rul lta bur mnam pa ni/ /sbyin bag dmar ser 'byung bar 'gyur/ /lhag ma yis ni lto ba 'gengs/ /dmu rdzing ④mi bzad skye bar 'gyur/ /de ni lte ba man chad rgyas/ /chus gang lta bur myur du 'gyur/ /nad kyi tshul ni shas cher ldan/ /dbugs mi bde skam ⑤mgo 'khor khyab/ /rgyu ⑥rdol dmu rdzing zhes bshad de/ /gzhan dag rgyu ma 'dzag ces zer/ /zhes bya ba la/ rus pa dang rtsa dang tsher ma dang rdo dang rwa dang shing gi tshal ba la sogs pa'i zas zug rngu dang bcas pa'i kha zas zos par gyur pa'am⑦/ yang na shin tu drag cing shas cher ⑧zos pas gang gi rgyu ma rdol rjocing bu ga dang bcas par 'gyur ba dang ⑩/ gas par gyur nas rdol ⑪ba'am—/ gas pa'i bu ga de nas phyir 'dzag cing zas ma zhu ba kho nar phyir 'dzag par gyur cing bshang ba'i lam nas 'byung bar byed la/ de yang bshang ba dang bcas par nyung shas nyung shas 'byung zhing / 'byung ba de yang sha rul te mi ro'i dri ltar shin tu mnam par 'byung zhing / shing shal ma li'i thang chu ltar sbyin zhing 'byar bag tu gnas pa la/ mdog dmar zhing rtsa ser bar 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /bshang ba'i lam las byung ba'i lhag mas ni lto ba 'gengs shing rgyas par byas nas ⑫dmu rdzing gi nad mi bzad cing brnag par dka' ⑫ba skye zhing 'byung bar 'gyur la/ dmu rdzing de ni lte ba man chad rgyas shing 'phel bar 'gyur la/ de yang lto ba chus gang ba lta bu'i ④dmu rdzing du myur zhing ring por mi thogs par 'gyur ro/ /de ni nad kyi tshul shas che zhing nad kyi rtags stobs 113—1176

dang ldan pa'i tshabs po che dang ldan pa yin la/ dbugs mi bde ba la sogs pas kyang khyab cing zil gyis mnan pa yin no/ /dmu rdzing ①de ni rgyu ma rdol 1ba'i dmu rdzing zhes bya'o/ /zhes slob dpon gyis bshad do/ /drang srong gzhan dag ni dmu rdzing de ①yongs su 'dzag pa'i dmu rdzing zhes bya'o/ /zhes zer ro /snum 'thungs la sogs byas nas ni/ /'phral du chu grang 'thungs pa 'am me drod bri ba'am ha cang ni/ /skom pas chu 'thungs drags pa 'am④/ /rlung dang bad kan 'khrugs chur 'dres/ /chu yi lam ni bkag gyur pas/ /de nyid gnas der 'phel bar 'gyur/ /de 'og dmu rdzing gyur pa yin/ /de nas dmu rjing de las ni/ /skom dad rkub tu chu 'dzag bcas/ /dbugs mi bde lud yi ga 'chus/ /sna tshogs mdog ldan rtsa yis khyab/ /rkyal pa chus gang reg pa 'draske/ /bskyod na sgra grag rjolus 'dar la/ /dmu rdzing chen pos ⑦che zhing snum//brtan zhing de ni lte ba zlum/ /zhes bya ba la/ mi gang zhig snum 'thungs par gyur pa dang / sogs pa zhes bya ba smos pas skyug ⑦sman dang / bkru sman la sogs pa byas shing btang zin pa'i rjes la 'phral du ste ⑧ring po ma lon pa nyid du chu grang ⑨bskol ba ma yin pa 'thungs pa dang / yang na chu grang la sogs pa 'thungs drags pas pho ba'i ⑩me drod bri zhing nyams pa dang / yang na ha cang skom ches pa ste/ zas bcad pa la sogs pas ⑪rus pa dang rgyus pa tsam lus ⑫par gyur pas chu 'thungs drags te⑫/ gnod pa de'i rgyus rlung 'khrugs shing ldang bar 'gyur ba dang / bad kan kyang 'khrugs par gyur nas chu rgyu ba'i lam gyi rgyun srang bkag cing / rlung dang bad kan de gnyis lto bar gnas shing chu de nyid der ④gnas shing de las 'phel zhing ⑫rgyas par gyur pas/ de'i 'og tu 113—1177

chu'i dmu rdzing du gyur pa yin no/ /de nas de'i 'og tu dmu rdzing de skom dad la sogs pa dang ldan par 'gyur ba dang / rkyal pa chus gang ba la reg pa dang 'dra bar chu'i dmu rdzing ①de phan tshun bskyod na sgra grag pa dang bcas pa ①la sogs pa dang / lte ba kun nas zlum zhing 'khyil ba'i rang bzhin can du gnas pa yin no/ /thams cad yal bar bor na ni/ /nad ni rang gnas las 'phos ④te/ /smin pas sla zhing zag 'gyur badhi/ /tshigs dang rtsa sgo las kyang 'dzag /phyi yi rtsa sgo nas rngul 'byung / /'gags nas ⑤thad kar 'khyil zhing gnas—/ /chu de nyid ni 'phel 'gyur zhing ⑥/ /sbyin bag gyur nas de'i tshe ni//lto ba lci zhing sra la zlum/ /brdabs na sgra ni mi 'byung zhing / /mdog 'jam rtsa ris mi snang la/ /lto ba dang ni rgyab du 'gro/ /de rjes chu yi dmu rdzing skye/ /lto bar 'phel zhing de las lhag /rtsa nub gyur pa'i dmu chu ni/ /dmu rdzing bshad pa'i mtshan nyid ldan/ /zhes bya ba la/ dmu rdzing de thams cad kyang yal bar bor zhing gso ba ma byas na/ rlung la sogs pa'i nad rang gi gnas nas 'phos nas rang gi gnas spangs te/ dzeesmin cing gsher bas bee zhing rnag zag ①par byed par 'gyur bas tshigs dang rtsa'i sgo nas kyang zag cing ⑨'byung bar 'gyur la/ phyi rol gyi rtsa'i sgo ba spu'i bu ga nas rngul 'byung ba 'gags shing 'byung du mi ster bas/ thad kar 'khyil cing yan lag tu ⑩'gro bas gnas la sngar gnas pa'i chu de nyid 'phel zhing sogs ⑪par byas nas sbyin bag tu byed ⑫la/de nas de'i 'og tu de'i tshe lto ba ⑫de lci ba la sogs par 'gyur la/ lag pas brdabs na yang sgra mi 'byung ba la sogs par 'gyur la/ de nas de'i rjes la dmu dzeeng der chu'i dmu rdzing ⑩'byung bar 'gyur zhing skye bar 'gyur te chu de lto 113—1178

bar lci zhing rgyas par 'gyur ba dang / rtsa rnams nub cing mi snang bar 'gyur ba dang / chu'i dmu rdzing bshang ba'i mtshan nyid/ /skom dad rkub tu ①chu 'dzag bcas—/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /rlung dang mkhris pa bad kan mcher/ /'dus pa'i 5chu yi dmu rdzing rnams/ /phyi ma bzhin du gso bar dka'/ /zhes bya ba la/ rlung la sogs pa'i dmu rdzing ni phyi ma bzhin du gso bar dka' ba yin te/ rlung gi dmu rdzing pas ④ni mkhris pa'i dmu rdzing gso bar dka' ba yin la/ de bas ni bad kan gyi dmu rdzing gso bar dka' bas na/ chu'i dmu rdzing ni shin tu gso bar dka' ba yin no/ /gzhan dag phal cher zla phyed gsod/ /ces bya ba la/ dmu rdzing de las gzhan pa gnyis po dri ma 'gags pa las gyur pa'i dmu rdzing dang / rgyu ma rdol ba las byung ba'i dmu rdzing dag ni phal cher te mang du zla ba phyed lon pa dang nad pa de gsod cing 'joms par byed pa yin no/ /thams cad chur gyur 'chi ltas le'u④/ /las bshad bla brnan ldan pa'ang ⑤gsod/ /ces bya ba la/ dmu dzeeng ⑥thams cad de rlung las gyur pa la sogs pa kun kyang chur ⑦skyes pa ste/ chu'i dmu rdzing du gyur pa dang / de bzhin du ⑧'chi ltas las bshad pa'i bla brnan ⑨dang ldan pa ste/ sna dang mig dang mtshan ma yo/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa ⑪dang ldan pa'i dmu rjing yang gsod pa yin no/ /skyes nas dmu rdzing ⑫gyur pa dag /phal cher gso bar dka' bar bshad/ /stobs ldan chur ni ma gyur zhing ⑫/ /gsar du byung tusteb 'bad pas gso/ /zhes bya ba la/ skyes nas byung ba'i dmu rdzing du ④gyur pa gang yin pa de thams cad kyang gso bar dka' ba yin no/ /mi stobs dang ldan zhing na tshod dar la bab pa la dmu rdzing de skyes par gyur cing /113—1179

chur ma gyur te gsar du byung ba dag ni gsor rung mod kyi/ spyir gso bar dka' ba'i nad yin pas 'bad pa dang ldan pa kho nas gso bar bya'o/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa'i rnam par 'grel pa tshig gi don gyi zla zer zhes bya ba/ slob dpon zla ba la dga' bas rnam par sbyar ba las/ nad gzhi'i gnas kyi le'u bcu gnyis pa'i rnam par 'grel pa'o// //de nas skya rbab dang 'or nad dang me dbal gyi nad gzhi bshad par bya'o/ /zhes bya ba la/ dmu rdzing gi nad gzhi'i 'og tu skya rbab kyi nad gzhi bshad pa ni/hu7dmu rdzing gi nad skyes na skya rbab la sogs pa yang 'byung bar 'gyur bas/ de'i phyir le'u 'di brtsams pa yin no/ /ji skad bshad pa'i nad 'khrugs pas⑤/ /mkhris pa lhag par ldang gyur la①/ /de la rlung ni stobs che bas/ /snying la gnas pa'i mkhris pa ni/ /gtor te rtsa chen bcu'i ④nang bkram/ /lus kun la ni khyab gyur pas/ /bad kan pags pa sha khrag la/ /gnod byas bar du gnas nas ⑤ ni/ /sha dang pags pa de dag las/ / lpags mdog tha dad dudakar ba dang / /ser zhing ljang sngon byed par 'gyur/ /de las skya ba'i shas che bas/ /de phyir skya rbab nad ces bshad/ /ces bya ba la/ nad rnams ji skad bshad pa'i kha ba dang tsha ba dang mngar ba la sogs pa'i nad gzhi ldang ba'i rgyus 'khrugs shing ldang bar 'gyur ④la/ mkhris pa lhag par shas che bar meldang zhing 'khrugs par gyur na skya rbab kyi nad skyed par 'gyur ro/ /de la nad de rnams kyi nang nas rlung gi nad gang yin pa de ni stobs dang ⑨nus pa shin tu che ba yin pas/ snying gar gnas pa'i mkhris pa gang yin pa de gtor zhing byer 113—1180

bar byed la/ des na mkhris pa de snying la brten pa'i rtsa bo che bcur bkram zhing phyin par byas nas lus ma lus pa kun la khyab cing byer bar gyur nas bad kan la sogs pa la gnod par byas nas/ de ①pags pa dang sha gnyis kyi ②bar du gnas te/ mkhris pa de pags pa'i mdog rnam pa tha dad cing du mar gyur pa skya zhing dkar ba dang ser po dang ①ljang sngon du byed par 'gyur ro/ /mdog de dag las gang gi phyir skya zhing dkar ba'i shas che bas ④na rgyu de'i phyir nad de la skya rbab kyi nad ces bya'o zhes drang srong dag gis ⑤bshad do/ /nad des lus ni lci ba dang / /lus zungs rnams ni lhod pa dang / /mdangs kyi yon tan zad gyur cing / /de las khrag dang tshil chung ste/ /snying po med cing dbang po lhod//yan lag brdungs pa snyam byed cing / /snying rgo zag pa snyam du sems/ /mig phugs skrang zhing nyams la ⑥na/ /mchil mang skad gdangs ⑦dma' ba dang / /zas mi 'dod cing grang mi bzod/ /spu 'byi ④me drod nyams pa dang / /ro smad 'bying zhing rims kyis 'debs/ /dbugs mi bde zhing rna sgra 'bod/ /mgo 'khor ngal bar byed pa yin/ /zhes bya ba la/ skya rbab kyi nad des lus kyi khong lci ba dang / dwangs ma la sogs pa'i lus zungs lhod cing gcig tu 'dus pa zhig pa dang / mdangs kyi yon tan gang dag yod pa de zad cing nyams par 'gyur ba dang / rgyu de dag gis mi'i khrag dang tshil chung ba la sogs par 'gyur ba dang / snying po ni lus kyi stobs la bya ste de med par 'gyur ba dang /dbang po'i tshogs rnams lhod cing bya ba'i sbyar ⑨ba las nyams pa dang / lag ngar la sogs pa'i yan lag rnams brdungs pa snyam du sems pa dang ⑩/ na bar 'gyur ba dang / snying zag cing 'khrugs ⑪par 'gyur ba dang / mig gi 113—1181

phugs skrang zhing glo ①ba dang / mig nyams shing mi sdug ①pa dang / mchil ma mang ba la sogs pa dang ldan pa dang / ro smad 'bying ①zhing nang du zhum pyapar 'gyur ba dang / de bzhin du rims kyis 'debs pa la sogs pa 'byung bar shes par bya'o/ /de ni nad gzhi tha dad 'dus/ /sa zhag zos las rnam lngar 'gyur—/ /zhes bya ba la/ skya rbab kyi nad de rnam pa lnga yod de nad gzhi ⑤ tha dad pa las gyur pa gsum dang / gsum char 'dus pa las gyur pa gcig dang /sa zhag zos pa las gyur pa ni lnga pa yin no/ /'di yi 7sngon tshul snying 'phar zhing / /pags pa rtsub par gyur pa dang / /yi ga 'chus shing gcin mdog ser—/ /rngul med khong pa'i me drod nyams/ /lus rmya ngal bar byed pa yin/ /zhes bya ba lame/ skya rbab kyi nad 'di'i sngon du byung ba'i tshul ni/ snying cung zad 'phar ba dang / la lar pags pa rtsub par gyur pa yin par shes par bya'o//de la rlung gyur lus na zug /rtsa sen mig dang bshang gci rnams/ /mdog gnag rtsub la 'dar ba dang / /skrang sbo kha yis ro mi tshor/ /rtug ⑧skam rtsib logs klad pa na/ /zhes bya ba la/ skya rbab kyi nad de rlung las gyur pa ni lus na zhing mi bde ba dang / khab kyis phug pa ltar zug pa dang / rtsa dang sen mo la sogs pa mdog dmar zhing ⑨rtsub pa dang / lus 'dar ba dang / skom dad la sogs pas nyen par 'gyur ba yin no/ /mkhris las rtsa dang sen mo ⑪sogs—/ /ljang sngon rims 'debs mun 'thibs ⑪byed/ /skom dad rngul brgyal bsel ba 'dod/ /lus mnam kha nang ⑫kha ba dang / /'khru zhing gregs pa byur la tsha/ /zhes bya ba la/ mkhris pa las gyur pa'i skya rbab kyi nad ni/rtsa dang sen mo dang mig dang / bshang ba dang / gci ba ljang sngon la sogs 113—1182

pa'i mdog tu snang ba dang / rims kyis 'debs pa la sogs par 'gyur ro/ /bad kan rtsa ①sogs dkar ba dang / / glongs shing lakha nang lan tshwa bro/ /ba spu ldang zhing skad 'gags la/ /lud pa lu zhing slon par byed/ /ces bya ba la/bad kan las gyur pa'i skya rbab kyi nad ni/ rtsa dang sen mo la sogs pa dkar ba dang / ba sru ldang zhing brtse ba la sogs pa 'byung ba yin no/ /'dus gyur mtshan ma 'dres brnag dka'/ /zhes bya ba la/ 'dus pa las gyur pa'i skya rbab ni nad gzhi gsum char gyi mtshan nyid 'dres ma dang ldan la/ de yang rnag cing ⑦bzod par dka' ba yin no/ /sa zhag bska bas rlung skyed la/ /tshwa bro mkhris pa mngar bad kan/ /dwangs ma la sogs gnod 'gyur zhing ⑤/ /rtsub pas zas zos durtsub gyur nas/ /zhu bas rtsa sbubs 'gags byas te/ /snga ma bzhin du skya rbab skyed/ /de nas lte ba rkang pa dang / /kha dang pho mtshan skrang bar ⑦byed/ /bshang ba srin bu dang bcas 'khru/ /bad kan khrag dang bcas pa ⑤'byung / /zhes bya ba la/ sa zhag zos na de'i ro bska bas ni rlung skyed cing gnod par byed la/ lan tshwa bro bas ni mkhris pa skyed par byed/ mngar bag las ni bad kan skyed par byed cing / dwangs ma la sogs pa'i lus zungs rnams la yang gnod cing 'khrugs par 'gyur ba dang / de'i rtsub pa'i rgyus kha zas zos pa rtsub por gyur nas sa zhag de zhu bar gyur pa dang / des rtsa sbubs kyi sgo 'gag ⑨cing rgyur mi rung bar byas te ⑩rtsa sbubs de dag snga ma bzhin du skya rbab kyi nad skyed par byed do/ /de nas de'i 'og tu lte ⑪ba la sogs pa skrang bar byed pa dang / bshang ba srin bu dang ⑩bcas par 'khru zhing 'byung ba dang / khrag dang bcas pa'i bad kan kha nas 'byung bar 'gyur ba yin no/ /113—1183
